failures.translation: 你的巡逻队遇到两名部落民侦察兵，并没收了他们的武器

failures.source: uses Guard.

failures.source: Not much is known about Antonio, beside him being an extremely talented doctor. How he gained the knowledge he possesses or the skills that he exhibits are a mystery. Wandering into town from the forest on a day like any other, he quickly attracted a crowd of curious people in the poor quarters. He went from person to person and, with simple remedies, made almost every sick person better. His sympathetic nature is unmatched and he can make any person feel welcome in his company.
failures.translation: 人们对安东尼奥知之甚少，只知道他是一位天赋异禀的医生。他如何获得这些知识、练就这些本领，至今仍是谜。有一天，他像往常一样从森林走进镇子，很快便吸引了贫民区一群好奇的人。他挨家挨户地走访，用简单的药剂治好了几乎每一位病人。他富有同情心，无人能及；无论是谁，都能在他身边感到自在。

failures.source: Born in 1489, she grew up in the city under the roof of a fletcher. Her knowledge of bows rivals any expert, and her ability to handle them exceeds even that, but she's proven to be equally handy with an arquebus. She trained with the city guard for several years, before eventually surpassing her superiors, taking over their duties in teaching her fellow students. Although not exactly humble, she is still well aware of her limitations and has an overall pleasant personality, making her a great companion.
failures.translation: 她生于1489年，在一名制弓匠家中长大。她对弓的了解足以媲美任何专家，运用弓的本领更是有过之而无不及；不过，她使用火绳枪也同样得心应手。她曾在城镇卫兵训练多年，后来逐渐超越上级，接过了教导同窗的职责。她虽算不上谦逊，却很清楚自己的局限，性格总体也十分讨喜，是个很好的伙伴。

failures.source: Moving through the jungle, you hear the sounds of people nearby and divert your expedition to investigate the noise. You come out into a creek where a group of natives similar in number to your expedition is setting up the sort of traps that the tribes use to hunt boars and similar. As soon as they notice your troops between the trees, the trappers grab their weapons and shout angrily at you in their native tongue.
failures.translation: 你穿行在丛林中，听见附近有人声，便带领远征队转向，前去查探。你们来到一条溪流边，看到一群人数与你们相近的原住民正在布置陷阱——那是部族用来捕捉野猪等猎物的那种陷阱。他们一发现你的部队出现在树林间，设陷者便抓起武器，用他们的母语愤怒地朝你们喊叫。

failures.source: The volley just about does the trick. The trappers scatter in panicked disarray, and some of them flee into the jungle. A handful of them choose to fight rather than flight, however, and attack you desperately.
failures.translation: 这一轮齐射差不多奏效了。设陷者惊慌失措地四散奔逃，有些人逃进了丛林。不过，仍有几个人选择战斗而非逃跑，绝望地向你们发起攻击。

failures.source: Though your plan was solid, the execution is lacking - you simply don't have the overwhelming force necessary to scare the trappers. Instead, your volley causes them to attack your people with all they've got.
failures.translation: 你的计划本身不错，执行起来却不尽如人意——你们没有足够压倒性的力量吓退那些设陷者。反倒是这一轮齐射激得他们全力攻击你的人。

failures.source: When the loudest sound in the jungle is once again whatever feathered nuisance kept you up most of the night, you order your men to check for survivors and collect anything useful they might find on the dead. They return with a few pieces of useful equipment and a decent assortment of valuable trinkets. The best part is the racks full of boar meat that the trappers had apparently managed to catch before you ran into them.
failures.translation: 当丛林里最大声的动静再次变成某种羽毛烦人精——它大半夜吵得你睡不着——你便命令手下查看是否有幸存者，并搜集死者身上可能有用的东西。他们带回了几件有用的装备和不少值钱的小饰品。最可观的是几架肉架，上面堆满了野猪肉，显然是那些设陷者遇见你们之前捕到的。

failures.source: The trappers fight skillfully as well as fiercely, and your people make several tactical mistakes. After a short skirmish, you're forced to admit defeat and withdraw your troops, barely hauling your injured with you out of the clearing. Perhaps fearful of being drawn into a trap, your enemies do not pursue you, and you make it back to the carts with no further losses.
failures.translation: 设陷者打得既娴熟又凶猛，你的人则犯了好几处战术错误。短暂交锋后，你们被迫认输撤兵，几乎是拖着伤员才逃出空地。敌人或许担心会中了陷阱，没有追来；你们回到马车旁，没有再遭受损失。

failures.source: "No one in this village, I can assure you. The good doctor left a week ago to seek the mad shaman Orocobix on the mountains. He did not return. We found his body two days ago, deep in the jungle where our trappers hunt. He was naked, and his eyes had been clawed from their sockets. Best I could tell, by his own hands."
failures.translation: “我可以保证，我们村庄里没人动手。好医生一周前去了山里找疯狂萨满奥罗科比克斯，再也没回来。两天前，我们在丛林深处发现他的尸体，那里是我们的设陷者狩猎的地方。他浑身赤裸，眼珠被人从眼眶里挖了出来。据我所知，是他自己动的手。”

failures.source: You recognise the helmet as soon as you pick it up: it belonged to the conquistador Felipe Gutiérrez, who was sent on an expedition three years prior to yours, from which nobody ever returned. Beneath the helmet is a small, distinctly feminine pouch full of medicinal herbs and remedies. The name "Ines" is stitched into it.
failures.translation: 你一拿起头盔便认出了它：这是征服者费利佩·古铁雷斯的头盔。他在你出发前三年奉命参加了一次远征，此后再也没有人回来。头盔下方有个小巧的袋子，样式颇有女性气息，里面装满了药草和药剂。袋子上绣着“伊内斯”这个名字。

failures.source: Your peaceful FType FName crosses FHisHer arms.
failures.translation: 你那和平的FTypeFName交叉抱着FHisHer双臂。

failures.source: "Ten seasons ago, we saw their ships sail down the coast, and many suspected that they were gods. Several days later, they came here. They were too many to count. Many times the population of my tribe. They were very aggressive and they took some of our people with them. We haven't seen our tribesmen since."
failures.translation: “十个季节以前，我们看见他们的船沿着海岸驶来，许多人以为他们是神。几天后，他们来到了这里。人数多得数不清，比我们部族的人口多出好几倍。他们十分好斗，还带走了我们的一些族人。自那以后，我们就再也没见过他们。”

failures.source: Immediately, the able-bodied men of the village raise their weapons and attack while everyone else scatters terrified between the huts.
failures.translation: 村庄里健壮的男人立刻举起武器发起攻击，其他人则惊恐地四散逃进各间小屋。

failures.source: "ATTACK! KILL EVERYONE!"
failures.translation: “进攻！杀光他们！”

failures.source: Your people immediately brandish their weapons and attack. The terrified villagers scatter and flee as best they can.
failures.translation: 你的人立刻亮出武器发起攻击。受惊的村民尽可能地四散逃跑。

failures.source: "We don't know how they'll respond to our presence. We must attack pre-emptively."
failures.translation: “我们不知道他们会如何回应我们的到来。必须先发制人。”

failures.source: You spend a little time scraping the overgrowth from the inscriptions around the entrance and determine that the "Temple of Death" is not just an apt moniker invented by the tribals, but indeed the original name of the temple. As far as you can tell from the weathered glyphs, the purpose of the construction is to honour Quetzalcoatl by inciting brash young men and women to throw their lives away with the promise of untold treasure hidden somewhere deep inside.
failures.translation: 你花了一点时间刮去入口周围铭文上的杂草，由此确定“死亡神庙”并非部落民随口编出的贴切绰号，而是这座神殿原本的名字。从风化的象形文字来看，这座建筑是为了纪念羽蛇神而建，借着深处藏有无数宝藏的承诺，怂恿鲁莽的年轻男女前来送命。

failures.source: "In God's name, FNameFirst2! If you were in charge, we'd have turned our ship around the moment we saw the coast! We came here to explore the land and claim its riches for Spain, and here is a splendid opportunity to do so."
failures.translation: “看在上帝的分上，FNameFirst2！要是由你做主，我们一看到海岸就会掉头返航！我们来这里是为了探索这片土地，为西班牙夺取它的财富，而眼下正有绝佳的机会！”

failures.source: You appear to have finally reached the innermost room of the Temple of Death. On a dais along the far wall, surrounded by valuable gems and golden trinkets, rests an exquisite mask shaped like a mostly humanoid skull, but with very large fangs. The mask is adorned with blue stones and its eyes are two enormous opals. From what you've picked up of Aztec mythology, you're guessing it must represent the creator god Tezcatlipoca, or "Smoking Mirror".
failures.translation: 你们似乎终于抵达了死亡神殿最深处的房间。远处墙边的高台上，摆着一副精美面具，周围散落着珍贵宝石和金色小饰品。面具呈骷髅状，大致是人形，却长着巨大的獠牙；上面镶嵌着蓝色宝石，眼眶里则嵌着两颗巨大的欧泊。从你了解到的阿兹特克神话来看，你猜它代表的应该是创世神特斯卡特利波卡，也就是“烟雾之镜”。

failures.source: When the creatures finally attack, your people don't know how to react, they split up and some of them are pinned down. FName1 receives a nasty bite in the neck before FHeShe1 can be saved, and when you've finally killed the last of the dogs and the doors at both ends of the room open again, the FType1 must be carried back out of the temple by a couple of your servants.
failures.translation: 那些生物终于发动攻击时，你的人马不知所措，四散开来，有些人被困住了。FName1被狠狠咬了一口，伤在脖子上；FHeShe1还没来得及救下FName1。等你们终于杀光最后几条狗、房间两端的门再次打开时，只得让几名仆人把FType1抬出神殿。

failures.source: The greeting party divides in two to allow you passage, and forms up behind you as an escort, following you across the causeway into the city. Up close, the city of Tenochtitlan almost defies description. It's as large as any European city you've ever visited, easily rivalling Seville or Córdoba for size. Its towering temples and palaces are richly decorated in blue and red, and its streets are filled with people who scatter before you and stare as you pass.
failures.translation: 迎接你们的人分成两列让出道路，随后在你们身后列队护送，陪你们沿堤道进入城中。走近之后，特诺奇蒂特兰的宏伟几乎难以言表。它不输你去过的任何一座欧洲城市，规模轻易便能与塞维利亚或科尔多瓦匹敌。高耸的神庙和宫殿装饰着华丽的蓝色与红色，街道上挤满了人；他们在你经过时纷纷避让，注视着你们。

failures.source: He nods. Then he turns and swings his macuahuitl with all his power, crushing the head of one of the warriors behind him. For a moment, everybody is stunned, and you realise you /must/ act before that moment passes.
failures.translation: 他点了点头，随后转过身，用尽全力挥动手中的马夸维特尔，砸碎了身后一名战士的头颅。一时间，所有人都惊呆了，你意识到自己/必须/趁着这片刻的空当采取行动。

failures.source: His entire body sags. He mumbles something, but you can't even remotely hear what he's saying at this distance. Then he straightens up, raises his hand, and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 他整个人都垮了下来。他低声嘟囔着什么，可隔着这么远，你根本听不清他在说什么。随后他挺直身子，举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: Coyotl raises his hand and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 科约特尔举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: Coyotl raises his hand and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 科约特尔举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: Coyotl raises his hand and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 科约特尔举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: To your dismay, Citlalli stands near the centre of the battlefield, her bow in her hands with an arrow ready to loose, scouting warily in your direction. She shouts to you as your people come to a halt.
failures.translation: 令你沮丧的是，西特拉利站在战场中央附近，手握弓箭，箭已搭弦，正警惕地朝你这边张望。你的人停下脚步时，她朝你喊道。

failures.source: "That's close enough! If you take another step, we will attack! Damn you for coming here, PNameFirst! And /damn/ you for siding with the Aztec!"
failures.translation: “站住！再敢向前一步，我们就进攻！该死的，你竟敢来这里，PNameFirst！还有/该死/的你，竟然站在阿兹特克人那边！”

failures.source: She holds your gaze a moment longer. Then in one fluid motion, she turns and raises her spear, thrusting it directly through the chest of one of the warriors behind her. For a moment, everybody is stunned, and you realise you /must/ act before that moment passes.
failures.translation: 她又凝视了你片刻，随后动作流畅地转过身，举起长矛，径直刺穿身后一名战士的胸膛。一时间，所有人都惊呆了，你意识到自己/必须/趁着这片刻的空当采取行动。

failures.source: She stares at you for another moment. You can see her lips move, but at this distance you can't even hear a sound. Then, she shifts her weight, raises her hand, and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 她又盯着你看了一会儿。你看见她的嘴唇在动，可隔着这么远，你什么也听不见。接着她挪了挪重心，举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: Citlalli shifts her weight, raises her hand, and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 西特拉利挪了挪重心，举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: Citlalli shifts her weight, raises her hand, and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 西特拉利挪了挪重心，举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: With that, Citlalli raises her hand and gives the signal to attack.
failures.translation: 说罢，西特拉利举起手，发出了进攻的信号。

failures.source: The central plaza, previously reserved for auctions, is littered with the scattered bodies of Tlaxcalteca warriors. Behind the barricades, among the scattered bodies of Totonac warriors, stands FNameLast. The jaguar warriors you gave FHimHer control over are rifling through the belongings of the fallen Aztecs.
failures.translation: 中央广场原本用于拍卖，如今散落着特拉斯卡拉战士的尸体。路障后，在托托纳克战士的尸体之间，FNameLast伫立在那里。你交由FHimHer指挥的美洲虎武士，正在翻找阵亡阿兹特克人的财物。

failures.source: "Of course we were! Are you ready to move on?"
failures.translation: “那当然！准备好继续前进了吗？”

failures.source: The central plaza, previously reserved for auctions, is littered with the bodies of Totonac warriors. Your people stop in their tracks when you realise that the market is still under Tlaxcalteca control.
failures.translation: 中央广场原本用于拍卖，如今散落着托托纳克战士的尸体。你意识到市场仍在特拉斯卡拉人控制之下，你的人顿时停下脚步。

failures.source: One of the Tlaxcalteca warriors waves his hand and shouts an invitation.
failures.translation: 一名特拉斯卡拉战士挥手高声邀请你们。

failures.source: A small group of servants nervously dart across the battlefield, and the Tlaxcalteca stay their bows as promised. The servants return carrying just one corpse - the body of your FRank FName.
failures.translation: 一小队仆人紧张地飞奔穿过战场，特拉斯卡拉人如约放下了弓。仆人回来时只抬回了一具尸体——你那位FRankFName的遗体。

failures.source: "Word has reached me of your FType's defeat here. My condolences, my friend, I placed too great a burden on you. It is good that you took the Emperor's palace, so my elites were free to launch a follow-up attack here. Come, follow me to the palace. We must plan our final move."
failures.translation: “我听说你们的FType在这里战败了。朋友，请节哀，是我把太重的担子压在你身上了。幸好你拿下了皇帝的宫殿，我的精锐部队这才得以腾出手来，在这里发动后续进攻。来，跟我去宫殿。我们得计划最后的行动。”

failures.source: "We have found the Emperor, but he and his Imperial guards have fortified themselves in one of the gardens. They are too well trained and equipped, and Moctezuma might escape if we don't do this right. You have to lead the attack, but I will join you, under your command, if you desire it."
failures.translation: “我们找到皇帝了，但他和他的皇家卫兵据守在一座花园里。他们训练有素、装备精良；我们若是处理不当，蒙特苏马可能会逃走。你必须率领进攻，不过如果你愿意，我也会在你的指挥下加入。”

failures.source: The Tlaxcalteca warriors have gathered on the central plaza, which was reserved for auctions, where they seem to be discussing strategy. It's a fairly defensible position, but you may still have a few options beyond a straightforward assault.
failures.translation: 特拉斯卡拉战士聚集在中央广场——那里原本是举行拍卖的地方——似乎正在商议策略。那里相当易守难攻，但除了正面强攻，你或许还有几种选择。

failures.source: The battle is over as quickly as it started. Among the dead and wounded bodies littering the ground, you find Coyotl sprawled on the ground, bleeding from several mortal injuries. He looks up at you and blinks.
failures.translation: 战斗开始得快，结束得也快。地上遍布死者和伤者，你发现科约特尔倒在地上，身上有好几处致命伤，鲜血直流。他抬头看着你，眨了眨眼。

failures.source: The sprawling and normally so busy market of Tlatelolco is a complete mess. The bodies of civilians and warriors alike litter the streets, the warehouses are burning, the stalls are trampled and broken, their colourful canopies fluttering in the wind.
failures.translation: 特拉特洛尔科市场平日里规模庞大、热闹非凡，此刻却一片狼藉。街上到处都是平民和战士的尸体，仓库燃着大火，摊位被踩烂、砸毁，色彩鲜艳的棚布在风中飘动。

failures.source: Your loyal FType1 raises a heavy arm in greeting as you approach FHimHer1.
failures.translation: 你那忠诚的FType1见你走近，举起粗壮的手臂向你致意。

failures.source: "Of course we were! Are you ready to move on?"
failures.translation: “那当然！准备继续前进了吗？”

failures.source: One of the Tlaxcalteca warriors waves his hand and shouts an invitation.
failures.translation: 一名特拉斯卡拉战士挥手高声邀请你们。

failures.source: A small group of servants nervously dart across the battlefield, and the Tlaxcalteca stay their bows as promised. The servants return carrying just one corpse - the body of your FRank FName.
failures.translation: 一小队仆人紧张地飞奔穿过战场，特拉斯卡拉人如约放下了弓。仆人回来时只抬回了一具尸体——你那位FRankFName的遗体。

failures.source: "I am sorry for the defeat your people have suffered here, but thanks to your victories on the causeway and in the military quarter, the brunt of the Totonac invaders have been repelled. We can deal with this isolated group later, something far more important needs your attention!"
failures.translation: “很遗憾你的人在这里遭遇了惨败。不过多亏你们在堤道和军事区取胜，托托纳克入侵者的主力已经被击退。我们之后再收拾这支孤军，有件重要得多的事正等着你处理！”

failures.source: The Tlaxcalteca warriors have gathered on the central plaza, which was reserved for auctions, where they seem to be discussing strategy. It's a fairly defensible position, but you may still have a few options beyond a straightforward assault.
failures.translation: 特拉斯卡拉战士聚集在中央广场——那里原本是举行拍卖的地方——似乎正在商议策略。那里相当易守难攻，但除了正面强攻，你或许还有几种选择。

failures.source: The battle is over as quickly as it started. Among the dead and wounded bodies littering the ground, you find Citlalli curled up in a foetal position, bleeding from several mortal injuries. She rolls over with a pained groan to look at you.
failures.translation: 战斗开始得有多快，结束得就有多快。地上横七竖八地躺着死者和伤者，你发现西特拉莉蜷缩成胎儿般的姿势，身上几处致命伤正不断流血。她痛苦地呻吟着翻过身来看你。

failures.source: Citlalli exhales deeply and dies.
failures.translation: 西特拉莉深深呼出一口气，死去了。

failures.source: Citlalli digs her nails into your arm.
failures.translation: 西特拉莉的指甲深深掐进你的手臂。

failures.source: Citlalli's grasp weakens and her whole body cramps up in pain, then she is dead.
failures.translation: 西特拉莉的手渐渐松开，整个身体因疼痛而抽搐起来，随后便死了。

failures.source: [Check Tactics Hard] Sneak closer and catch them unawares with a volley.
failures.translation: [检定战术（困难）] 悄悄靠近，趁他们不备齐射一轮。

failures.source: You identify the locations of the enemy lookouts, then direct your troops to stay low and move from cover to cover, taking care to time their movement to when the lookouts aren't paying attention. Your people take care of the lookouts first, then get into position within range of the enemies.
failures.translation: 你找出敌方哨兵的位置，然后指挥队伍压低身子、借助掩体逐步前进，并谨慎把握时机，趁哨兵不注意时行动。你的人先解决哨兵，再进入敌人射程内就位。

failures.source: On your signal, the troops let loose a volley that immediately takes out several of the enemies. The rest scramble to ready their weapons and defend themselves against your surprise attack.
failures.translation: 你一声令下，士兵们立刻齐射，击倒了好几名敌人。其余敌人慌忙拿起武器，抵挡这场突袭。

failures.source: You direct your troops to stay low and move from cover to cover, but Tlaxcalteca lookouts soon spot you and alert their comrades. Looks like it'll be a straight-up fight then!
failures.translation: 你指挥队伍压低身子、借助掩体逐步前进，但特拉斯卡拉人的哨兵很快发现了你们，并向同伴示警。看来只能正面交战了！

failures.source: FName volunteers to scout out the area and moves quickly and carefully from building to building around the plaza. When FHeShe returns, it is with good news and bad news both.
failures.translation: FName主动请缨侦察周围情况，在广场周围的建筑间迅速而谨慎地穿行。FHeShe回来时，带来了好消息，也带来了坏消息。

failures.source: "The bad news is that the direct approach seems heavily trapped and fortified - there are some dangerous choke points where we could get pinned down while we hack away at barricades. The good news is that I think I've found a path between two houses that circumvents all this, though it's quite narrow. There was a spike trap there, but I disarmed it."
failures.translation: “坏消息是，正面路线似乎布满陷阱，防守严密——有几处危险的狭窄地段，我们可能会被困在那里，一边砍开路障一边挨打。好消息是，我想我找到了一条绕过这些障碍的小路，夹在两栋房子之间，不过路很窄。那里有个尖刺陷阱，但我已经拆除了。”

failures.source: FName volunteers to scout out the area and moves quickly and carefully from building to building around the plaza. When FHeShe returns, it is with bad news.
failures.translation: FName主动请缨侦察周围情况，在广场周围的建筑间迅速而谨慎地穿行。FHeShe回来时带来了坏消息。

failures.source: "I'm sorry Capitán, I see no way in there other than the direct approach. It seems heavily trapped and fortified, and there are some dangerous choke points where we could get pinned down while we hack away at barricades."
failures.translation: “抱歉，队长，我看没有别的路，只能正面突破。那里似乎布满陷阱，防守严密，还有几处危险的狭窄地段，我们可能会被困在那里，一边砍开路障一边挨打。”

failures.source: You form up and advance upon the enemy with your weapons lowered, your translators preaching of your superiority in battle and urging the enemies to retreat before it's too late. The Tlaxcalteca warriors look not at all sure how to deal with this new menace, so to drive home the point, your people fire a volley from their weapons into the air.
failures.translation: 你们列队向敌人推进，武器低垂，翻译官高声宣扬你们在战斗中的优势，劝敌人趁还来得及赶紧撤退。特拉斯卡拉战士似乎完全不知该如何应对这支新出现的威胁。为了让他们明白，你的人朝空中齐射一轮。

failures.source: This makes a certain impression on your enemies, a few of whom turn tail and flee your ranks as fast as their legs will take them. The majority of the Tlaxcalans, unfortunately, opt to draw their weapons and defend themselves.
failures.translation: 这番举动确实震慑了敌人，其中几人转身逃跑，拼命跑离你们的队伍。可惜，大多数特拉斯卡拉人选择拔出武器自卫。

failures.source: You form up and advance upon the enemy with your weapons lowered, your translators preaching of your superiority in battle and urging the enemies to retreat before it's too late. The Tlaxcalteca warriors look farely confused and not at all sure how to respond to this new menace, but in the end - regrettably - they all opt to draw their weapons and defend themselves.
failures.translation: 你们列队向敌人推进，武器低垂，翻译官高声宣扬你们在战斗中的优势，劝敌人趁还来得及赶紧撤退。特拉斯卡拉战士显然十分困惑，完全不知该如何应对这支新出现的威胁，但最终——令人遗憾的是——他们全都选择拔出武器自卫。

failures.source: There's no way to be sneaky about it, so your people form up and file into the plaza. Your enemies immediately begin to shout and ready their weapons. The battlefield is fairly wide, with plenty of good cover, but it doesn't look like you'll have time to set up barricades and such. Your enemies have evidently had time to fortify the area, so you should probably expect a few traps.
failures.translation: 这事没法悄悄办成，于是你的人列队鱼贯进入广场。敌人立刻开始呼喊并拿起武器。战场相当宽阔，有不少可用的掩体，但看起来你们没时间设置路障之类的东西。敌人显然有时间加固了这片区域，所以最好预料到会有一些陷阱。

failures.source: Coyotl wipes the blood from his weapon, then he zeroes in on you like a bird of prey and pulls you into a strong embrace.
failures.translation: 科约特擦去武器上的血迹，随后像猛禽锁定猎物般盯住你，将你紧紧拥入怀中。

failures.source: Citlalli discards the half-broken spear she took from one enemy and pulls her own weapon from the chest of another enemy. Then she quickly scans the battlefield to find you, and walks directly up to you.
failures.translation: 西特拉莉丢下从一名敌人手中夺来的半截长矛，从另一名敌人的胸口拔出自己的武器。随后她迅速扫视战场找到了你，径直朝你走来。

failures.source: Go to the military quarter and see how the fight went there.
failures.translation: 前往军营区，看看那里的战况。

failures.source: "Capitán, we should rendezvous with FNameFirst2 in the military quarter and get an idea of how the war is going."
failures.translation: “队长，我们应该去军营区和FNameFirst2会合，了解一下战况。”

failures.source: From out here, you have a fine view of the obliteration of the Totonac invasion force as the Aztec army mounts a counter-attack and rolls right over the encampments surrounding the city. The cheers of the Aztecs can be heard far outside the city. Tepictoton is dead, Tenochtitlan remains, and all hope of overthrowing the established order is lost because your people could not fulfil the role they had been afforded.
failures.translation: 从这里望去，托托纳克人的入侵军遭到彻底歼灭，景象尽收眼底。阿兹特克军队发起反击，席卷了城外的营地。城外远处也能听见阿兹特克人的欢呼。特皮克托顿死了，特诺奇蒂特兰依然屹立，而推翻既有秩序的希望也彻底破灭——你们未能履行被赋予的使命。

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回国向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就返回船上，扬帆启航。

failures.source: The merchant bows and leaves to make the arrangements. You return to your carts, and half an hour later, four overtaxed servants arrive with an old wooden cart loaded with iron ore and gold.
failures.translation: 商人鞠躬离去，着手安排此事。你回到车队，半小时后，四名累得不堪重负的仆人赶来，拉着一辆破旧的木车，车上装满了铁矿石和黄金。

failures.source: The marketplace is found in Tlatelolco, which turns out to be a sister city that lies right next to Tenochtitlan, on the northern part of the island. Its market is enormous, perhaps twice the size of the city of Seville, and brimming with food and trinkets. It's well known that you've been a friend to the Aztec, and so the prices in the market are a little lower for you than the would normally be.
failures.translation: 集市位于特拉特洛尔科。那里原来是一座紧邻特诺奇蒂特兰的姐妹城，坐落在岛屿北部。集市规模庞大，大约是塞维利亚城的两倍，食品和小玩意琳琅满目。众所周知，你与阿兹特克人交好，因此这里的价格比平常稍低一些。

failures.source: The marketplace is found in Tlatelolco, which turns out to be a sister city that lies right next to Tenochtitlan, on the northern part of the island. Its market is enormous, perhaps twice the size of the city of Seville, and brimming with food and trinkets. The merchants are friendly and subservient, but as the city is very rich, their prices are fairly steep.
failures.translation: 集市位于特拉特洛尔科。那里原来是一座紧邻特诺奇蒂特兰的姐妹城，坐落在岛屿北部。集市规模庞大，大约是塞维利亚城的两倍，食品和小玩意琳琅满目。商人们友善而恭顺，但这座城市十分富庶，物价也相当高。

failures.source: Find Mātlal's storerooms.
failures.translation: 找到马特拉尔的仓库。

failures.source: Night falls and the people passing by the building slow from a trickle to an occasional drip. Your servants quietly move a few carts up to the back of the building while you break down the door with some of your people.
failures.translation: 夜幕降临，路过建筑的人从稀稀拉拉变成偶尔才有一两个。仆人悄悄把几辆车赶到建筑后方，你则带着几个人破门而入。

failures.source: A group of Aztec warriors led by an Eagle Warrior and directed from behind by Mātlal are converging on your people. Your servants are already making off with the carts, so you should be able to make a clean escape if you don't fancy your chances against the Aztecs.
failures.translation: 一群阿兹特克战士正朝你们围拢过来，为首的是一名鹰战士，马特拉尔则在后方指挥。仆人已经赶着车逃走；若你不想和阿兹特克人交手，应该能顺利脱身。

failures.source: After defeating your people, the Aztecs catch up to your servants and attack them as well, causing them to abandon the carts and flee in disarray. Meanwhile, you gather your wounded and sneak off to safety before the warriors come back.
failures.translation: 阿兹特克人击败你们后，追上仆人并对他们发动攻击，迫使他们丢下车子，狼狈逃窜。与此同时，你召集伤员，在战士们回来之前悄悄逃到安全处。

failures.source: You break out the old bartering skills that served you so well in the markets back in Spain. Despite the language barrier, the Aztec merchants are no match for your assertiveness and your deft timing and inventiveness. You manage to lower their prices considerably.
failures.translation: 你使出在西班牙集市上屡试不爽的老练议价本领。尽管有语言障碍，阿兹特克商人仍不是你的对手；你把握时机，机敏应对，最终成功大幅压低了价格。

failures.source: You break out the old bartering skills that served you so well in the markets back in Spain. Perhaps because of the language barrier, however, the Aztec merchants seem immune to your deft timing and inventiveness. Exhibiting stubbornness that would ruin any merchant in a Spanish market, they simply refuse to go any lower than their original prices.
failures.translation: 你使出在西班牙集市上屡试不爽的老练议价本领。然而，也许正因为语言障碍，阿兹特克商人似乎对你把握时机、机敏应对的本领毫无反应。他们固执得足以让任何西班牙集市上的商人破产，只肯维持原价，绝不再降。

failures.source: Most of the items on sale in the market are everyday objects of little use to you. However, after trawling through useless junk for the longest time, you manage to locate the few scattered stalls where artisans from outside the city are peddling supplies for trappers and warriors. Unfortunately, spike traps and net traps both sell for 400 Valuables a piece, and you can't afford that.
failures.translation: 市场上出售的大多是些日常用品，对你没什么用处。然而，在一大堆无用杂物里翻找了半天后，你总算找到了几处零散的摊位，外城来的工匠正在那里兜售供设陷者和战士使用的装备。可惜，尖刺陷阱和网陷阱都要每个400贵重物品，你买不起。

failures.source: As you navigate the narrow streets of the sprawling market, an Aztec man steps into your path. He is dressed in fine clothes, with an ostentatious hat and much jewellery adorning his upper body. He speaks slowly, picking his words carefully, evidently with a broad and precise vocabulary which seems to brush off on your interpreter.
failures.translation: 你穿行在这片广阔集市的狭窄街巷间，一名阿兹特克男子挡在了你面前。他身穿华服，头戴一顶惹眼的帽子，上身佩戴着许多珠宝。他说话缓慢，字斟句酌，显然词汇丰富又精确，似乎连你的翻译都受到了感染。

failures.source: "That we deliver three score sacks of corn and seeds to him. His demands grow more insistent with every week that goes by, but we cannot simply give away our goods. We all have debts to repay."
failures.translation: “要我们给他送去六十袋玉米和种子。每过一周，他的要求就更强硬一些，但我们也不能把货物白白送人。大家都有债要还。”

failures.source: A merchant in Tenochtitlan has asked you to find the Eagle Warrior Coyotl and make him cease his threats. Coyotl is stationed in Texcoco, on the eastern bank of the lake.
failures.translation: 一名特诺奇蒂特兰的商人请你找到鹰武士科约特尔，让他停止威胁。科约特尔驻扎在湖东岸的特斯科科。

failures.source: Your loyal FType1 raises a heavy arm in greeting as you approach FHimHer1.
failures.translation: 你走近时，忠诚的FType1举起粗壮的手臂向你致意。

failures.source: In the central part of the district stands an old temple that appears to have been converted into some sort of fortification. Your people stop in their tracks when you realise that the district is still under Totonac control.
failures.translation: 区中央矗立着一座古老的神殿，似乎已被改造成某种防御工事。你意识到这片区域仍在托托纳克人控制之下，自己人随即停下脚步。

failures.source: A small group of servants nervously dart across the battlefield, and the Totonacs stay their bows as promised. The servants return carrying just one corpse - the body of your FRank FName.
failures.translation: 一小队仆人紧张地冲过战场，托托纳克人信守承诺，没有放箭。仆人回来时只抬着一具尸体——那是你的FRankFName。

failures.source: "I am sorry for the defeat your people have suffered here, but thanks to your victories on the causeway and in the market, the brunt of the Totonac invaders have been repelled. We can deal with this isolated group later, something far more important needs your attention!"
failures.translation: “很遗憾你的人在这里遭遇了惨败。不过，多亏你们在堤道和集市取得的胜利，托托纳克侵略者的主力已经被击退。我们可以稍后再处理这支孤军，眼下有更重要的事需要你去办！”

failures.source: In the central part of the district stands an old temple that appears to have been converted into some sort of fortification. This is where the Totonac invaders have convened and dug in against the inevitable Aztec counter-attack.
failures.translation: 区中央矗立着一座古老的神殿，似乎已被改造成某种防御工事。托托纳克侵略者聚集在这里据守，准备迎战势不可挡的阿兹特克反攻。

failures.source: The battle is over as quickly as it started. Among the dead and wounded bodies littering the ground, you find Citlalli curled up in a foetal position, bleeding from several mortal injuries. She rolls over with a pained groan to look at you.
failures.translation: 战斗开始得快，结束得也快。在遍地的死者和伤者中，你发现西特拉利蜷缩成胎儿般的姿势，身上几处致命伤正不断流血。她痛苦地呻吟一声，翻过身来看着你。

failures.source: FName volunteers to scout out the area and moves quickly and carefully from building to building around the plaza. When FHeShe returns, it is with good news and bad news both.
failures.translation: FName主动请缨侦察周边，迅速而谨慎地穿行于广场周围的各栋建筑之间。FHeShe回来时，带来了好消息，也带来了坏消息。

failures.source: FName volunteers to scout out the area and moves quickly and carefully from building to building around the plaza. When FHeShe returns, it is with bad news.
failures.translation: FName主动请缨侦察周边，迅速而谨慎地穿行于广场周围的各栋建筑之间。FHeShe回来时，只带来了坏消息。

failures.source: The battle is over as quickly as it started. The Totonac warriors lie scattered across the market, the survivors among them soon being helped by civilians cautiously emerging from the surrounding buildings.
failures.translation: 战斗开始得快，结束得也快。托托纳克武士横七竖八地倒在市场上，周围建筑里的平民谨慎地走出来，很快便开始救助幸存者。

failures.source: "My people will take care of it. We will draw as many of the Totonacs away from the palace as we can, so you can bring your people in and defend the emperor!"
failures.translation: “我的族人会处理。我们会尽可能把托托纳克人从宫殿引开，这样你就能带人进去保护皇帝！”

failures.source: "I'm glad that you have been victorious here. Thanks to you, the brunt of the Totonac invaders have been repelled, and the island is secure except for isolated skirmishes throughout the city."
failures.translation: “很高兴你在这里取得了胜利。多亏了你，托托纳克入侵者的主力已被击退，岛上也已安全，城中只剩零星冲突。”

failures.source: "Tepictoton himself has breached the palace with a group of his elite warriors! The emperor's personal guard has fortified him in his garden, but they can't hold out much longer. You must come to Moctezuma's aid! If  the emperor falls, our victories here won't matter!"
failures.translation: “特皮克托顿亲自率领一队精锐武士攻入了宫殿！皇帝的近卫已在花园中护住他，但他们撑不了多久。你必须去救蒙特苏马！如果皇帝倒下，我们在这里的胜利就毫无意义了！”

failures.source: He looks at his warriors, and they nod back in reply.
failures.translation: 他看向自己的武士，他们也点头回应。

failures.source: "We will take care of that. We will draw the main group of warriors out of the palace so you can reach the emperor and deal with Tepictoton!"
failures.translation: “这事交给我们。我们会把宫殿里的主力武士引出来，这样你就能赶到皇帝身边，对付特皮克托顿！”

failures.source: "Take this extra equipment. Use it to defend the emperor. As always, good luck my friend!"
failures.translation: “拿上这些额外的装备，用它们保护皇帝。老朋友，祝你好运，一如既往！”

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回家向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就回到船上启航。

failures.source: Tepictoton looks like his old self again, and he's changed out of his Jaguar Warrior armour and into a very fancy gown that you suspect he's pilfered from Moctezuma's wardrobe. You join him along with a careful selection of the city's highest ranking nobles in the feast hall and enjoy one of the best meals you've had in a very long time.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿看起来又恢复了往日的样子。他脱下美洲虎武士护甲，换上一件华丽的长袍，你猜那是他从蒙特苏马的衣橱里顺来的。你和他一同来到宴会厅，与精心挑选的几位城中最高阶贵族共进晚餐，享用了很久以来最好的一顿饭。

failures.source: The chieftain-turned-emperor signals his servants, and they bring out four large chests full to the rim with gold and jade and valuable gems and pearls. Your people gasp with delight and there is much clapping and cheering from all around the feast hall.
failures.translation: 这位从酋长变成皇帝的人向仆人示意，他们便抬出四口大箱子，里面装满了金币、玉、珍贵宝石和珍珠。你的人欣喜地惊叹起来，宴会厅各处响起阵阵掌声和欢呼声。

failures.source: You have played an instrumental role in resolving the conflict between the Aztec empire and the Totonac people. Your troops are markedly tired, not just from the night's feast, but from everything they have seen and done. It might be time to return to your ship and sail back to Spain.
failures.translation: 你在化解阿兹特克帝国与托托纳克人之间的冲突中发挥了关键作用。你的部队明显疲惫不堪，这不仅是因为昨夜的宴席，也因为他们所见所为的一切。或许是时候回到船上，启航返回西班牙了。

failures.source: Tepictoton gets up and follows you and a handful of your troops into the garden, far out of earshot of the feast. A few guards are milling about, and they move to the edges of the garden as you enter with the new Emperor.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿起身，跟着你和几名部下走进花园，远离宴席的喧闹声。几名卫兵正在附近徘徊；你和新皇帝进入花园时，他们便移步到花园边缘。

failures.source: "After all we've been through, after all you /did/ for me, you would turn around and drive a knife into my back?! On the very eve of our victory, you would snatch the freedom of my people away with an honourless betrayal?!"
failures.translation: “经历了这么多事，你为我/做了那么多/，你竟然还要反过来捅我一刀？！就在我们即将胜利的前夜，你竟要用这卑劣的背叛夺走我族人的自由？！”

failures.source: Tepictoton is dead, the reign he had dreamt of for so long having only lasted an evening. Unable to participate in your betrayal, his daughter Anacaona has joined him in the afterlife. The halls of the palace are quiet save for distant sounds of the last guests leaving the feast that was held in your honour.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿死了，他梦寐以求的统治只持续了一个晚上。他的女儿阿纳卡奥娜无法参与这场背叛，如今也已随他去了来世。宫殿的大厅一片寂静，只有远处的宾客陆续离开那场为你举办的宴会时，才传来些许声响。

failures.source: Tepictoton is dead, the reign he had dreamt of for so long having only lasted an evening. The halls of the palace are quiet save for distant sounds of the last guests leaving the feast that was held in your honour.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿死了，他梦寐以求的统治只持续了一个晚上。宫殿的大厅一片寂静，只有远处的宾客陆续离开那场为你举办的宴会时，才传来些许声响。

failures.source: "A perfectly executed plan, PNameFirst. I am honoured that I could be here beside you in the end, to aid in the conquest of the Aztec empire. Much remains to be done, I'm sure - though the really hard work has been done, the city is unlikely to surrender all at once. We must bring in our troops from your fortress garrison and secure our power here."
failures.translation: “计划执行得天衣无缝。能在最后关头陪在你身边，助你征服阿兹特克帝国，我深感荣幸。接下来还有许多事要做，我想你也清楚——最艰难的部分虽已完成，但这座城不太可能立刻就投降。我们必须调来堡垒驻军，巩固我们在此地的势力。”

failures.source: "That is boring work though, and you are a PManWoman of action, aren't you? I think your troops would not object if you wish to return to Spain and bring word of our deeds here to the King. This kind of shrewd victory, and if you even bring a substantial amoung of treasure with you, I dare say that will leave quite an impression on the court!"
failures.translation: “不过那活儿可无聊得很，而你是个行动派，对吧？如果你想回西班牙向国王报告我们的功绩，我想你的士兵不会反对。如此漂亮的一场胜利，要是你还能带回一大笔财宝，我敢说宫廷上下都会印象深刻！”

failures.source: "Good luck with your work here, Capitán Noriega."
failures.translation: “诺列加船长，祝你在这里诸事顺利。”

failures.source: "And you with yours, whatever you choose to do next... Capitán PNameLast!"
failures.translation: “你也一样。祝你接下来一切顺利……船长PNameLast！”

failures.source: "It is done. From what we have seen of the Aztec society, it is a very hierarchical system, and we have just severed the head. It will take a lot of work to secure and maintain our position here, but we can leave that to our countrymen."
failures.translation: “事情办妥了。从我们对阿兹特克社会的了解来看，这是一个等级森严的体系，而我们刚刚砍掉了它的首脑。要在这里站稳脚跟并维持势力，还得费不少工夫，不过可以交给我们的同胞去办。”

failures.source: "Capitán, if I may speak freely... we've achieved something great here, but it might be time to return to the Maria Teresa and sail home. If we bring the king a taste of the treasure that awaits Spain here, and word of our incredible deeds, we will be the talk of the court."
failures.translation: “船长，恕我直言……我们成就了一番大业，但也许该回到玛丽亚·特蕾莎号，启航返乡了。只要带些财宝回去，让国王看看西班牙在此地能得到什么，再讲讲我们的丰功伟绩，我们就会成为宫廷里的风云人物。”

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回家向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就返回船上扬帆起航。

failures.source: Your assassination attempt thwarted, the broken bodies of you and your troops are collected by Tepictoton's servants and taken to the Great Temple where you are incarcerated for the night. Next morning, before a cheering crowd, Tepictoton watches while each of your expedition members are decapitated one by one atop the steps of the pyramid.
failures.translation: 刺杀未遂，你和士兵们伤痕累累，被特皮克托顿的仆人抬到大神庙，关押了一夜。第二天清晨，在欢呼的人群面前，特皮克托顿看着你的每一名远征队员被逐一押上金字塔台阶斩首。

failures.source: The guards warn Moctezuma of your arrival, and rather than cower behind them, he steps forward, flanked by his High General Quappiatl, and strikes an imperial pose. He is clad in the garb of an Eagle Warrior beneath a Spanish steel beastplate.
failures.translation: 卫兵向蒙特苏马报告你已到来。他没有躲在他们身后，而是走上前来，身旁簇拥着他的最高将领夸皮亚特尔，摆出帝王的架势。他身穿西班牙钢制胸甲，里面则是鹰战士的装束。

failures.source: "Do your troops even know what they fight for? My people fight to defend their homes, to protect their families, their children from death and violation! We have /everything/ to lose, and /that/ will drive us to victory!"
failures.translation: “你的士兵知道自己为何而战吗？我的族人为了保卫家园、保护家人和孩子免遭杀戮与凌辱而战！我们/一无所有/可失，/这/将驱使我们走向胜利！”

failures.source: "I am the true and rightful ruler of the Aztec! My Empire is the heir to a thousand years of great empires preceding us. How dare you come here from your own world and toy with the fates of hundreds of thousands of people? How /dare/ you interfere?!"
failures.translation: “我才是阿兹特克人真正且合法的统治者！我的帝国继承了前代伟大帝国千年积累的基业。你们来自自己的世界，竟敢来到这里，摆弄数十万人的命运？你们竟敢插手？！”

failures.source: "I am here to /kill/ you, not to chat. Defend yourself!"
failures.translation: “我来是/杀/你的，不是来聊天的。自卫吧！”

failures.source: You are knee deep in the blood of the Aztecs. Quappiatl is dead. Moctezuma is lying among the flowers, spluttering blood, mumbling incomprehensibly to himself while butterflies idly flutter over his head. He reaches weakly out towards the colourful insects, but they evade his touch.
failures.translation: 你已深陷在阿兹特克人的血泊中。夸皮亚特尔死了。蒙特苏马躺在花丛间，咳着血，嘴里含糊不清地喃喃自语，蝴蝶在他头顶悠闲地飞舞。他虚弱地伸手去够那些色彩斑斓的昆虫，它们却躲开了他的触碰。

failures.source: "So many lives lost. I cannot decide if we should celebrate our victory or mourn our losses. The city is ravaged, and we are honour-bound to help in its restoration, but that will take /months/. I'm sorry... I should not burden you with my regrets in your hour of victory. Tonight, I will throw a feast in your honour, here in the palace. It will be an occasion for reconciliation."
failures.translation: “死了这么多人。我不知道该庆祝胜利，还是哀悼我们的损失。城里满目疮痍，按道义我们有责任帮助重建，但这需要/数月/。抱歉……在你凯旋之际，我不该让你听这些懊悔的话。今晚，我会在宫殿里设宴款待你。这也将成为和解的契机。”

failures.source: As you're leaving the palace, you are intercepted by a Spaniard whose uniform identifies him as a Scout under the command of Noriega.
failures.translation: 你正要离开宫殿时，一名西班牙人拦住了你。他的制服表明他是诺列加麾下的一名侦察兵。

failures.source: "Your grace, Capitán Noriega has sent me to relay a message. He requests your presence the city's Great Temple at your earliest convenience.
failures.translation: “阁下，队长诺列加派我来传话。他请您尽早前往城里的大神庙一叙。”

failures.source: "Capitán, now that the war is over, there is something we ought to discuss. We have a very short window of opportunity here, and I think we should make use of it. Perhaps we should regroup in the Great Temple and discuss our next move?"
failures.translation: “队长，如今战争已经结束，有件事我们该谈谈。眼下机会稍纵即逝，我觉得我们应该好好把握。或许我们该在大神庙集合，商量下一步行动？”

failures.source: Tepictoton is dead. Your people are scattered, broken. Moctezuma resumes command of his warriors and takes back the palace, then he drives the remains of the Totonac army from the city. When the Emperor returns to the palace, a pair of his Eagle Warriors help you to your feet but tie your hands behind your back.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿死了。你的部下四散溃败。蒙特苏马重新指挥他的战士，夺回宫殿，随后将托托纳克军队的残部赶出城去。皇帝回到宫殿后，两名鹰武士扶你站起来，却又把你的双手反绑在身后。

failures.source: Your people are scattered and broken. Moctezuma resumes command of his warriors, takes back the palace, and kills Tepictoton. Then he drives the remains of the Totonac army from the city. When the Emperor returns to the palace, a pair of his Eagle Warriors help you to your feet but tie your hands behind your back.
failures.translation: 你的部下四散溃败。蒙特苏马重新指挥他的战士，夺回宫殿并杀死特皮克托顿，随后将托托纳克军队的残部赶出城去。皇帝回到宫殿后，两名鹰武士扶你站起来，却又把你的双手反绑在身后。

failures.source: You gather your men and, with the aid of a few of your braver servants, you bring them out through the city to the relative safety of your caravan. Here you can rest and lick your wounds while you watch the black smoke billowing calmly from the burning homes of Tenochtitlan. The victory cheers of the Aztecs can be heard all across Lake Texcoco.
failures.translation: 你召集部下，在几名勇敢仆从的帮助下，带他们穿过城市，回到相对安全的车队营地。在那里，你可以休息养伤，同时看着黑烟从特诺奇蒂特兰燃烧的房屋中袅袅升起。阿兹特克人的胜利欢呼声响彻特斯科科湖四周。

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回家向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历后，就回到船上启航吧。

failures.source: "Perhaps we should go home, Capitán. Perhaps this is where we cut our losses, take what we have, and go back to Spain. As long as we bring back enough treasure, I think the King might regard our expedition as a success."
failures.translation: “队长，或许我们该回家了。也许就该到此为止，止住损失，带上现有的一切回西班牙。只要带回足够多的财宝，我想国王会认为这次远征取得了成功。”

failures.source: Moctezuma's palace has been turned into a makeshift fortress, a purpose it was clearly not designed for. Behind the barricades, among the scattered bodies of Aztec warriors, stands FNameLast. The jaguar warriors you gave FHimHer control over are rifling through the belongings of the fallen Aztecs.
failures.translation: 蒙特苏马的宫殿被改造成了一座临时堡垒，显然这根本不是它原本的用途。路障后方，散落着阿兹特克战士的尸体，FNameLast就站在那里。你交由FHimHer指挥的美洲虎武士，正在翻找阵亡阿兹特克人的财物。

failures.source: "Of course we were! Are you ready to move on?"
failures.translation: “当然赢了！准备继续前进了吗？”

failures.source: You clear the palace's chambers of all resistance to make sure nobody can catch you in the back. Once you sound the all clear, a group of Totonac warriors move in to secure the entrance so you can prepare to face Moctezuma. Among the dead and wounded bodies filling the opulent halls, you find Coyotl sprawled on the floor, bleeding from several mortal injuries. He looks up at you and blinks.
failures.translation: 你清除了宫殿各个厅室里的所有抵抗者，以免有人从背后偷袭。你确认安全后，一队托托纳克战士进来守住入口，好让你准备迎战蒙特苏马。华丽的大厅里满是死者和伤者，你发现科约特尔倒在地上，身上几处致命伤口正汩汩流血。他抬头看着你，眨了眨眼。

failures.source: FName volunteers to scout out the area and sneaks around to the side of the building, which FHeShe scales elegantly to climb in through a window. When FHeShe returns, it is with good news and bad news both.
failures.translation: FName主动请缨侦察周围，悄悄绕到建筑侧面，FHeShe身手优雅地攀上墙，从窗户爬了进去。FHeShe回来时，带来了好消息，也带来了坏消息。

failures.source: FName volunteers to scout out the area and sneaks around to the side of the building, which FHeShe scales elegantly to climb in through a window. When FHeShe returns, it is with bad news.
failures.translation: FName主动请缨侦察周围，悄悄绕到建筑侧面，FHeShe身手优雅地攀上墙，从窗户爬了进去。FHeShe回来时，带来了坏消息。

failures.source: The four guards exchange guilty looks as they accept your bribe, quickly and suspiciously seizing the chest of gold that your servants bring forth and then disappearing down the steps of the palace and into the city. Though you have removed a not inconsiderable portion of the resistance you ought to have faced, the palace is far from unguarded, however.
failures.translation: 四名卫兵彼此交换着心虚的眼神，收下了贿赂。他们迅速而鬼祟地接过仆人抬来的金箱，随后消失在宫殿台阶下，混入城中。尽管你因此扫清了本该面对的一大部分抵抗，宫殿却远未到毫无守卫的地步。

failures.source: Rather than simply fighting your way to the garden, you clear the palace's chambers of all resistance to make sure nobody can catch you in the back. Once you sound the all clear, a group of Totonac warriors move in to secure the entrance so you can prepare to face Moctezuma.
failures.translation: 你没有只顾着一路杀到花园，而是肃清宫殿各个房间里的抵抗，以免有人从背后偷袭。你发出安全信号后，一队托托纳克战士进来守住入口，让你可以准备迎战蒙特苏马。

failures.source: "Then my warriors and I will guard the entrance while you deal with the Emperor. He has nowhere to go, so make sure you are prepared before we strike."
failures.translation: “那我和我的战士会守住入口，你们去对付皇帝。他已无路可逃，所以出击前务必做好准备。”

failures.source: The battle is over as quickly as it started. Your troops are crushed and driven from the palace by the Imperial guards. Once you are eliminated as a threat, Moctezuma is secure in his palace, and from here he can get the Aztec army back under control and direct it to crush the Totonac invaders.
failures.translation: 战斗开始得快，结束得也快。你的部队被帝国卫兵击溃，赶出了宫殿。你不再构成威胁后，蒙特苏马便能安稳地待在宫殿里，重新控制阿兹特克军队，并指挥他们击溃托托纳克入侵者。

failures.source: From out here, you have a clear view as the surviving Totonac warriors flee the city as a steady stream. The cheers of the Aztec defenders can be heard far outside the city. Tepictoton is dead, Moctezuma remains the ruler of these lands, and the oppression of the Totonac peoples will go on, ultimately because your people could not fulfil the role they had been afforded.
failures.translation: 从这里望去，你清楚地看见幸存的托托纳克战士络绎不绝地逃离城市。阿兹特克守军的欢呼声传到了城外很远的地方。特皮克托顿已死，蒙特苏马仍是这片土地的统治者，托托纳克人将继续受其压迫。归根结底，是你的人没能承担起赋予他们的使命。

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回国向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就回到船上启航。

failures.source: The Emperor signals his servants, and they bring out four large chests full to the rim with gold and jade and valuable gems and pearls. Your people gasp with delight and there is much clapping and cheering from all around the feast hall.
failures.translation: 皇帝向仆人示意，他们便抬出四只大箱子，里面装满了黄金、玉石、珍贵宝石和珍珠。你的人欣喜地惊呼起来，盛宴大厅里掌声和欢呼声此起彼伏。

failures.source: When everybody is drunk and full from the splendid feast and it's getting late, you thank the emperor many times for his hospitality and graciousness and retire to your own quarters along with your troops.
failures.translation: 所有人都喝得酩酊大醉，吃饱了丰盛的盛宴，天色也渐晚。你再三感谢皇帝的款待与慷慨，随后和部下一同回到各自的住处休息。

failures.source: You have played an instrumental role in resolving the conflict between the Aztec empire and the Totonac people. Your troops are markedly tired, not just from the night's feast, but from everything they have seen and done. It might be time to return to your ship and sail back to Spain.
failures.translation: 你在阿兹特克帝国与托托纳克人之间的冲突中发挥了关键作用。你的部队显然已疲惫不堪，不仅因为昨晚的宴席，更因为他们一路以来的所见所为。或许是时候回到船上，启航返回西班牙了。

failures.source: Moctezuma gets up and follows you and a handful of your troops into the garden, far out of earshot of the feast. A few guards are milling about, and they move to the edges of the garden as you enter with the Emperor.
failures.translation: 蒙特苏马起身，跟着你和几名部下走进花园，远离宴席，听不到那边的声音。几名卫兵在四周徘徊；皇帝与你一进来，他们便移到花园边缘。

failures.source: "I've been waiting on this moment for a long time. How long have you been giving me orders, sending me on errands, made me do your dirty work? To Hell with the gold, /this/ is my reward for that indignity!"
failures.translation: “我等这一刻已经很久了。你对我呼来喝去、派我跑腿、让我替你干脏活，到底有多久了？去他的黄金，/这/就是我对那份屈辱的回报！”

failures.source: "It is done. From what we have seen of the Aztec society, it is a very hierarchical system, and we have just severed the head. It will take a lot of work to secure and maintain our position here, but we can leave that to our countrymen."
failures.translation: “一切都结束了。从我们对阿兹特克社会的了解来看，这是个等级森严的体系，而我们刚刚斩断了它的首级。要巩固并维持我们在这里的地位，还得花不少工夫，不过这些可以交给我们的同胞处理。”

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回国向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就回到船上启航。

failures.source: Inside the palace, chaos reigns supreme. The Emperor's personal guard of elite Eagle Warriors is fending off multiple groups of Totonac invaders, and the sounds of battle echo throughout the palace halls. You make your way along a less direct path towards the garden where you first met Moctezuma.
failures.translation: 宫殿里一片混乱。皇帝的精锐贴身卫队鹰武士正抵挡着多股托托纳克人入侵者，战斗声在宫殿的长廊间回荡。你绕远路前往花园，那里是你初次与蒙特苏马会面的地方。

failures.source: Though your people must dispatch a few attackers, you make it to the garden unscathed. The Emperor is fortified inside, decked out like an Eagle Warrior and strapped into a Spanish steel breastplate. He is protected by a small group of his personal guards who let you enter on his orders. Your people quickly set about preparing the garden for an attack while you address Moctezuma.
failures.translation: 你的人不得不击退几名袭击者，但你最终毫发无伤地抵达花园。皇帝全副武装地待在里面，身着鹰武士的装束，胸前还穿着西班牙钢制胸甲。一小队贴身卫兵奉他的命令护送你入内。你的人很快着手准备花园的防御，而你上前与蒙特苏马交谈。

failures.source: "The enemy has yet to reach this garden, they seem to be searching my personal quarters and the feast halls first. It can't be long until they realise where we are."
failures.translation: “敌人还没到这座花园。他们似乎先在搜查我的寝宫和宴会厅。用不了多久，他们就会发现我们在这里。”

failures.source: "This is hardly the time to discuss such matters! Of /course/ you will be generously rewarded for your help, rest assured of that!"
failures.translation: “现在根本不是谈这种事的时候！当然会重重酬谢你们的帮助，这点尽管放心！”

failures.source: "Why don't you ask your friend PNameFirst here how come PHeShe crossed the great sea just to prop up an old empire and aid it in repressing its own people?! You think PHeShe'll just jump right back on PHisHer ship and go home when this war is over?!"
failures.translation: “你何不问问PNameFirst，PHeShe为何远渡重洋，只为扶持一个衰老的帝国、助它压迫自己的子民？！你以为这场战争结束后，PHeShe就会立刻跳回PHisHer船上，打道回府吗？！”

failures.source: "What does a small girl understand about the motivations of her elders. If you have the nerve to back your words up with actions, I suggest you make your move now, before I strike you down myself!"
failures.translation: “一个小姑娘懂什么长辈的用意？若你有胆用行动证明自己的话，我劝你现在就动手，免得我亲自将你击倒！”

failures.source: "Your people fight to overthrow a proud and prosperous society that has brought stability and peace to this land! Before the Aztec empire, there was /chaos/, and you wish to reinstitute that chaos. The Aztec people will never serve you, and the results of your actions will be nothing but war, from now until the end of time."
failures.translation: “你们要推翻一个自豪而繁荣的社会，一个为这片土地带来稳定与和平的社会！阿兹特克帝国建立之前，这里/只有混乱/，而你们想让混乱重现。阿兹特克人绝不会侍奉你们，你们的所作所为只会带来战争，从现在一直延续到永恒。”

failures.source: "You deserve more than just gold for your aid. There should be fanfares, parades, week-long celebrations. My people are in no shape to celebrate this victory. It will take time to restore the city to its real glory. All I can offer you is a substantial gift from my treasury, and a feast tonight in your honour, here in my palace."
failures.translation: "你们的援助值得更多回报，绝不只是金币。理应有号角齐鸣、盛大游行和持续一周的庆典。可我的人民如今无力庆祝这场胜利。要让城市重现昔日荣光，还需要时间。我能给你们的，只有国库里一份丰厚的赠礼，以及今晚在我的宫殿里为你们设下的一场宴席。"

failures.source: "Your grace, Capitán Noriega has sent me to relay a message. He requests your presence the city's Great Temple at your earliest convenience.
failures.translation: "阁下，诺列加队长派我来传话。他希望您方便时尽早前往城中的大神庙。"

failures.source: "Capitán, now that the war is over, there is something we ought to discuss. We have a very short window of opportunity here, and I think we should make use of it. Perhaps we should regroup in the Great Temple and discuss our next move?"
failures.translation: "队长，战争既已结束，我们有件事该谈谈。眼下机会稍纵即逝，我觉得应该好好把握。也许我们该在大神庙会合，商量下一步行动？"

failures.source: When you are ready to go home and recount the tale of your expedition to King Carlos, return to your ship and cast off.
failures.translation: 准备好回家向卡洛斯国王讲述远征经历时，就回到船上启航。

failures.source: You arrive at Tenochtitlan just before noon. Last evening as you made camp, you could see the smoke from a hundred campfires on the horizon. Cautiously approaching the great city, you find it besieged by thousands of Totonac warriors and their multifarious tribal allies.
failures.translation: 你在中午前不久抵达特诺奇蒂特兰。昨晚扎营时，你看见地平线上有上百处营火升起的烟柱。你小心翼翼地靠近这座大城，却发现它正遭到数千名托托纳克战士及形形色色的部族盟军围攻。

failures.source: You are forced to take a long way around and sneak into the city in commandeered canoes. The defenders of Tenochtitlan are so on edge they almost riddle you with arrows as you land on the shores of the island. When you've checked that everybody made it across safely, you hurry through the city to Moctezuma's palace.
failures.translation: 你们被迫绕远路，乘征用来的独木舟潜入城中。特诺奇蒂特兰的守军紧张到了极点，你们刚在岛岸登陆，他们几乎就要用箭把你们射成刺猬。确认所有人都安全渡岸后，你们赶忙穿城前往蒙特苏马的宫殿。

failures.source: "I will position my forces to defend one of the causeways. You will defend the other. We send a group out of the city to bait the attack, then we withdraw them and make our stand."
failures.translation: "我会部署兵力防守一条堤道，另一条由你来守。我们派一队人马出城引敌人上钩，再把他们撤回来，守住阵地。"

failures.source: "Precisely what I was proposing, PName! I will direct the defence of the second causeway myself!"
failures.translation: "这正是我提议的方案，PName！第二条堤道就由我亲自指挥防守！"

failures.source: "The Tlaxcalteca army has been identified among the enemy. No doubt the Totonac negotiated some secret deal with them after their plot against me was foiled by you. Tlaxcala has caused us much trouble in the past, and their presence here does not bode well for us."
failures.translation: "敌军中发现了特拉斯卡拉军队。毫无疑问，托托纳克人在针对我的阴谋被你挫败后，与他们达成了什么秘密交易。特拉斯卡拉过去给我们惹了不少麻烦，他们出现在这里，对我们可不是好兆头。"

failures.source: "The Tlaxcalteca army has been identified among the enemy. No doubt they are here to avenge the deaths of their diplomatic representatives in the Toltec Temple. Tlaxcala has caused us much trouble in the past, and their presence here does not bode well for us."
failures.translation: "敌军中发现了特拉斯卡拉军队。毫无疑问，他们是来为死在托尔特克神庙的外交使节报仇的。特拉斯卡拉过去给我们惹了不少麻烦，他们出现在这里，对我们可不是好兆头。"

failures.source: "Our greatest problem is Tepictoton - he remains in control of the Totonac, and though he has come here without the warriors of Xalapa or Papantla, the tribes fight ferociously and are well organised under his leadership. Would that you had killed Tepictoton when you had the chance."
failures.translation: “我们最大的麻烦是特皮克托顿——他仍控制着托托纳克人。尽管他来此时没有哈拉帕或帕潘特拉的战士相随，那些部族仍在他的领导下骁勇作战、组织严密。真希望你当初有机会时就杀了特皮克托顿。”

failures.source: Take your troops to the main Causeway into Tenochtitlan and provoke the Totonac army to attack.
failures.translation: 率领你的部队前往通往特诺奇蒂特兰的主堤道，挑衅托托纳克军队发动攻击。

failures.source: For once, Quappiatl actually /is/ in the palace even though you have nothing in particular to report, but he's not there to see you - he's tied down with strategising for the upcoming battle of Tenochtitlan.
failures.translation: 难得夸皮亚特尔这回确实/在/宫殿里，尽管你没什么特别的事要汇报；不过他不是来见你的——他正忙着筹划即将到来的特诺奇蒂特兰之战。

failures.source: The general trips over the spear of an Eagle Warrior and stumbles forward, but he quickly regains his balance, spins around, bounds back towards the guard, and punches the unexpecting man directly in the face.
failures.translation: 将军被一名鹰武士的长矛绊倒，踉跄向前，但很快稳住身形，转身冲回那名守卫身边，一拳正中这个猝不及防的人的脸。

failures.source: "Your pacification of Xalapa didn't have quite the effect that we had hoped. The Totonac are assembling in the east to move against us."
failures.translation: “你平定哈拉帕的行动，并未达到我们期望的效果。托托纳克人正在东面集结，准备向我们进军。”

failures.source: Quappiatl wipes sweat from his forehead. Behind him, the offending Eagle Warrior is trying to stop his nose bleeding.
failures.translation: 夸皮亚特尔擦去额头上的汗水。他身后，那名惹祸的鹰武士正试图止住鼻血。

failures.source: "Even without the armies of Xalapa and Papantla, Tepictoton has enough support among the scattered tribes of the Totonac that he remains a threat. Though their numbers are fewer than they would be without your efforts, they appear undeterred!"
failures.translation: “即便没有哈拉帕和帕潘特拉的军队，特皮克托顿在托托纳克各部族中仍有足够的支持，依然是个威胁。虽然他们的人数比没有你出手时少了，但似乎并未因此退缩！”

failures.source: "Their plans with our treacherous nobles were foiled, but it appears they had another secret meeting with Totonac representatives, which was more successful."
failures.translation: “他们与我们那些叛徒贵族的计划被挫败了，但看来他们又与托托纳克代表秘密会面了一次，而且这次谈得更顺利。”

failures.source: "PName's attack on their meeting with our treacherous nobles only gave them more reason to join the Totonac and fight against us. To make matters even worse, they apparently had another secret meeting with Totonac representatives, which was more successful."
failures.translation: “PName袭击了他们与我们那些叛徒贵族的会面，反而给了他们更多理由加入托托纳克人、与我们为敌。更糟的是，他们显然又与托托纳克代表秘密会面了一次，而且这次谈得更顺利。”

failures.source: "It would appear that our attempts to stop their secret meeting with our treacherous nobles drove them into the arms of the enemy. PName's attack only gave them more reason to join the Totonac and fight against us."
failures.translation: “看来我们试图阻止他们与叛徒贵族秘密会面的举动，反倒把他们推向了敌人。PName的袭击只会让他们更有理由加入托托纳克人、与我们为敌。”

failures.source: Return to your fortress and prepare your people to defend against an attack by the Totonac rebels.
failures.translation: 返回你的堡垒，准备好人手，抵御托托纳克叛军的进攻。

failures.source: "I've been told the reconstructed stronghold is an impressive sight, I'm sure it will strike awe into the hearts of anyone who dares to stand against us. It's time to see Emperor Moctezuma. Come, follow me."
failures.translation: “我听说重建后的要塞景象壮观，相信任何胆敢与我们为敌的人都会心生敬畏。该去见蒙特苏马皇帝了。来，跟我走。”

failures.source: You return to the palace, but Quappiatl is not there. His servants inform you that he is out on official business, but he will take you to see Moctezuma again when he receives word that the fortress has been restored.
failures.translation: 你回到宫殿，却发现夸皮亚特尔不在。他的仆人告诉你，他正在外处理公务；等他得知堡垒已经修复，就会再带你去见蒙特苏马。

failures.source: Rebuild the Spanish fortress north-west of Tenochtitlan and return to the palace to speak to Moctezuma when the reconstruction is complete.
failures.translation: 重建特诺奇蒂特兰西北方的西班牙堡垒，完工后返回宫殿与蒙特苏马交谈。

failures.source: "Welcome back, honoured PName. Reports of your success in Papantla preceed you here. Your reward is being prepared, but more difficult conquests await you, and the Great Moctezuma requests that you meet him in the feast hall. He will explain the next stage of our collaboration in person."
failures.translation: “欢迎回来，尊贵的PName。你在帕潘特拉的捷报已传到这里。你的奖赏正在准备，不过还有更艰难的征服等着你。伟大的蒙特苏马请你到宴会厅与他会面，他会亲自说明我们合作的下一阶段。”

failures.source: "He has been inciting all of the Totonac tribes to attack our scouts and our warriors."
failures.translation: “他一直煽动所有托托纳克部族袭击我们的斥候和战士。”

failures.source: Travel to Xalapa to the north and decide how to deal with Tepictoton and his budding Totonac insurrection. Quappiatl has sent a division of warriors to help you in the event of a battle.
failures.translation: 前往北方的哈拉帕，决定如何处置特皮克托顿及其正在酝酿的托托纳克叛乱。如有战斗，夸皮亚特尔已派出一支战士队伍前来助你。

failures.source: "I understand your concerns. Tlaxcala may ally with the Totonac, and we will face greater resistance. But this empire did not achieve greatness by bowing down to our inferiors. Tlaxcala will never be made to bow their heads to Moctezuma without a fight, and we will not tolerate them to exist as an independent state within our borders."
failures.translation: “我理解你的顾虑。特拉斯卡拉或许会与托托纳克人结盟，我们将面临更大的抵抗。但这个帝国的伟业并非靠向下等人低头成就。特拉斯卡拉绝不会不经战斗就向蒙特苏马俯首，我们也不会容许他们在我国疆界内作为独立国家存在。”

failures.source: Quappiatl waves his hand in the general direction of Citlalli, who's minding her own business with the rest of your people in the far end of the room.
failures.translation: 夸皮亚特尔朝房间另一头比划了一下，示意西特拉利。她正和你的其他同伴待在那边，自顾自地做着自己的事。

failures.source: Quappiatl waves his hand in the general direction of Coyotl, who's minding his own business with the rest of your people in the far end of the room.
failures.translation: 夸皮亚特尔朝房间另一头的科约特尔比划了一下。科约特尔正和你的其他同伴待在那边，自顾自地做着自己的事。

failures.source: "Such trivial matters rarely reach my ears. We do not take insubordination lightly, especially not from an Eagle Warrior. However, we might have let it pass if he had not also stolen from an influential merchant inside the very borders of our city."
failures.translation: “这种小事很少传到我耳中。我们绝不轻视违抗命令，尤其是来自鹰武士的违抗。不过，要不是他还在本城疆界内偷了一个有影响力的商人的东西，我们或许就睁一只眼闭一只眼了。”

failures.source: "An escalation of our ongoing conflict with the Totonac is inevitable. Soon, we will strike at Xalapa. With that stubborn fool Tepictoton out of the picture, the Totonac will be deprived of strong leadership, and we will be free to move on their capital, Cempoala."
failures.translation: “我们与托托纳克人的冲突必然会升级。很快，我们就要进攻哈拉帕。除掉那个顽固的蠢货特皮克托顿后，托托纳克人将群龙无首，我们也就能进军他们的首都森波阿拉。”

failures.source: "Before we can move directly against Xalapa, however, we have an opportunity to weaken Tepictoton's position without provoking an immediate response. The town of Papantla belongs to the Totonac, but if /you/ take it, that will not be enough to unify the Totonac leadership against us."
failures.translation: “不过，在我们直接进攻哈拉帕之前，有机会先削弱特皮克托顿的势力，又不至于立刻引来反击。帕潘特拉镇属于托托纳克人，但即使/you/攻下那里，也不足以让托托纳克各方团结起来对付我们。”

failures.source: "The royal guard informs me that you have brought three carts full of food with you back from Cuautitlán. I take it they were agreeable in your dealings with them?"
failures.translation: “王室卫队告诉我，你们从夸乌蒂特兰带回了三车粮食。看来你们和他们谈得很顺利？”

failures.source: "It would please the Emperor greatly if /unknown forces/ acting /alone/ were to show up at this secret meeting and... for example... take the lives of everyone involved!"
failures.translation: “若有一股/不明势力/独自前往这场秘密会面……比如说，把所有参与者都杀掉！皇帝一定会非常高兴！”

failures.source: "The royal guard informs me that you have returned emptyhanded from Cuautitlán. How can this be?"
failures.translation: “王室卫队告诉我，你们从夸乌蒂特兰空手而归。怎么会这样？”

failures.source: Quappiatl sighs harder still, and waves his hand.
failures.translation: 夸皮亚特尔又深深叹了口气，挥了挥手。

failures.source: "In fact a more important matter /has/ come up that may provide a better chance to improve our empire's trust in you."
failures.translation: “其实眼下有件更重要的事，或许能更好地增进帝国对你的信任。”

failures.source: You put on your best humble manners, and after half an hour of compliments and grovelling, you're granted entrance to the palace of Tenochtitlan to speak to the wise men of the city. Your Scholars quickly find common ground with the Aztec wise men and eagerly trade knowledge.
failures.translation: 你摆出最谦恭的姿态，奉承逢迎了半个小时后，终于获准进入特诺奇蒂特兰宫殿，拜见城中的智者。你的学者很快与阿兹特克智者们谈得投机，热切地交换起知识来。

failures.source: You order your servants to bring forth a small chest of treasures from your caravan and present it to Moctezuma as a gift. Moctezuma looks over the spoils with a pleased expression and in turn gets his servants to bring out several chests of medicinal herbs from palace storerooms. The Aztec emperor himself further presents you with a gold disc and a silver disc that you recognise as the calendar of the Aztecs.
failures.translation: 你命仆人从商队中取出一只装满珍宝的小箱，献给蒙特苏马作为礼物。蒙特苏马满意地端详着这些战利品，随后也让仆人从宫殿的储藏室取出几箱药草回赠。阿兹特克皇帝本人还送给你一金一银两块圆盘，你认出那是阿兹特克人的历法。

failures.source: You order your servants to bring forth a lockbox of treasures from your caravan and present it to Moctezuma as a gift. Moctezuma looks over the spoils with a pleased expression and in turn gets his servants to bring out a set of finely crafted weapons from his personal collection. The Aztec emperor himself further presents you with a gold disc and a silver disc that you recognise as the calendar of the Aztecs.
failures.translation: 你命仆人从商队中取出一只装满珍宝的小匣，献给蒙特苏马作为礼物。蒙特苏马满意地端详着这些战利品，随后也让仆人从自己的收藏中取出一套精工打造的武器回赠。阿兹特克皇帝本人还送给你一金一银两块圆盘，你认出那是阿兹特克人的历法。

failures.source: You order your servants to bring forth a lockbox of treasures from your caravan and present it to Moctezuma as a gift. Moctezuma looks over the spoils with a pleased expression and in turn gets his servants to bring out a chest full of gold and jewelry from his personal collection. The Aztec emperor himself further presents you with a gold disc and a silver disc that you recognise as the calendar of the Aztecs.
failures.translation: 你命仆人从商队中取出一只装满珍宝的小匣，献给蒙特苏马作为礼物。蒙特苏马满意地端详着这些战利品，随后也让仆人从自己的收藏中取出一箱金币和珠宝回赠。阿兹特克皇帝本人还送给你一金一银两块圆盘，你认出那是阿兹特克人的历法。

failures.source: You order a few of your servants to step forth and present them to Moctezuma as a gift. Moctezuma looks over your people with a pleased expression, and with a subtle gesture signals his guards to tie their hands and bring them into the palace chambers where they will presumably be prepared for sacrifice to the Aztec gods.
failures.translation: 你命几名仆人上前，将他们作为礼物献给蒙特苏马。蒙特苏马满意地打量着你的人，随后暗中示意卫兵捆住他们的双手，将他们带进宫殿的房间，想必是要准备献祭给阿兹特克诸神。

failures.source: A disgusted murmer passes through the ranks of your people as they realise that you've just given Spanish citizens up as slaves to heathen natives, but you quickly silence the dissent. In return for your gift, the Aztec emperor presents you with a gold disc and a silver disc that you recognise as the calendar of the Aztecs.
failures.translation: 得知你竟把西班牙公民送给异教原住民为奴，你的队伍中顿时响起一阵愤怒的低语，但你很快压下了不满。作为回礼，阿兹特克皇帝送给你一金一银两块圆盘，你认出那是阿兹特克人的历法。

failures.source: The Aztec High General displays the amusement of a man who has burst into a dark and unfamiliar room only to find himself at home.
failures.translation: 这位阿兹特克高级将军露出一丝笑意，仿佛一个人闯进陌生黑暗的房间，却发现自己其实回到了家中。

failures.source: "What can I do to aid our Aztec allies?"
failures.translation: “我能为阿兹特克盟友做些什么？”

failures.source: "To the west lies an Aztec settlement called Cuautitlán. They have neglected to send regular shipments of food to Tenochtitlan. The people of Tenochtitlan depend on these shipments from the outlying farming communites to survive. Cuautitlán is part of the heart of our empire, and if we move against them militarily, it could have undesirable political repercussions."
failures.translation: “西边有一处名叫夸乌蒂特兰的阿兹特克定居点，他们一直没有按时向特诺奇蒂特兰运送粮食。特诺奇蒂特兰的民众依靠周边农耕村落运来的粮食维生。夸乌蒂特兰位于帝国腹地，若我们动用武力对付他们，恐怕会引发不利的政治后果。”

failures.source: "Tepictoton will hold a feast in our honour tonight."
failures.translation: “今晚特皮克托顿会设宴款待我们。”

failures.source: "Then that is when we should strike. You have a whole batallón of Spanish soldiers waiting outside the city. If we can get Tepictoton away from the majority of his guards during the feast, we can easily dispose of him, and your troops can move in and seize the city in the ensuing chaos. Then Tenochtitlan will be ours, and we can bring this entire region under the control of Spain!"
failures.translation: “那就是我们动手的时机。城外有一整营西班牙士兵等候着。若能趁宴席期间让特皮克托顿远离大部分卫兵，我们就能轻易除掉他，你的部队也可趁乱攻入并夺取城市。到那时，特诺奇蒂特兰就是我们的了，整个地区也将归西班牙掌控！”

failures.source: "Capitán, as I'm sure you can tell, the Totonac dominion over Tenochtitlan is delicate for now. Tepictoton considers you a friend, and he's going to throw some sort of feast for you. We have a whole batallón of Spanish soldiers waiting outside the city. If you aim to turn on Tepictoton and bring these lands under Spanish dominion, now is the time to strike."
failures.translation: “队长，你肯定也看得出来，托托纳克人如今对特诺奇蒂特兰的统治并不稳固。特皮克托顿视你为朋友，今晚还要设宴款待你。城外有一整营西班牙士兵等候着。若你打算背叛特皮克托顿，让这些土地归西班牙统治，现在正是动手的时机。”

failures.source: "I'm relieved to see you made it through the fighting in one piece, PNameFirst. It seems like the Aztec are back in control of this city, but as I had hoped, their position is greatly weakened. Tell me, are they planning any sort of celebration for you?"
failures.translation: “很高兴看到你平安度过了战斗，PNameFirst。看来阿兹特克人重新控制了这座城市，不过正如我所希望的，他们的势力已经大大削弱。告诉我，他们打算为你举办什么庆祝活动吗？”

failures.source: "Moctezuma will hold a feast in our honour tonight."
failures.translation: “蒙特苏马今晚会设宴款待我们。”

failures.source: "Then that is when we should strike. You have a whole batallón of Spanish soldiers waiting outside the city. If we can get Moctezuma away from the majority of his guards during the feast, we can easily dispose of him, and your troops can move in and seize the city in the ensuing chaos. Then Tenochtitlan will be ours, and we can bring this entire region under the control of Spain!"
failures.translation: “那我们就该趁这个时候动手。城外有整整一个营的西班牙士兵等着你。只要能在盛宴期间让蒙特苏马远离大多数卫兵，我们就能轻易除掉他，你的部队也能趁乱进城夺取控制权。到时候特诺奇蒂特兰就是我们的了，我们还能让整个地区都归西班牙统治！”

failures.source: "Capitán, as I'm sure you can tell, the Aztec position has been greatly weakened by the war. You have Moctezuma's trust, and he's going to throw some sort of feast for you. We have a whole batallón of Spanish soldiers waiting outside the city. If you aim to overthrow the Emperor and bring these lands under Spanish dominion, now is the time to strike."
failures.translation: “队长，你肯定也看得出来，阿兹特克人的势力在战争中已大大削弱。蒙特苏马信任你，而且他要为你设宴。城外有整整一个营的西班牙士兵等着你。若你打算推翻皇帝，让这些土地归西班牙统治，现在就是动手的时机。”

failures.source: "I recognise this talisman! I am certain that she would not have given it to you willingly. You have done /all/ of Tenochtitlan a great service by killing her. As a token of our gratitude, I will have my servants bestow upon you an amount of medicinal mixtures and some treasure from the temple vaults."
failures.translation: “我认得这枚护符！我敢肯定，她绝不会自愿把它交给你。你杀了她，/全/特诺奇蒂特兰都因此受益匪浅。为表谢意，我会让仆人给你一些药剂，再从神殿宝库中取些宝物赠予你。”

failures.source: Momoztli sends you away for a few hours while his servants prepare a feast in gratitude of your service. You order your men to conceal knives about their person before you all show up at the feast hall to partake in the celebrations.
failures.translation: 莫莫兹特利让你先离开几小时，同时命仆人准备宴席，感谢你的相助。你命手下把刀藏在身上，然后一行人前往宴会厅，参加庆祝活动。

failures.source: Half-way through the dinner, you sense an opportunity when most of the Aztec guests are showing distinct signs of intoxication, and the guards are about to change shifts - you must strike now, before the guards retire, so that all witnesses may be eliminated.
failures.translation: 晚餐过半时，大多数阿兹特克宾客都已明显醉酒，卫兵也即将换班，你察觉到机会来了——必须趁卫兵退下前立刻动手，把所有目击者都灭口。

failures.source: In a flash, your men produce their knives and quickly dispatch the Aztec priesthood. The enemy guards are completely taken aback, and by the time they engage your people, the deed is already done. Even though the guards are well armed, your people kill them all with only the concealable weapons they brought.
failures.translation: 转眼间，你的手下拔出刀来，迅速解决了阿兹特克祭司。敌方卫兵完全猝不及防；等他们与手下交上手时，一切已经结束。尽管卫兵装备精良，你的人仅凭带来的隐蔽武器便将他们全部杀死。

failures.source: In a flash, your men produce their knives and quickly dispatch the Aztec priesthood. The enemy guards are completely taken aback, but unfortunately they are well armed, and your people are not quite good enough to hold their own with the concealable weapons they brought.
failures.translation: 转眼间，你的手下拔出刀来，迅速解决了阿兹特克祭司。敌方卫兵完全猝不及防，但不幸的是，他们装备精良，而你的人不够强，无法仅凭带来的隐蔽武器与他们抗衡。

failures.source: "She was the leader of the entire group. Our history with Citlalli and her band of revolutionaries was dark and troubled, and you have done all of Tenochtitlan a great service by killing her. As a token of our gratitude, I will have my servants bestow upon you an amount of medicinal mixtures and some treasure from the temple vaults."
failures.translation: “她是整群人的首领。我们与西特拉利及其革命者团伙的过往阴暗而曲折。你杀了她，为整个特诺奇蒂特兰立下大功。为表谢意，我会让仆人送给你一些药剂，以及神殿宝库里的财宝。”

failures.source: The Aztec priests are honoured by your devotion to The Feathered Serpent Quetzalcoatl, but they have plenty of slaves to sacrifice for no cost at all. They gracefully decline your offer.
failures.translation: 阿兹特克祭司敬佩你对羽蛇神克察尔科亚特尔的虔诚，但他们有的是奴隶，献祭也分文不花。他们婉言谢绝了你的提议。

failures.source: While one of the subordinate priests strips the FType1 of FHisHer1 clothes and covers FHisHer1 body with blue paint, the head priest goes into some sort of trance to communicate with his gods, chanting the same strange incantation over and over again. FNameLast1 is then taken into the temple by three of the priests, looking increasingly worried about the unfolding situation.
failures.translation: 一名低阶祭司脱去FType1的FHisHer1衣服，用蓝色颜料涂满FHisHer1身体。与此同时，大祭司进入某种恍惚状态，试图与神祇沟通，反复吟唱同一句奇怪的咒语。随后，三名祭司带着FNameLast1进入神殿；看起来，FNameLast1对事态的发展越来越担忧。

failures.source: "The men who preceded you, a few years ago, stormed the great temple of Quetzalcoatl in Cholula and burned the city to the ground, raping the women and murdering the men and the children."
failures.translation: “几年前，走在你们前面来的那些人强闯乔卢拉的羽蛇大神庙，把整座城夷为平地，强暴女人，杀害男人和孩子。”

failures.source: He stares at you for a second. He blinks. Then he lifts his macuahuitl and hurls it angrily into the dirt at his feet. He shouts several aggressive-sounding words into the air that your interpreter refuses to translate. Finally, he sits down on his own doorstep and buries his face in his hands.
failures.translation: 他盯着你看了一会儿，眨了眨眼。随后，他举起马夸维特尔，愤怒地把它掷进脚边的泥土里。他朝空中喊了几句听起来充满敌意的话，你的翻译拒绝替他翻译。最后，他在自家门前坐下，双手捂住了脸。

failures.source: The grizzled and sardonic Coyotl was a distinguished Eagle Warrior of the Aztec until he angered the nobles of Tenochtitlan. Unhappy with their apathy towards the suffering of the commoners, he took matters into his own hands and went against their explicit orders. In doing so, he lost command of his warriors and was forced to leave the city of Texcoco where he had been stationed. Instead, he joined your expedition.
failures.translation: 饱经风霜、言辞讥诮的科约特尔曾是阿兹特克一位杰出的鹰武士，直到他惹恼了特诺奇蒂特兰的贵族。他对贵族漠视平民苦难的态度深感不满，于是亲自采取行动，违抗了他们的明确命令。为此，他失去了战士们的指挥权，不得不离开驻扎之地特斯科科。他最终加入了你的远征队。

failures.source: The region surrounding the lake is so well populated, you probably wouldn't recognise Texcoco as a distinct city if you didn't know that it is - it almost seems like an extension of Tenochtitlan. Thousands upon thousands of people fill its streets, and the crowds part as you move towards the city centre. You feel like a shark swimming through an ocean full of fish.
failures.translation: 湖边一带人口稠密，若不是早知道特斯科科是一座独立的城市，你大概根本不会把它认出来——它几乎像是特诺奇蒂特兰的延伸。成千上万的人挤满街道，人群在你前往市中心时纷纷让开。你感觉自己像一条鲨鱼，游在满是鱼群的海洋里。

failures.source: "I seek an Eagle Warrior called Coyotl."
failures.translation: “我在找一位名叫科约特尔的鹰武士。”

failures.source: A few minutes later, a tall warrior emerges around the corner trailed by five subordinates. He's wearing the costume of the Aztecs' elite Eagle Warriors, but it's clearly seen some heavy use and has been repaired in several places with whatever fabrics were at hand.
failures.translation: 几分钟后，一名高大的战士从拐角处现身，身后跟着五名部下。他穿着阿兹特克精锐鹰武士的服饰，不过显然已经穿了很久，几处地方还用手边找到的布料缝补过。

failures.source: He stops dead in his tracks when he sees you, and frowns. His hands move instinctively to the macuahuitl at his side. He turns and speaks to the warrior from before, but your interpreter hears what he's saying and translates:
failures.translation: 他一看见你便猛地停下，皱起眉头，双手本能地摸向腰侧的马夸维特尔。他转身对先前那名战士说了几句，你的翻译听懂了他的话，并替你翻译道：

failures.source: Coyotl regards you wearily, then he takes another few steps towards you, never letting down his guard.
failures.translation: 科约特尔疲惫地打量着你，随后又朝你走近几步，始终没有放松警惕。

failures.source: "My name is Coyotl, I am the leader of the Aztec warriors in Texcoco."
failures.translation: “我叫科约特尔，是特斯科科阿兹特克战士的首领。”

failures.source: "I expect you have not come to deliver corn and seeds."
failures.translation: “我想你不是来送玉米和种子的。”

failures.source: Coyotl takes you to a compound just outside the centre of the city where he and his people live. They are clearly not temporary accomodations; a military barracks consisting of four buildings in the Aztec style, arranged around a small square. The Eagle Warrior beckons you into the smallest building, which appears to be his home. He sits on the floor at a low table and motions for you to join him. He looks tired.
failures.translation: 科约特尔带你来到城中心外的一处院落，他和族人就住在那里。这显然不是临时住所，而是一座军事营房，由四栋阿兹特克风格的建筑围绕着一片小广场而成。鹰武士招呼你进入最小的那栋，看起来那是他的住处。他在一张矮桌旁席地而坐，示意你坐到他身边。他看起来很疲惫。

failures.source: "Metals. I assume gold, maybe iron for weapons."
failures.translation: “金属。我猜是黄金，也可能有用来做武器的铁。”

failures.source: "It's not a solution, but it would keep them going until this disease blows over. With corn and seeds from Mātlal and the other merchants, we could feed the citizens until they can once again feed themselves."
failures.translation: “这算不上解决办法，但至少能让他们撑到这场瘟疫过去。有了马特拉尔和其他商人提供的玉米与种子，我们就能供养市民，直到他们重新能够自给自足。”

failures.source: "It may take a while for these starving people to get used to military rations, but this will do. I would say one bag of corn and seeds from Mātlal would roughly amount to 5 of these rations. Can you spare 300 of them?"
failures.translation: 这些挨饿的人或许得花些时间才能习惯军粮，不过这东西可以。马特拉尔的一袋玉米和种子，大约能换五份这样的口粮。你能拿出300份吗？

failures.source: Your tremendous generosity earns you strong praise from some of your people, and their vocal celebrations of your selfless act deter any criticism from the rest of your expedition members. Your servants quietly load a huge delivery of rations into a cart and transport it to Coyotl's compound where he and his warriors stand ready to receive it.
failures.translation: 你的慷慨赢得了部分部下的高度赞扬，他们大声称颂你的无私之举，压下了远征队其他成员的批评。你的仆人悄悄把一大批口粮装上马车，运到科约特尔的营地。他和战士们早已等在那里接收。

failures.source: As the autopsy comes to an end, you excuse yourself and wait outside while Patli finishes up. A couple of moments pass by and then Patli steps out from his house, his clothes and arms still slightly bloodied.
failures.translation: 尸检结束后，你告辞到屋外等候，让帕特利收拾一番。过了一会儿，他从屋里出来，衣服和手臂上还沾着些许血迹。

failures.source: You return with Iccauhtli in tow, who is obviously impressed with the buildings and the size of the city. People stop and stare at the spotted man, but he seems oblivious to the attention he's getting, entirely focused on his surroundings. When you enter the plaza, Patli greets you with open arms and a large smile on his face, which - much to your disbelief - becomes even bigger as he spots the patient you've brought along.
failures.translation: 你带着伊卡乌特利一同回来。他显然被这些建筑和城市的规模所震撼。人们停下脚步，盯着这个满身斑点的人看，他却浑然不觉，只顾着打量周围的一切。你们走进广场时，帕特利张开双臂迎上来，脸上笑容灿烂；他看到你带来的病人时，笑容竟又扩大了几分，叫你难以置信。

failures.source: "By the Gods! It's even more amazing than I imagined! Come, my poor friend, let me have a look at you."
failures.translation: “天哪！比我想象的还要惊人！来吧，可怜的朋友，让我看看你。”

failures.source: Patli offers you to wait in the plaza as he leads Iccauhtli to his house. He is gone for a long time, and you and your men wait in the sun. Just as you are about to leave, Patli steps back outside. He hands Iccauhtli a small bag, for which the boy seems very grateful. Patli speaks a few words to the boy, though he is too far away for your translator to make any sense of it.
failures.translation: 帕特利请你在广场等候，自己带着伊卡乌特利去了家中。他去了很久，你和手下们一直在阳光下等着。就在你们准备离开时，帕特利回到屋外，递给伊卡乌特利一个小袋子，男孩看起来十分感激。帕特利对他说了几句话，但他离得太远，你的翻译听不清楚。

failures.source: Finally, Patli gives the boy a small piece of what looks like bark, and Iccauhtli looks awestruck. Patli then turns and walks toward you. Iccauhtli wanders off the way you came, looking intently at whatever Patli gave him, not paying attention to where he's walking.
failures.translation: 最后，帕特利给了男孩一小块看起来像树皮的东西，伊卡乌特利惊得目瞪口呆。帕特利转身朝你走来。伊卡乌特利沿着来路走开，专注地看着帕特利给他的东西，连自己正往哪儿走都没留意。

failures.source: "I've sent the boy home. Don't worry, I gave him some remedies and supplies for the journey. He'll be fine. Before you leave, I want to thank you for bringing him here, unfortunately I don't have much to offer in terms of worldly goods. However..."
failures.translation: “我已经把那孩子送回家了。别担心，我给了他一些药剂和路上用的补给。他会没事的。你们离开前，我想谢谢你把他带来。可惜我没有多少世俗财物能送给你。不过……”

failures.source: Patli breaks out in laughter. His joy is palpable and infectuous and your men can't help but smile, despite whatever prejudice they may harbour. Patli excuses himself for a moment and runs inside his house, before re-emerging shortly after with a bindle slung over his shoulder. You can't help but notice a slight discolouration around the bottom of the bag.
failures.translation: 帕特利放声大笑。他的喜悦感染了众人，手下们也忍不住跟着微笑，尽管他们或许心存偏见。帕特利告辞片刻，跑回屋里，很快便重新出来，肩上挎着一个包袱。你注意到包袱底部有些微微变色。

failures.source: Patli is a bit of a mystery to you. As an Aztec healer from the city of Tenochtitlan, he is a skilled and experienced healer, but he speaks not a word of Spanish and largely keeps to himself during your travels, and most of your people seem perfectly happy with that. When you do interact with him through your interpreters, he is friendly, accomodating, and surprisingly funny.
failures.translation: 帕特利对你来说有些神秘。他是来自特诺奇蒂特兰的阿兹特克治疗师，医术娴熟，经验丰富；但他一句西班牙语也不会说，旅途中也大多独来独往，而你的人似乎对此都很满意。你通过翻译与他交谈时，会发现他友善、随和，而且出奇地风趣。

failures.source: Pretend you didn't hear it and move on.
failures.translation: 假装没听见，继续赶路。

failures.source: Ignore the bag and move on.
failures.translation: 别管袋子，继续赶路。

failures.source: "The same as always! Fever, infections, sore bones, boring! Never anything exciting. I heard of a rumour where an entire village carried spots on their skin, but I have not been able to go there. It sounds fascinating though! Why can't I get some of that my way?"
