failures.translation: “老毛病！发烧、感染、骨头疼，真无聊！从来没有什么新鲜事。我听说有个村子里的人身上都长满了斑点，可我一直没机会去看看。不过听起来真有意思！怎么就不能让我也碰上这种事呢？”

failures.source: "PSenorSenora, I do not think this would be wise. Lord knows what devil-worshipping ritual this heathen will use it for."
failures.translation: “PSenorSenora，我觉得这不明智。天知道这个异教徒会拿它去举行什么崇拜魔鬼的仪式。”

failures.source: "PSenorSenora, I do not think this is a good idea. God only knows what a person with an infectious disease might do to such a populous civilisation as this."
failures.translation: “PSenorSenora，我觉得这不是个好主意。天知道一个身患传染病的人会对这样人口稠密的文明造成什么影响。”

failures.source: Tlālli waves his laughable little stone knife desperately at the FType1, who stops a few steps short of its reach. A few words are exchanged, but you didn't send anybody to translate, and the two don't speak the same language.
failures.translation: 特拉利拼命挥舞着他那把可笑的小石刀，朝FType1砍去；对方在刀刃够不到的几步外停下。两人交谈了几句，但你没派人翻译，而且他们说的不是同一种语言。

failures.source: Frustrated and scared, the young man throws himself at FNameFirst1, by some stroke of luck burying his knife directly between two parts of FHisHer1 armour. Cursing loudly, FNameFirst1 cuts the boy down and stabs him several times extra for good measure.
failures.translation: 年轻人又恼又怕，猛地扑向FNameFirst1，不知怎的竟把刀直接刺进了FHisHer1盔甲的接缝处。FNameFirst1咒骂一声砍倒了男孩，又多捅了几刀，确保他断气。

failures.source: Tlālli waves his laughable little stone knife desperately at the FType1, who stops a few steps short of its reach. A few words are exchanged, but the situation appears to remain tense.
failures.translation: 特拉利拼命挥舞着他那把可笑的小石刀，朝⟪SHH_90bc9c9e0d7_0⟫砍去；对方在刀刃够不到的几步外停下。两人交谈了几句，但局势似乎依旧紧张。

failures.source: For the briefest of moments, the young man lowers his guard, and FNameFirst1 quickly raises FHisHer1 weapon and skewers the young man before he has time to defend himself.
failures.translation: 年轻人有那么一瞬间放松了警惕，FNameFirst1迅速举起FHisHer1武器，在年轻人来不及自卫前将他刺穿。

failures.source: Tlaxcala Tomb
failures.translation: 特拉斯卡拉之墓

failures.source: Cihuātōn is a quiet old woman who prefers to keep to herself on the journey even though she seems to speak a few words of Spanish. The only time she speaks to anybody is to communicate the way to the meeting place.
failures.translation: 西瓦托娜是位沉默寡言的老妇人，旅途中总喜欢独处，尽管她似乎会说几句西班牙语。她只在指明会面地点时才会开口。

failures.source: The Tlaxcalan elder Ēlōxōchitl is waiting inside the central chamber. Astonishingly, he seems to have come here completely alone. Your people spread out to thoroughly check every corner of the dark tomb, and return to report that everything seems clear.
failures.translation: 特拉斯卡拉长老埃洛索奇特正在中央墓室里等候。令人惊讶的是，他似乎完全是独自前来的。你的人散开，仔细检查这座昏暗墓穴的每个角落，回来报告说一切似乎安全。

failures.source: "These are pretty cramped quarters, and that could work in our favour if the meeting comes under attack. The way I see it, we can either assemble everybody in this central room, close to the diplomats, or we can split up and leave a couple of people to fortify the entrance, if you want to trap it or put up some barricades."
failures.translation: “这里实在狭窄，如果会面时遭到袭击，反倒对我们有利。在我看来，我们可以让所有人都聚集在这间中央墓室，靠近外交使节；也可以分出几个人去加固入口——如果你想把入口堵住，或者架起一些路障的话。”

failures.source: You and your people quickly fortify the tomb, and then you allow the meeting to get started. The two elders chat casually at first, but then they get to the heart of the matter and their voices are gradually raised.
failures.translation: 你和手下迅速加固墓穴，然后让会谈开始。两位长老起初只是随意交谈，随后谈到正题，声音也渐渐高了起来。

failures.source: Send a few people to fortify the entrance.
failures.translation: 派几个人去加固入口。

failures.source: You assign a couple of troops to watch the entrance while the rest of your people quickly fortify the tomb, and then you allow the meeting to get started. The two elders chat casually at first, but then they get to the heart of the matter and their voices are gradually raised.
failures.translation: 你安排几名士兵看守入口，其余人迅速加固墓穴，然后让会谈开始。两位长老起初只是随意交谈，随后谈到正题，声音也渐渐高了起来。

failures.source: Just as your people are starting to look bored, a commotion from the narrow corridor makes everyone jump to their feet and draw their weapons. Much to your surprise, you seem to be under attack by five Totonac warriors!
failures.translation: 就在你的人开始感到无聊时，狭窄走廊里传来一阵骚动，所有人都猛地站起身，拔出武器。令你大吃一惊的是，你们似乎遭到了五名托托纳克战士的袭击！

failures.source: For a moment, your people seem unsure of what course of action to take, but then Cihuātōn screams in a broken Spanish that echoes off the walls of the small chamber.
failures.translation: 你的人一时不知该如何行动，西瓦托娜却突然用蹩脚的西班牙语尖声喊道，声音在小墓室的墙壁间回荡。

failures.source: Continue.
failures.translation: 你突然意识到，如果来者是意图破坏哈拉帕与特拉斯卡拉谈判的托托纳克敌对派系，那么只要他们杀死西瓦托娜⟪SHH_150da0b32d0b_0⟫或⟪SHH_150da0b32d0b_1⟫埃洛索奇特，你们的事业就完了。

failures.source: It occurs to you that if this is a rival Totonac faction which has come to spoil the negotiations between Xalapa and Tlaxcala, your cause is lost if they manage to kill either Cihuātōn /or/ Ēlōxōchitl.
failures.translation: 开始战斗。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: Totonac faction, Xalapa, Tlaxcala, Cihuātōn, Ēlōxōchitl

failures.source: After a brief but brutal battle you stand victorious, and both envoys are still alive. You order your people to search the corpses of the fallen enemies, and they retrieve a small amount of valuables and a few pieces of usable equipment.
failures.translation: 继续。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: battle, corpses, valuables, equipment

failures.source: Ēlōxōchitl is understandably more than a little upset at being attacked by the Totonac, but Cihuātōn appears to bring out the full diplomatic arsenal of appeasement, apology, flattery, and veiled threats. Eventually Ēlōxōchitl is convinced that not only did Xalapa not have a hand in this assassination attempt, but you and your troops were specifically sent to prevent precisely such an attack from being successful.
failures.translation: 继续。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: Ēlōxōchitl, Totonac, Cihuātōn, Xalapa, attack

failures.source: Protect The Envoy
failures.translation: 带西瓦托娜回哈拉帕，告诉特皮克托顿会面很成功。

failures.source: Bring Cihuātōn back to Xalapa and inform Tepictoton that the meeting was a success.
failures.translation: 埃洛索奇特离开后，西瓦托娜转向你。

failures.source: After Ēlōxōchitl leaves, Cihuātōn turns to you.
failures.translation: “我们万分感谢你，⟪SHH_4b710f89dc1d_0⟫。要不是你在这里，我现在可能已经没命了。多亏你，特拉斯卡拉同意了结盟条件。我们得回哈拉帕，把发生的事情告诉特皮克托顿。”

failures.source: "Our many thanks, PName. With not you here, I maybe would not be alive now. Thank to you, Tlaxcala agreed terms of alliance. We must return Xalapa and tell Tepictoton of what happened."
failures.translation: 尽管你们竭尽全力，来自森波阿拉的托托纳克战士还是杀死了使节。外交官一死，袭击者显然已经得偿所愿；他们迅速逃出墓穴，散入墓地，在树林间消失无踪。

failures.source: Despite your best efforts, the Totonac warriors from Cempoala manage to kill the envoys. As soon as the diplomats are dead, it's clear that the attackers got what they came for, and they quickly retreat back out of the tomb and scatter across the burial ground, disappearing between the trees.
failures.translation: 继续。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: Totonac, warriors, Cempoala, tomb

failures.source: Protect The Envoy
failures.translation: 回到哈拉帕，告诉特皮克托顿这次会面惨败。

failures.source: Return to Xalapa and inform Tepictoton of the catastrophic outcome of the meeting.
failures.translation: 你只能收拾残局，尽快离开。确认手下安然无恙，也检查了你们的受保护者是否真的死了（遗憾的是，确实如此）后，你们回到了商队。希望特皮克托顿的谈判比你们顺利。

failures.source: It's all you can do to pick up the pieces and get out of there. When you've made sure that your people are all right, and checked to make sure your wards are actually dead (they are, regrettably), you return to your caravan. Hopefully Tepictoton had more luck in his negotiations than you.
failures.translation: 离开。

failures.source: Toltec Temple Ruins
failures.translation: 托尔特克神庙是广阔平原上几座废弃建筑之一。那些宽阔低矮的建筑围成方形，一侧有座规模不大的金字塔，远不及特诺奇蒂特兰的那些宏伟。几名仆人守在牛车旁，车停在金字塔底部的隧道入口前。

failures.source: The Toltec Temple is one of several ruined buildings sitting on a large plain. The large, flat buildings form a square, along one side of which sits a pyramid of modest size compared to the ones in Tenochtitlan. A group of servants are standing around ox-drawn carts in front of a tunnel entrance at the base of the pyramid.
failures.translation: 杀掉仆人。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: Toltec Temple, pyramid, Tenochtitlan, tunnel

failures.source: A handful of your troops rush the gathered servants and kill them all. A commotion from the tunnel tells you that the nobles gathered within are quite aware of what's about to happen.
failures.translation: [战术检定（中等）] 悄悄杀掉仆人。

failures.source: [Check Tactics Medium] Kill the servants sneakily.
failures.translation: 几名士兵绕过建筑，从两侧接近仆人。他们迅速而完美地发动袭击，打了仆人一个措手不及，在他们来得及反应前就将他们刺穿。

failures.source: A handful of your troops sneak around the buildings and approach the servants from either side. In a quick, flawlessly executed attack, they take the servants by surprise and skewer them before they have a chance to react.
failures.translation: 几名士兵试图在神庙两侧找到合适位置，迅速设伏，但仆人发现了他们，惊恐地尖叫起来。你的人大声咒骂着冲上前，很快将他们全部杀死。

failures.source: A handful of your troops attempts to get into a good position for a quick ambush from either side of the temple, but the servants notice them and scream in alarm. Swearing loudly, your people rush them and quickly kill them all.
failures.translation: [战术检定（困难）] 活捉仆人。

failures.source: [Check Tactics Hard] Capture the servants alive.
failures.translation: 几名士兵绕过建筑，从两侧接近仆人。他们迅速而完美地发动袭击，打了仆人一个措手不及：有些人被重击头部打晕，另一些人则被人从背后抓住，用布堵住嘴巴，无法出声。

failures.source: A handful of your troops around the buildings and approach the servants from either side. In a quick, flawlessly executed attack, they take the servants by surprise, knocking some of them out with powerful strikes to the head while others are grabbed from behind and silenced with a cloth in the mouth.
failures.translation: 几名士兵试图在神庙两侧找到合适位置，迅速设伏，但仆人发现了他们，惊恐地尖叫起来。你的人只得大声咒骂着冲上前，将他们全部杀死。

failures.source: "Do not presume to understand the intricacies of Aztec diplomacy!"
failures.translation: “别自以为了解阿兹特克外交的奥妙！”

failures.source: [Check Diplomacy Hard] "I am here for the Aztec traitors. All Tlaxcalteca in the room are free to leave."
failures.translation: [检定：外交（困难）]“我是来找阿兹特克叛徒的。在场的特拉斯卡拉人都可以离开。”

failures.source: [Check Diplomacy Hard] "I am here for the Tlaxcalteca spies. All Aztecs in the room are free to leave."
failures.translation: [检定：外交（困难）]“我是来找特拉斯卡拉间谍的。在场的阿兹特克人都可以离开。”

failures.source: The end of a long rope falls through one of the holes in the ceiling of the temple. A few of your servants peek in from above, waving for you to grab the rope so they can pull you out. You climb out and the rest of your troops quickly follow.
failures.translation: 一根长绳的末端从神殿天花板的一个洞口垂了下来。几名仆役从上方探头出来，挥手示意你抓住绳子，好把你拉上去。你爬了出去，其余队伍也很快跟了上来。

failures.source: The enemies break through your troops and rush up out of the temple where they fight their way through the rest of your people. Your remaining people defend themselves against this unexpected attack, but instead of trying to stop the natives, they run down to the chamber to aid you, carrying your wounded people up to the carts and making sure that nobody is dead.
failures.translation: 敌人突破了你的队伍，冲出神殿，杀穿你剩下的人。剩下的人奋力抵挡这场突如其来的袭击，但他们没有试图阻止原住民，而是跑下去支援你，把伤员抬到马车上，并确保无人丧命。

failures.source: At the exit, you find the corpses of the Tlaxcalteca escorts, but the diplomats are nowhere to be found. Your people explain that the escorts sacrificed their lives to buy the diplomats time, and they managed to escape.
failures.translation: 出口处有特拉斯卡拉护卫的尸体，却不见外交官的踪影。你的人解释说，护卫牺牲性命为外交官争取了时间，他们成功逃走了。

failures.source: At the exit, you find the corpses of the Aztec escorts, but the nobles are nowhere to be found. Your people explain that the escorts sacrificed their lives to buy the nobles time, and they managed to escape.
failures.translation: 出口处有阿兹特克护卫的尸体，却不见贵族的踪影。你的人解释说，护卫牺牲性命为贵族争取了时间，他们成功逃走了。

failures.source: "There! Look! It's that kid from the village, he's got the idol! Bloody /stop/ him, for God's sake!"
failures.translation: “在那里！看！是村子里的那个孩子，他拿着神像！该死的/stop/住他，看在上帝的份上！”

failures.source: Your expedition members rifle through the offerings, picking out a few small gold or jade trinkets that could at least be traded on the local markets. They also uncover a few jars of oil and a plate of herbs that have already been prepared as medicine.
failures.translation: 远征队员翻找着供品，挑出几件小巧的金饰或玉饰，至少还能拿到当地市场上交易。他们还发现了几罐油，以及一盘已经配制成药的草药。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: expedition members, gold, trinkets, oil, medicine

failures.source: As your dealings with them have been fair in the past, the Totonac villagers are happy to trade with you. On the outskirts of the village, a small group of them are making rope to trade with the larger Totonac villages, and they offer to sell to you some if you will buy 5 units at a time.
failures.translation: 你们过去与托托纳克村民交易时一向公平，因此他们很乐意与你们做生意。村庄边缘有一小群人正在编绳子，准备拿去和更大的托托纳克村庄交易。他们提出卖给你一些，但每次至少要买5单位。

failures.source: Find who's in charge.
failures.translation: 找出谁是管事的。

failures.source: "Are you the ruler of this village?"
failures.translation: “你是这个村子的统治者吗？”

failures.source: "Such an amount of treasure would do our village more good than the idol ever has. I'm certain my sister will agree."
failures.translation: “这么多财宝能给我们村庄带来的好处，远胜过那尊神像。我肯定我姐姐也会同意。”

failures.source: "Since you speak so well for yourself, I suppose I will indulge you. We need the treasure more than we need some silly old idol, anyway!"
failures.translation: “既然你这么会为自己说话，那我就满足你吧。反正我们需要财宝，胜过需要什么破旧的神像！”

failures.source: "Since you speak so well for yourself, I suppose I will indulge you. We need the treasure more than we need some silly old idol, anyway!"
failures.translation: “既然你这么会为自己说话，那我就满足你吧。反正我们需要财宝，胜过需要什么破旧的神像！”

failures.source: "The idol is in our holy place, at a pond at the base of a cliff. Go directly north from this village until you see a marker constructed out of stones and spears. Continue west from there, and you will reach the pond."
failures.translation: “神像在我们的圣地，就在悬崖脚下的池塘边。从这个村子径直向北走，直到看到一座由石块和长矛搭成的标记。然后从那里向西走，就能到池塘。”

failures.source: Tlālli nods satisfied, then he and his sister each grab one handle of the big chest you brought them and carry it off back the village.
failures.translation: 特拉利满意地点点头，随后他和姐姐各抓住大箱子的一边提手，把你带来的箱子抬回村里。

failures.source: [Check Scouting Hard] "Spread out and search the village for the idol."
failures.translation: [检定：侦察（困难）]“分头行动，在村子里搜寻神像。”

failures.source: The village craftsmen seem pleased with the trade. They have Int_TotonacVillageRopeStock units of Rope left.
failures.translation: 村里的工匠似乎对这笔交易很满意。他们还剩Int_TotonacVillageRopeStock单位绳索。

failures.source: It seems you've purchased all the rope that the village has to sell. They seem very apologetic, and yet quite pleased with the Valuables they've got out of you.
failures.translation: 看来你已经买光了村里所有的绳索。他们显得很抱歉，却也对从你这里赚到的贵重物品相当满意。

failures.source: "We harbour no hostile intentions. Who is your leader?"
failures.translation: “我们没有敌意。你们的首领是谁？”

failures.source: "Very well. Attack!"
failures.translation: “很好。进攻！”

failures.source: "They're regrouping for a retaliatory strike. Fortify this area!"
failures.translation: “她们正在重新集结，准备反击。加固这片区域的防御！”

failures.source: Following the noise to its source, you find a wounded native lying face-down in a bush, holding his hand over a serious stomach wound. His blood-stained clothing and equipment marks him as a Totonac warrior. As you approach, he turns his head to you and whispers weakly in broken Spanish.
failures.translation: 你循声找到源头，发现一名受伤的原住民面朝下倒在灌木丛中，一只手捂着严重的腹伤。他沾满鲜血的衣服和装备表明他是托托纳克战士。你走近时，他转过头看向你，用蹩脚的西班牙语虚弱地低声说道。

failures.source: You gesture to FNameFirst and FHeShe takes medicine from the cart and hurries over. FNameFirst1 holds FHisHer1 peace, but is looking increasingly frustrated as FHeShe1 watches FNameFirst work. The FType kneels over the warrior and begins to tend to the wound, cleaning it and dressing it as best FHeShe can before returning to you.
failures.translation: 你向FNameFirst示意，FHeShe从马车上取来药品，快步赶来。FNameFirst1保持着FHisHer1平静，但看着FHeShe1忙活时，FNameFirst的神情愈发不耐。FType跪在战士身边，开始照料伤口，尽可能清理并包扎好，然后回到你身边。

failures.source: You gesture to FNameFirst and FHeShe takes medicine from the cart and hurries over. The FType kneels over the warrior and begins to tend to the wound, cleaning it and dressing it as best FHeShe can before returning to you.
failures.translation: 你向FNameFirst示意，FHeShe从马车上取来药品，快步赶来。FType跪在战士身边，开始照料伤口，尽可能清理并包扎好，然后回到你身边。

failures.source: Returning to your caravan on the outskirts of Xalapa, a girl of about 14 or 15 years of age stops you on the road. You recognise her as the young woman who translated the Chieftain Tepictoton's words into flawless Spanish.
failures.translation: 你回到哈拉帕郊外的商队时，一名约莫十四五岁的女孩在路上拦住了你。你认出她就是那位年轻女子，曾将首领特皮克托顿的话译成流利的西班牙语。

failures.source: "How did you learn to speak Spanish so well?"
failures.translation: “你怎么能把西班牙语说得这么好？”

failures.source: "Think about how useful it could be to have me with you I am much better at Spanish than anybody else you'll meet I promise. I can translate for you and I've learned about the Olmec and the Toltec and I can read the old glyphs. And-- and I'm a chieftain's daughter! I'm a diplomatic asset! Right?"
failures.translation: “想想看，带上我能有多大用处。我保证，我的西班牙语比你遇到的任何人都好。我可以给你翻译，还学过奥尔梅克人和托尔特克人，也能读懂古老的象形文字。还有——还有，我是酋长的女儿！我可是外交上的一大助力！对吧？”

failures.source: She turns away and runs back towards the chieftain's house. Your people are staring after her like they can't believe she's for real.
failures.translation: 她转身跑回酋长的住处。你的人望着她的背影，仿佛不敢相信她是认真的。

failures.source: You decide to take a different way out of the village to avoid the Totonac warriors standing watch. No sooner have you lost sight of the village than a ruckus behind you announces the discovery of Anacaona's "abduction". Your expedition is forced to flee the premises with arrows and spears raining down around them.
failures.translation: 你决定从村子的另一条路离开，以避开守在那里的托托纳克战士。你们刚离开村子的视线范围，身后便传来一阵骚动，显然有人发现阿纳卡奥娜被“绑架”了。箭矢和长矛雨点般落在四周，你的远征队只得仓皇逃离。

failures.source: Anacaona seems to calm down a little as you give the order to make sure the survivors will be all right. Not all of them are going to get out of this without some permanent injuries, but once you're ready to leave, you're fairly sure none of them will die.
failures.translation: 你下令确保幸存者安然无恙，阿纳卡奥娜似乎稍稍平静了些。他们之中有人会留下永久伤残，但等你准备离开时，你相当确信不会有人丧命。

failures.source: On your command, your troops check each of the Totonac warriors and finish them off. Anacaona begins to cry, but she's too scared to say anything. When the deed is done, you secure the carts and your expedition moves along.
failures.translation: 你一声令下，部下逐一检查托托纳克战士，并将他们全部杀死。阿纳卡奥娜哭了起来，却吓得不敢说话。事情办妥后，你们收拾好马车，继续启程。

failures.source: The daughter of the Totonac chief Tepictoton, Anacaona is a friendly and adventurous and somewhat hyperactive young girl burdened with a priviledged but bored upbringing. As the daughter of a local chieftain, she is a considerable diplomatic asset, and it helps that her Spanish is impeccable.
failures.translation: 阿纳卡奥娜是托托纳克酋长特皮克托顿的女儿，性情友善、爱冒险，还有些精力过剩。她在优渥却乏味的环境中长大，过得百无聊赖。作为当地酋长的女儿，她在外交上颇有价值，而且她的西班牙语十分地道。

failures.source: Anacaona sits paralysed for a while, but then she snaps out of it and catches up to you. She follows a few steps behind your rear guard, looking fairly out of sorts.
failures.translation: 阿纳卡奥娜僵坐了一会儿，随后回过神来，赶上了你。她落在后卫身后几步远，看起来颇为失魂落魄。

failures.source: Grossly outnumbered, you lead your people on a less than tactical retreat, high-tailing it into the jungle and back to your caravan. You manage to shake your pursuers and hastily prepare your carts for departure before the Totonac warriors are able to pick up the scent again.
failures.translation: 你们寡不敌众，只能进行一场毫无章法的撤退，飞快逃进丛林，返回商队。你设法甩掉了追兵，并赶在托托纳克战士再次循迹追来之前，匆忙准备好马车，启程离开。

failures.source: The daughter of the Totonac chief Tepictoton, Anacaona is a friendly and adventurous and somewhat hyperactive young girl burdened with a priviledged but bored upbringing. As the daughter of a local chieftain, she is a considerable diplomatic asset, and it helps that her Spanish is impeccable.
failures.translation: 阿纳卡奥娜是托托纳克酋长特皮克托顿的女儿，性情友善、爱冒险，还有些精力过剩。她在优渥却乏味的环境中长大，过得百无聊赖。作为当地酋长的女儿，她在外交上颇有价值，而且她的西班牙语十分地道。

failures.source: Xalapa's market is fairly large and seems to be well stocked with a wide variety of goods from the surrounding farmland and other Totonac towns. A group of artisans in the corner are selling items for the trappers, and seem willing to sell to you as well, if you'll pay the price.
failures.translation: 哈拉帕市场颇为宽敞，货品种类繁多，似乎都来自周边农田和其他托托纳克城镇。角落里有一群手艺人在出售捕猎者所需的物品；只要你付得起价钱，他们似乎也愿意卖给你。

failures.source: Xalapa is on high alert. Nobody is allowed in or out of the city with the Aztec division sitting on their outskirts like a hungry hawk eyeing its prey. Imbued with authority by Quappiatl, the decision to mount another attack is yours. The Aztec warriors are ready whenever you are.
failures.translation: 哈拉帕戒备森严。阿兹特克部队驻扎在城外，像饥饿的鹰隼盯着猎物一样虎视眈眈，城里的人一律不许进出。夸皮亚特尔授予你指挥权，再次发动攻击与否由你决定。阿兹特克武士随时待命。

failures.source: Order the attack.
failures.translation: 下令进攻。

failures.source: "Good to see that you have returned safely my friend. You are confident that your fortress will withstand any potential Aztec attack?"
failures.translation: “很高兴你平安归来，我的朋友。你确信你的堡垒能够抵挡阿兹特克人的任何袭击吗？”

failures.source: "That's... not good. I'm sorry to hear that. But it's time to march on Tenochtitlan, our forces are ready for the attack. You'll be with us until the end, I hope?"
failures.translation: “这……可不是什么好消息。听到这事我很难过。不过，是时候向特诺奇蒂特兰进军了，我们的军队已准备好发起进攻。希望你会和我们并肩到最后？”

failures.source: "In fact I arrived at the fortress not long before such an attack took place. We stood our ground and the fortress is safe."
failures.translation: “事实上，那场袭击发生前不久我才抵达堡垒。我们守住了阵地，堡垒安然无恙。”

failures.source: Tepictoton shakes his head. He looks quite distracted.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿摇了摇头。他看起来心不在焉。

failures.source: "What will be our role in the attack, then?"
failures.translation: “那么我们在进攻中担任什么角色？”

failures.source: "With its earthen causeways, Tenochtitlan is dangerously defendable. We will launch a thousand canoes across Lake Texcoco to draw the majority of the Aztec force away from the island. You will lead the first assault across the causeways."
failures.translation: “特诺奇蒂特兰有土筑堤道，易守难攻。我们会派出一千艘独木舟横渡特斯科科湖，把阿兹特克军队主力引离岛上。你将率领先头部队穿越堤道发起突袭。”

failures.source: Clear the Causeway
failures.translation: 肃清堤道

failures.source: "As soon as possible! When you leave here, I will give the word, and my army will march to Tenochtitlan. We will secure the shore of the lake and establish our encampment there so we are ready to attack when you are."
failures.translation: “越快越好！你们离开这里后，我就会下令，我的军队将向特诺奇蒂特兰进军。我们会控制湖岸并在那里扎营，准备好与你们同时发起进攻。”

failures.source: "To you as well - oh, and Capitán PNameLast... /please/ keep my daughter safe!"
failures.translation: “你也一样——哦，还有，卡皮坦PNameLast……/请/照顾好我女儿！”

failures.source: "And to you as well, Capitán!"
failures.translation: “你也一样，卡皮坦！”

failures.source: "Word of your success in Cuautitlán has reached me in advance of your own return. Not a glorious battle to fight, I'll be the first to admit, but you and your people did well nevertheless, and you should feel proud of that. We now control all territory north of Tenochtitlan!"
failures.translation: “你从夸乌蒂特兰传来的捷报比你本人先一步到了我这里。我得承认，这算不上什么荣耀之战，但你和你的部下依然表现出色，应该为此感到自豪。如今特诺奇蒂特兰以北的领土全在我们控制之下！”

failures.source: "Without my presence, my fortress is vulnerable to attack."
failures.translation: “我不在时，我的堡垒很容易遭到袭击。”

failures.source: "I had not thought of that, but you're correct. If an Aztecs division can move up between Cuautitlán, which we hold, and Xalapa, and take your fortress, our west flank is exposed."
failures.translation: “我没想到这一点，但你说得对。要是阿兹特克人的一支部队能从我们控制的夸乌蒂特兰和哈拉帕之间穿过，夺下你的堡垒，我们的西翼就会暴露。”

failures.source: "You must return to your fortress and make preparations to defend it in case the Aztecs attack. They may already be on their way, for all we know. When you are confident that your fortress is prepared, return here. Then we will march on Tenochtitlan."
failures.translation: “你必须回到自己的堡垒，做好准备，以防阿兹特克人来袭。我们也不知道他们会不会已经在路上了。等你确信堡垒已准备就绪，就回来找我。然后我们就向特诺奇蒂特兰进军。”

failures.source: "Very well. When you are confident that your fortress can withstand anything the Aztecs can throw at it, return here. Then we will rally the army and march on Tenochtitlan."
failures.translation: “很好。等你确信堡垒能抵挡阿兹特克人的任何攻势，就回来找我。之后我们会集结军队，向特诺奇蒂特兰进军。”

failures.source: Return to your fortress and prepare your people to defend against an attack by the Aztec Empire.
failures.translation: 回到你的堡垒，做好准备，抵御阿兹特克帝国的进攻。

failures.source: "It has been some time since you last received a reward that has done your invaluable service justice. Our coffers are of course stretched to their limits due to the impending war, but my servants will bring a chest to your caravan full of jewellery, statuettes, and other gold and silver trinkets."
failures.translation: “距你上次收到足以匹配你卓越功绩的奖赏，已经有段时间了。眼下战争迫在眉睫，国库当然也捉襟见肘，不过我的仆人会把一箱珠宝、小雕像以及其他金银饰品送到你的商队。”

failures.source: A little coldly, the palace staff informs you that Tepictoton is in some important meeting or another concerning the impending attack on Tenochtitlan. You are also apparently no longer invited to stay in the palace while you are in the city, though you will be tolerated to set up camp just outside the city limits.
failures.translation: 宫廷侍从有些冷淡地告诉你，特皮克托顿正在参加某个重要会议，商讨即将对特诺奇蒂特兰发动的进攻。看来你也不再受邀留宿宫中，不过他们容许你在城外扎营。

failures.source: With many regrets, the palace staff informs you that Tepictoton is in some important meeting or another concerning the impending attack on Tenochtitlan. As a trusted ally of the Totonac, you are invited to stay in the palace and make use of any of the modest luxuries its staff has on offer.
failures.translation: 宫廷侍从很遗憾地告诉你，特皮克托顿正在参加某个重要会议，商讨即将对特诺奇蒂特兰发动的进攻。作为托托纳克人信赖的盟友，你受邀留宿宫中，并可享用侍从提供的各种朴素便利。

failures.source: "It is finished, the fortress has been restored."
failures.translation: “已经完成了，堡垒修复好了。”

failures.source: "So it was self-defence?"
failures.translation: “所以这是自卫？”

failures.source: "Fine. This is a bad thing for us both, and I believe you. With the warriors of Papantla slaughtered, it's only a matter of time before Moctezuma attempts to subject us to the same fate. We must fortify our position, and then it is time to strike at the Aztecs."
failures.translation: “好吧。这对我们双方都不是好事，不过我相信你。帕潘特拉的战士已经被屠杀殆尽，蒙特苏马迟早会企图让我们也遭受同样的命运。我们必须巩固阵地，然后就该向阿兹特克人开战了。”

failures.source: Rebuild the Spanish fortress west of Xalapa and return to Tepictoton when the reconstruction is complete.
failures.translation: 重建哈拉帕以西的西班牙要塞，完工后回来找特皮克托顿。

failures.source: "Reclaim it and restore it to its former glory. When you return, the Totonac peoples will be ready to go to war. Good luck - to all of us!"
failures.translation: “收复那座要塞，让它重现昔日的荣光。等你回来，托托纳克人就会准备好开战。祝我们大家好运！”

failures.source: "It has come to my attention that you have reclaimed and rebuilt your predecessor's fortress in the west. No love was lost between my people and his, but I must respect the masonry of your people! Not as imposing as the pyramids of our cities, but it cannot be faulted on practical application!"
failures.translation: “我听说你已经收复并重建了你前任在西边的要塞。我族与你前任素无情谊，但我不得不佩服你们的砌石工艺！它不如我们城中金字塔那般雄伟，不过实用性无可挑剔！”

failures.source: "I propose we attack Cuautitlán before we attempt to take Tenochtitlan itself."
failures.translation: “我建议先攻打夸乌蒂特兰，再设法拿下特诺奇蒂特兰。”

failures.source: "My plan is for you to attack Cuautitlán first."
failures.translation: “我的计划是让你们先攻打夸乌蒂特兰。”

failures.source: Tepictoton has returned from his diplomatic tour of the Totonac tribes. He welcomes you back to Xalapa with a smile on his face so big it reaches all the way from his left ear to his right.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿结束了对托托纳克各部族的外交巡访，回到了哈拉帕。他笑容满面地欢迎你回来，嘴角几乎要从左耳咧到右耳。

failures.source: "Do I have some great news for /you/, PName! Although there was a small disagreement with Cempoala, all the Totonac chiefs have agreed to join me against Tenochtitlan! With the combined might of our tribes, and the military aid of Tlaxcala, we now pose the most significant threat to their power that the Aztecs have ever faced!"
failures.translation: “我有个天大的好消息要告诉/你/，PName！虽然和森波阿拉闹了点小矛盾，但所有托托纳克酋长都答应和我联手对抗特诺奇蒂特兰了！如今我们各部族合力，再加上特拉斯卡拉的军事援助，已经成了阿兹特克人有史以来面临的最大威胁！”

failures.source: "Thank the gods you were there to help and protect Cihuātōn. I will have your reward brought to your servants as soon as our business here is concluded."
failures.translation: “感谢诸神保佑你们及时赶来，救助并保护了西瓦顿。等我们这里的事情办妥，我就让人把答谢送到你们仆从手上。”

failures.source: "That's... very bad news. I'm glad you made it out alive, but this means we've lost the support of Tlaxcala. They will know the Totonac were to blame for that attack. How could they follow us into battle after that?"
failures.translation: “这……真是个坏消息。很高兴你们活着回来了，但这意味着我们失去了特拉斯卡拉的支持。他们会知道这次袭击是托托纳克人惹的祸。出了这种事，他们怎么还会跟我们并肩作战？”

failures.source: "Perhaps it's time we move directly against the Aztec."
failures.translation: “也许是时候直接对付阿兹特克人了。”

failures.source: "Not quite yet, my friend. We need time to rally the Totonac armies - there is equipment to be constructed, supply lines to be established, battle plans to be... planned. We can't strike directly against an Aztec settlement until we're ready for war."
failures.translation: “还不行，朋友。我们得花些时间集结托托纳克军队——要打造装备，建立补给线，还得……制定战斗计划。我们得做好开战准备，才能直接攻打阿兹特克人的定居点。”

failures.source: Raze The Farms
failures.translation: 烧毁农场

failures.source: Attack and raze the Aztec farms north of Tenochtitlan.
failures.translation: 攻击并烧毁特诺奇蒂特兰以北的阿兹特克农场。

failures.source: Let the enormous jaguar loose in the city.
failures.translation: 把那只巨大的美洲豹放到城里去。

failures.source: Attack Xalapa.
failures.translation: 袭击哈拉帕。

failures.source: He waves his hand angrily in front of his face.
failures.translation: 他恼怒地在脸前挥了挥手。

failures.source: "When I am attacked, I defend myself."
failures.translation: “别人攻击我，我当然要自卫。”

failures.source: He waves his hand dismissively.
failures.translation: 他不以为意地挥了挥手。

failures.source: "I'm certain she did, seeing how she won't shut up about going on an adventure and seeing the world. If she doesn't want to get married yet, so be it - she hardly had to go and get herself abducted."
failures.translation: “我当然知道。她整天嚷嚷着要去冒险、看看外面的世界。她要是不想现在结婚，那就随她去——可她也没必要把自己弄到被人绑架的地步。”

failures.source: "All right, PName. I yield. For the safety of my daughter, I will seize my involvement with the Totonac rebellion, and I will send no warriors of Xalapa to Tenochtitlan when the attack takes place."
failures.translation: “好吧，PName。我认输。为了我女儿的安全，我会停止参与托托纳克人的叛乱；进攻发生时，我不会派哈拉帕的战士前往特诺奇蒂特兰。”

failures.source: "That's not good enough, you have to stop the attack!"
failures.translation: “这还不够，你必须阻止这场进攻！”

failures.source: Tired, Tepictoton simply shakes his head, waves his hand, and leaves the room to go find his daughter. His champions firmly but politely escort you from the building.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿疲惫地摇摇头，挥了挥手，离开房间去找他的女儿。他的卫士坚决而有礼地将你送出了建筑。

failures.source: "I've changed my mind. ATTACK!"
failures.translation: “我改变主意了。进攻！”

failures.source: Attack Xalapa.
failures.translation: 进攻哈拉帕。

failures.source: Defend yourselves.
failures.translation: 保护好自己。

failures.source: Your people scramble to draw their weapons and withdraw from the palace. Your forces are routed out into the plaza in front of the palace, where you manage to regroup with the Aztec division that Quappiatl has sent to face Tepictoton's elite. During the chaos, Anacaona seems to have disappeared.
failures.translation: 你的人慌忙拔出武器，撤出宫殿。你们被击退到宫殿前的广场上，在那里与夸皮亚特尔派来对付特皮克托顿精锐部队的阿兹特克军队会合。混乱之中，阿纳卡奥娜似乎不见了。

failures.source: Your people scramble to draw their weapons and withdraw from the palace. Your forces are routed out into the plaza in front of the palace, where you manage to regroup with the Aztec division that Quappiatl has sent to face Tepictoton's elite.
failures.translation: 你的人慌忙拔出武器，撤出宫殿。你们被击退到宫殿前的广场上，在那里与夸皮亚特尔派来对付特皮克托顿精锐部队的阿兹特克军队会合。

failures.source: Deciding that a distraction would be a great way to start your attack on Xalapa, you have the giant jaguar brought to the outskirts of the city, and then you open its cage. And run like hell away from the city.
failures.translation: 你觉得用一场调虎离山来打响进攻哈拉帕的第一枪再合适不过，于是让人把那头巨大的美洲虎带到城郊，然后打开了它的笼子。接着你拔腿就跑，拼命逃离城市。

failures.source: As you'd hoped, the jaguar ignores you and heads straight for the much more target-rich environment that is the city centre. Judging from the screams, the crying, and the blood-curdling growls, you seem to have executed one hell of a distraction indeed.
failures.translation: 正如你所料，美洲虎没有理会你，径直冲向目标更多的城市中心。从尖叫声、哭喊声和令人毛骨悚然的咆哮声判断，你显然制造了一场极其成功的混乱。

failures.source: Attack Xalapa.
failures.translation: 进攻哈拉帕。

failures.source: With a large part of Xalapa's defences in utter disarray, desperately attempting to contain the jaguar's rampage, and another part off with Tepictoton on his diplomatic errand, this is perhaps the best possible time you could have chosen to attack the city.
failures.translation: 哈拉帕的大部分守军都乱成一团，正竭力控制美洲虎肆虐造成的混乱；另一部分则跟着特皮克托顿外出执行外交任务。此刻或许正是进攻这座城市的绝佳时机。

failures.source: As you roll into the city centre with a large division of Aztec warriors behind you, you catch a glimpse of a large group of warriors chasing into the jungle after the jaguar. The remaining defenders of the city scramble to counter this new unexpected threat.
failures.translation: 你率领一支阿兹特克武士部队驶入城中心，身后跟着大队人马。你瞥见一大群武士正追着美洲虎冲进丛林。城里剩下的守军慌忙应对这突如其来的威胁。

failures.source: With a large part of Xalapa's defences in utter disarray, desperately attempting to contain the jaguar's rampage, Tepictoton is left with just his personal guard to counter your surprise attack. With a large division of Aztec warriors behind you, your forces meet Tepictoton's in the centre of the city.
failures.translation: 哈拉帕的大部分守军都乱成一团，正竭力控制美洲虎肆虐造成的混乱，特皮克托顿只能靠自己的亲卫抵挡你的突袭。你身后有一支阿兹特克武士部队，你的人马在城中心与特皮克托顿的部队交战。

failures.source: Taking advantage of Tepictoton's absense, you decide to attack Xalapa now, while the Totonac city is without its regular leadership. You rendezvous with a large division of Aztec warriors sent by Quappiatl to aid you, and then you roll into the city.
failures.translation: 趁特皮克托顿不在，你决定立刻进攻哈拉帕，此时这座托托纳克人的城市群龙无首。你与夸皮亚特尔派来助战的一支阿兹特克武士部队会合，随后开进城中。

failures.source: The Aztec forces quickly split up to raze and plunder Xalapa, and many scattered skirmishes break out in the narrow streets as the city's defenders attempt to stop them. With determination, you head straight for the palace where you are met by a small part of Tepictoton's elite, left behind to guard the chieftain's home.
failures.translation: 阿兹特克军队迅速分头行动，焚掠哈拉帕。城里的守军试图阻止他们，狭窄的街道上随即爆发了多场零星战斗。你坚定地直奔宫殿，在那里遇到一小队特皮克托顿的精锐，他们被留下来守卫酋长的住所。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: Aztec, guard, chieftain's home

failures.source: The Aztec forces quickly split up to raze and plunder Xalapa, and many scattered skirmishes break out in the narrow streets as the city's defenders attempt to stop them. With determination, you head straight for the palace where you are met by Tepictoton and his elite guards.
failures.translation: 阿兹特克军队迅速分头行动，焚掠哈拉帕。城里的守军试图阻止他们，狭窄的街道上随即爆发了多场零星战斗。你坚定地直奔宫殿，在那里遇到了特皮克托顿和他的精锐卫队。

failures.source: Tepictoton's personal guards are not to be trifled with, but as long as the Aztecs keep the rest of Xalapa's warriors occupied, your people can handle the elite.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿的亲卫不容小觑，但只要阿兹特克人牵制住哈拉帕其余的武士，你的人就能对付他的精锐部队。

failures.source: Even though Tepictoton wasn't here, you've struck a great blow against the Totonac uprising by removing Xalapa's warriors from the equation.
failures.translation: 尽管特皮克托顿不在城里，你仍通过让哈拉帕的武士退出战局，重创了托托纳克人的起义。

failures.source: Your troops subject the bodies of the fallen guards to a cursory search and return with assorted valuables and a few pieces of useful equipment. Leaving the Aztec contingent to clean up the mess and secure their control of Xalapa, you pass through the burning city and return to your caravan.
failures.translation: 你的部队粗略搜查了阵亡卫兵的尸体，带回一些贵重物品和几件有用的装备。你留下阿兹特克部队收拾残局、巩固对哈拉帕的控制，自己穿过燃烧的城市，返回商队。

failures.source: Tepictoton's personal guards are not to be trifled with, and even though the Aztecs keep the rest of Xalapa's warriors occupied, Tepictoton's elite get the better of your troops.
failures.translation: 特皮克托顿的亲卫不容小觑。尽管阿兹特克人牵制住了哈拉帕其余的武士，特皮克托顿的精锐还是击败了你的人马。

failures.source: Eventually, you meet a small patrol of warriors who request your permission to take you to Xalapa's chieftain, Tepictoton.
failures.translation: 最后，你遇到一小队巡逻武士。他们请求你允许他们带你去见哈拉帕的酋长特皮克托顿。

failures.source: The chieftain stands as you enter, takes one step towards you, and addresses you in what sounds like a somewhat humourous and rather irreverent tone. A young woman next to him translates his words into impeccable Spanish.
failures.translation: 酋长见你进来便起身，向你迈了一步，用一种听起来颇为诙谐又相当不敬的语气开口说话。他身旁一位年轻女子将他的话流利地译成了西班牙语。

failures.source: "Well! Another group of white people has come across the sea, shining like silver statuettes. Don't bother pretending to be gods, my people won't fall for that twice, and I never did!"
failures.translation: “哟！又有一群白人漂洋过海而来，闪闪发亮，像银制的小雕像。别费心装神弄鬼了，我的族人可不会再上第二次当，我从来就没信过！”

failures.source: "You had best address me with respect, old fool! Gods or no, my troops and I can fast make you regret your impudence."
failures.translation: “老糊涂，你最好放尊重点！管他什么神不神的，我和我的部队很快就能让你为这番无礼后悔。”

failures.source: "That kind of tribute is common among the tribes and pales in comparison to what goes on in Tenochtitlan."
failures.translation: “这种贡献在各部族间很常见，特诺奇蒂特兰发生的事比这可怕得多。”

failures.source: You personally set up a net trap in front of the cave, centered over the place where the tracks are most numerous. Then, you place a little meat under the trap for good measure and withdraw to a safe distance.
failures.translation: 你亲自在洞口前布下网陷阱，正对着足迹最密集的地方。随后，你又在陷阱下放了些肉当诱饵，这才退到安全距离外。

failures.source: You personally set up a spike trap in front of the cave, hidden under leaves in the place where the tracks are most numerous. Then, you place a little meat in front of the trap for good measure and withdraw to a safe distance.
failures.translation: 你亲自在洞口前布下尖刺陷阱，用树叶盖住足迹最密集处的陷阱。随后，你又在陷阱前放了些肉当诱饵，这才退到安全距离外。

failures.source: What must be the world's largest jaguar bursts through the cave opening and pounces FNameFirst1, who throws FHimHer1self aside at the last moment, dodging the monster.
failures.translation: 那头想必是世上最大的美洲虎猛然冲出洞口，扑向FNameFirst1。FNameFirst1在最后一刻侧身躲开，避过了怪物的扑击。

failures.source: You quickly direct your people to surround the beast, each of your troops holding one end of a rope. You have a few close calls with the jaguar's mighty paws, but you manage to get into a position where you can spring the trap, catching the enormous animal in a carefully fastened web of ropes.
failures.translation: 你迅速指挥众人包围野兽，每名士兵都握住一根绳索的一端。你几次险些被美洲虎有力的爪子击中，但最终还是找准时机发动陷阱，用精心布置的绳网捆住这头巨兽。

failures.source: You take a moment to admire the quality of the pelt and then it's time to move on.
failures.translation: 你停下来欣赏了一会儿这张毛皮的质地，随后便该继续上路了。

failures.source: Skinning the big cat takes a while as there is a lot of skin, and her carcass emits a particularly unpleasant smell. You take a moment to admire the quality of the pelt and then it's time to move on.
failures.translation: 剥下这头大猫的皮花了些时间，毕竟皮毛面积很大，而她的尸体散发出一股格外难闻的气味。你停下来欣赏了一会儿这张毛皮的质地，随后便该继续上路了。

failures.source: "Your relationship with the Aztec empire isn't the best, so these patrols are best avoided. I've had my run-ins with Aztec patrols in the past, I wouldn't pick a fight with them if I could help it."
failures.translation: “你和阿兹特克帝国的关系不怎么样，所以最好避开这些巡逻队。我以前和阿兹特克巡逻队打过交道；能不跟他们起冲突，我就不会主动挑事。”

failures.source: "Even though your relationship with the Aztec empire is workable, these patrols are best avoided. In the field, this far from Tenochtitlan, the Aztec commanders do as they please, and they are rarely inclined towards peaceful diplomacy."
failures.translation: “虽然你和阿兹特克帝国的关系还过得去，但最好还是避开这些巡逻队。在外征战时，离特诺奇蒂特兰这么远，阿兹特克指挥官都是我行我素，很少愿意和平谈判。”

failures.source: "I understand that you have a working relationship with the Aztec empire, but it might still be wise to avoid patrols like this. Not all Aztec commanders are as reasonable as I, some are barely more than bandits, marauding through the remote villages as they please."
failures.translation: “我知道你和阿兹特克帝国合作得还不错，但或许还是避开这种巡逻队为妙。并非所有阿兹特克指挥官都像我这么讲理；有些人和强盗没什么两样，想怎么劫掠偏远村庄就怎么劫掠。”

failures.source: "Clearly they're already aware of our presence. I think our best option is to attack. Perhaps they're used to people around here fleeing wherever they go, and an aggressive response would take them by surprise."
failures.translation: “显然他们已经发现我们了。我认为最好的办法就是攻击。也许他们早已习惯这里的人见了他们就逃跑，咱们主动出击会让他们措手不及。”

failures.source: "If they're already aware of our presence, which appears to be the case, I think our best option is to attack. Perhaps they're used to people around here fleeing wherever they go, and an aggressive response would take them by surprise."
failures.translation: “他们显然已经发现我们了，我看情况确实如此。最好的办法就是攻击。也许他们早已习惯这里的人见了他们就逃跑，咱们主动出击会让他们措手不及。”

failures.source: The landscape here is uneven and devoid of trees, with large rocks jutting out of the ground. You identify the area where your expedition are most likely to clash with the Aztec patrol if you were to engage them in battle. It's a well suited location for a close engagement, with a maze-like layout of paths navigable between rocks that will disrupt the line of sight for ranged attacks.
failures.translation: 这里地势崎岖，寸草不生，巨石从地面突兀而起。你判断出若与阿兹特克巡逻队交战，远征队最可能发生冲突的区域。这里很适合近距离交战：岩石间的小径交错如迷宫，会阻断远程攻击的视线。

failures.source: The landscape here is uneven and devoid of trees, with large rocks jutting out of the ground. It would make a fine pasture for sheep or cattle, and the locals undoubtedly use it as such. It's hard to say how a battle would unfold in a place like this.
failures.translation: 这里地势崎岖，没有树木，巨石从地面突兀而起。这里倒是很适合放牧羊牛，当地人肯定也这么做。很难说在这样的地方开战会是什么情形。

failures.source: [Check Scouting Medium] Scout out the enemy's ranks.
failures.translation: [检定：侦察（中等）] 侦察敌方队伍。

failures.source: You have killed the Aztec warriors as Calliandra requested. Return to Papantla and show her the trinkets you took from the bodies.
failures.translation: 你已按卡利安德拉的要求杀死了阿兹特克战士。返回帕潘特拉，把从尸体上拿到的小饰物交给她。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: Aztec warriors, Calliandra, trinkets

failures.source: Your troops face off against the Aztec patrol and emerge victorious. Your people quickly rifle through the belongings of your vanquished foes and add their loot to your carts - there's an unusually large amount of valuable trinkets, with a large enough range of artistic expression that you suspect they must have been stolen or raised as taxes from remote villages. You also recover a healthy amount of rations and a pouch of untreated medicinal herbs.
failures.translation: 你的部队与阿兹特克巡逻队交锋并取得胜利。你的人迅速搜刮败敌的财物，把战利品装上马车——其中贵重的小饰物数量异常之多，样式也十分丰富，让你怀疑它们一定是从偏远村庄偷来的，或是作为税赋征收来的。你们还找到不少口粮和一袋未经处理的药草。

failures.source: Your people report movement ahead, and you order your expedition members to form up in a defensive formation. A group of Aztec warriors appear a bit ahead of you moving in single file, dragging a large group of dejected tribals tied to poles connected by ropes. They must be heading towards Tenochtitlan. The slavers eye you suspiciously and change their course to avoid your expedition.
failures.translation: 你的人报告说前方有动静，于是你命令远征队成员列成防御阵型。一群阿兹特克战士出现在前方不远处，排成单列，拖着一大群垂头丧气的部族民。他们被绑在连接着绳索的木杆上，想必正前往特诺奇蒂特兰。奴隶贩子疑心地打量着你们，改变路线以避开远征队。
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: movement, Aztec warriors, tribals

failures.source: *[Check Tactics VeryHard]* Set up a surprise attack.
failures.translation: *[检定：战术（极难）]* 设下埋伏。

failures.source: When the smoke clears, not a single Aztec warrior still stands. The tribal captives mostly consist of women and elders, and they regard your people with blind fear.
failures.translation: 硝烟散尽时，已没有一个阿兹特克战士站着。部族俘虏大多是妇女和老人，他们望着你们的人，眼中满是恐惧。

failures.source: FNameFirst1 looks on in horror as your people systematically murder the tribals, hand clasped over FHisHer1 mouth.
failures.translation: FNameFirst1惊恐地看着你的人有条不紊地屠杀部族民，FHisHer1手捂着嘴。

failures.source: FNameFirst1 shouts out in objection and jumps forward to intervene as your people systematically murder the tribals, but a couple of your other people hold FHimHer1 back.
failures.translation: FNameFirst1出声反对，冲上前想要阻止你的人有条不紊地屠杀部族民，但你手下的另外几个人拦住了FHimHer1。

failures.source: "Who's in charge here?"
failures.translation: “谁是这里管事的？”

failures.source: On their leader's orders, the slavers untie the ropes binding the captives. Then they bow for you and your men and continue down the path they were taking when you encountered them. The tribal captives mostly consist of women and elders, and they regard your people with blind fear.
failures.translation: 奉首领之命，奴隶贩子解开绑住俘虏的绳索。随后他们向你和手下行礼，沿着遇见你们时走的那条路继续前行。部族俘虏大多是妇女和老人，他们望着你们的人，眼中满是恐惧。

failures.source: Your translator shouts a greeting out into the dense swampland behind you. Quite some time passes before tribal warriors step out of the wilderness, covered in war-paint and adorned with jewellery made of bones. They brandish their weapons menacingly.
failures.translation: 你的翻译朝身后浓密的沼泽地喊了一声问候。过了好一阵子，部族战士才从荒野中现身，他们身上涂着战绘，佩戴着用骨头制成的饰物。他们威胁性地挥舞着武器。

failures.source: "Well done, Capitán PNameLast. It is an honour to serve under a PManWoman who will not shed blood if it can be avoided."
failures.translation: “干得好，队长PNameLast。能在避免流血时尽量不动刀兵，这样的队长值得效命。”

failures.source: You allow your troops a few minutes to talk among themselves and calm down before ordering everyone to move out.
failures.translation: 你让部下们自行交谈、平复情绪几分钟，然后才下令全队出发。

failures.source: "Stop your pathetic fawning over these worthless primitives. The only thing we just achieved was to teach them that they can rob their Spanish overlords with impunity. We should have killed them all."
failures.translation: “别再对这些不值一提的蛮夷卑躬屈膝了。我们刚才唯一的成果，就是让他们知道可以肆无忌惮地抢劫他们的西班牙宗主。我们本该把他们全杀了。”

failures.source: "Worthless primitives. The only thing we just achieved was to teach them that they can rob their Spanish overlords with impunity. We should have killed them all."
failures.translation: “不值一提的蛮夷。我们刚才唯一的成果，就是让他们知道可以肆无忌惮地抢劫他们的西班牙宗主。我们本该把他们全杀了。”

failures.source: Your troops breathe a sigh of relief. You allow them a few minutes to talk among themselves and calm down before ordering everyone to move out.
failures.translation: 你的部队松了一口气。你让他们自行交谈、平复情绪几分钟，然后才下令全队出发。

failures.source: Your people form up and attempt to cover all possible angles of attack. Quite some time passes in tense anticipation, then a volley of arrows whistle out of the woods, followed by painted savages screaming a bone-chilling war cry in unison.
failures.translation: 你的人列好阵势，试图防住所有可能的进攻方向。紧张地等待了好一阵后，一阵箭雨从树林中呼啸而出，紧接着，涂着彩绘的野蛮人齐声高喊令人毛骨悚然的战吼。

failures.source: You meet a native on the road. He is in his best years and looks quite strong, but years of work have already chiseled deep lines into his face. He walks with an empty cart which is being dragged by two strong, healthy (delicious-looking) oxen. He stops as you approach and warily wait for your expedition to pass.
failures.translation: 你在路上遇到一名当地人。他正值壮年，看起来颇为强健，但多年的劳作已在他脸上刻下深深的皱纹。他赶着一辆空车，车由两头强壮健硕、看起来很好吃的牛拖着。见你们靠近，他停下来，警惕地等你的远征队经过。

failures.source: "Ohtli, sire."
failures.translation: “我叫奥特利，大人。”

failures.source: "I would like to buy one of your oxen, Ohtli."
failures.translation: “奥特利，我想买你的一头牛。”

failures.source: "Will you sell me both your oxen, Ohtli?"
failures.translation: “奥特利，你愿意把两头牛都卖给我吗？”

failures.source: "Safe travels, Ohtli."
failures.translation: “一路顺风，奥特利。”

failures.source: Your servants bring 200 Valuables from your carts to the farmer, and he gives them the ox in return. The ox is immediately brought to the back of the caravan and slaughtered, its meat added to your stores, while the farmer leaves the way he was going with his remaining ox.
failures.translation: 你的仆人从车上取来200件贵重物品交给农夫，他则把牛交给他们。牛立刻被牵到商队后方宰杀，肉也收入储备。农夫带着剩下的那头牛继续上路。

failures.source: "Pay no attention to FNameFirst1, this is a noble gesture. This poor man /does/ clearly need the treasure more than we, and 300 Valuables is not an unfair price for such a fine, strong ox."
failures.translation: “别理FNameFirst1，这可是善举。这个可怜人显然/确实/比我们更需要财宝，而且300件贵重物品买下这么一头健壮的好牛，价格并不算过分。”

failures.source: Your servants bring 300 Valuables from your carts to the farmer, and he gives them the ox in return. The ox is immediately brought to the back of the caravan and slaughtered, its meat added to your stores, while the ecstatic farmer leaves the way he was going with his remaining ox.
failures.translation: 你的仆人从车上取来300件贵重物品交给农夫，他则把牛交给他们。牛立刻被牵到商队后方宰杀，肉也收入储备。农夫欣喜若狂，带着剩下的那头牛继续上路。

failures.source: "Very well. For 150 Valuables, this ox is yours, my lord."
failures.translation: “好吧，150件贵重物品，这头牛就是您的了，大人。”

failures.source: Your servants bring 150 Valuables from your carts to the farmer, and he gives them the ox in return. The ox is immediately brought to the back of the caravan and slaughtered, its meat added to your stores, while the farmer leaves the way he was going with his remaining ox.
failures.translation: 你的仆人从车上取来150件贵重物品交给农夫，他则把牛交给他们。牛立刻被牵到商队后方宰杀，肉也收入储备。农夫带着剩下的那头牛继续上路。

failures.source: His two oxen are added to your food stores, and as they eye the meat hungrily, your people seem perfectly pleased with how things turned out.
failures.translation: 他的两头牛被收入粮食储备。众人眼馋地盯着牛肉，似乎对事情的结果十分满意。

failures.source: "I can't believe my own eyes! I never thought I'd experience such disgrace as heavily armed Spanish soldiers defeated by a peasant with a butter knife."
failures.translation: “我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！全副武装的西班牙士兵竟被一个拿黄油刀的农民打败，我从没想过会遭此奇耻大辱。”

failures.source: You arrange your troops in the most intimidating formation you can invent and wait until the Mayans are close, then you fire your cannon over their heads. As you'd hoped, they scatter in terror as the blast rolls across the barren rock and echoes between the mountains. You've escaped them this time, but this little trick probably won't work twice.
failures.translation: 你让部队摆出你能想到的最具威慑力的阵形，等玛雅人靠近后，朝他们头顶开了一炮。正如你所料，炮声在荒凉的岩地间滚滚回荡，在群山之间不断反响，吓得他们四散奔逃。这次你们逃过一劫，但这个小把戏恐怕不能再用第二次了。

failures.source: You wait until the Mayans are close, then you fire your cannon over their heads. The blast rolls across the barren rock and echoes between the mountains, and the bandits do appear quite shocked by the noise. Unfortunately they quickly realise that no mythical beast from the Underworld is forthcoming, brandish their weapons, and charge down the hillside towards your ranks.
failures.translation: 你等玛雅人靠近后，朝他们头顶开了一炮。炮声在荒凉的岩地间滚滚回荡，在群山之间不断反响。强盗们显然被这声巨响吓了一跳。可他们很快意识到，根本不会有什么冥界神兽现身，于是亮出武器，沿山坡朝你们的队伍冲来。

failures.source: Return to Tutul Xiu in the village of Masaya and inform him that the bandits will no longer pose a threat.
failures.translation: 回到马萨亚村向图图尔·修报信，告诉他强盗不会再构成威胁。

failures.source: Tribal Raiders
failures.translation: 部落劫掠者

failures.source: Moving through the mountains, your expedition is intercepted by a group of tribal warriors. They look malnourished and poorly equipped, but there's rather a lot of them.
failures.translation: 你们在山间行进时，一群部落战士拦住了远征队。他们看起来营养不良、装备简陋，人数却相当多。

failures.source: *[Check Scouting Easy]* Scout ahead to get an overview of the situation.
failures.translation: *[侦察检定：容易]* 派人前去侦察，了解情况。

failures.source: Your troops do as you say, first discharging their arquebuses towards the enemies, then making as much of an ungodly ruckus as they possibly can. Panicked screams and rustling leaves indicates that your tactic has had the desired effect on most of the savages, and yet a handful of warriors and trappers rush out from the wilderness to throw themselves at you as one might attack a pack of horrifying monsters.
failures.translation: 部队照你说的做了，先朝敌人放了一轮火绳枪，接着拼尽全力制造出震天的声响。惊慌的尖叫声和树叶的沙沙声表明，你们的战术吓住了大多数野蛮人；然而，仍有几名战士和捕猎者从荒野中冲出，像扑向一群可怕的怪物那样朝你们猛扑过来。

failures.source: *[Check Tactics Easy]* Quickly fortify your position.
failures.translation: *[战术检定：容易]* 迅速加固阵地。

failures.source: You deftly direct your troops to prepare for battle, and your FRank1 FNameLast1 helps to ensure that everything is ready by the time the savages are upon you.
failures.translation: 你熟练地指挥部队做好战斗准备，FRank1FNameLast1也帮忙确保一切就绪，赶在野蛮人冲到面前之前完成了准备。

failures.source: *[Check Leadership Medium]* Rally your troops into a tighter formation.
failures.translation: *[领导力检定：中等]* 集结部队，收紧阵形。

failures.source: You bark your orders to the troops with practiced efficiency, and FNameLast1 helps to carry out your directions and get everybody into a tight defensive formantion in almost no time. Almost the very instant your people are ready, the savages charge out from the wilderness.
failures.translation: 你熟练利落地向部队发出命令，FNameLast1协助你执行指令，让所有人迅速组成严密的防御阵形。几乎就在部队刚准备就绪的那一刻，野蛮人便从荒野中冲了出来。

failures.source: Your troops and servants go over the corpses and recover a few bits of usable equipment, some valuable trinkets, and a bit of primitive medicine.
failures.translation: 你的部队和仆役搜查尸体，找到一些还能用的装备、几件值钱的小物件，还有少量原始药物。

failures.source: The battle is over and you are beaten, forced to retreat down the mountain path, struggling to get your wounded troops out of harm's way. Rather than following you, the natives concentrate on your food cart, killing a few servants stubbornly trying to recover it. The warriors loot 2 days worth of rations for 10 men and then disappear back into the mountains.
failures.translation: 战斗结束，你们被打败，只能沿山路撤退，拼命把伤员带离险境。原住民没有追击你们，而是围住了运粮车，杀死了几名执意想把车抢回来的仆役。战士们抢走了够十个人吃两天的口粮，随后消失在群山之间。

failures.source: FName2 folds FHisHer2 arms across FHisHer2 chest.
failures.translation: FName2双臂交叉抱在FHisHer2胸前。

failures.source: You pick a squad of followers and cautiously advance through the swamp. Soon, you see a group of tribals between the trees, ready to face your attack.
failures.translation: 你挑选了一队随从，小心翼翼地穿过沼泽。很快，你看见树丛间有一群部落民，正准备迎击你们。

failures.source: You pick a squad of followers and cautiously advance through the swamp. Soon, you see a group of tribals between the trees, ready to face your attack.
failures.translation: 你挑选了一队随从，小心翼翼地穿过沼泽。很快，你看见树丛间有一群部落民，正准备迎击你们。

failures.source: You order your people to administer basic treatment to the enemies, just enough to ensure their survival. Then you're ready to be on your way.
failures.translation: 你命令手下给敌人做些基础治疗，确保他们能活下来。随后你们准备继续上路。

failures.source: Throughout your travels in this area, you feel like you are being followed. When you eventually catch glimpses between the dense trees of a small temple that looks mostly intact, a group of warriors appears, posing menacingly with their weapons. They look competent but not particularly well equipped.
failures.translation: 你们在这片区域旅行时，总觉得有人跟踪。终于，你透过茂密的树木瞥见一座保存尚好的小神庙，随即一群战士手持武器，摆出威吓的姿态现身。他们看起来训练有素，但装备并不算精良。

failures.source: FName waves FHisHer weapon casually at the defeated enemies.
failures.translation: FName随意地挥舞着FHisHer的武器，指向被打败的敌人。

failures.source: "They tried to kill us, Capitán. It's only fair we try to kill them back. Remember, mercy can be dangerous around these parts."
failures.translation: “他们刚才想杀我们，Capitán。我们以牙还牙也很公平。记住，在这地方仁慈可能会惹来危险。”

failures.source: "They fought well, they don't deserve to be slaughtered like animals. Let them go, Capitán, I think we got the point across."
failures.translation: “他们打得很英勇，不该像牲畜一样遭到屠杀。放他们走吧，Capitán，我想我们已经让他们明白了。”

failures.source: "These are just young men and women fighting to defend their home against strange intruders. And now they're our prisoners of war. We should cut them loose and let them go, they're no threat to us anymore!"
failures.translation: “他们不过是些年轻男女，为了保卫家园而与陌生入侵者作战。现在他们成了我们的战俘。我们该放开他们，让他们离开；他们已经不再对我们构成威胁了！”

failures.source: You suffer defeat at the hands of these guardians of the ruins. Once they have beaten you, they gather their wounded and leave, now completely disinterested in you or the resources in your caravan.
failures.translation: 你败在这些废墟守卫手下。他们打败你们后，收拢伤员离开了，对你和商队里的物资都彻底失去了兴趣。

failures.source: You once again encounter the Totonac hunting party that beat you in combat last time you encountered them. Since they know you as a dangerous aggressor, you will have no choice but to engage them in combat again now that your paths have crossed once more.
failures.translation: 你们再次遇到那支托托纳克狩猎队，上次交手时他们曾击败你们。既然他们已经把你们视作危险的侵略者，这回双方重逢，你们只能再次投入战斗。

failures.source: You once again encounter the Totonac hunting party that you have avoided in the past. Now that they know you for a PManWoman of peace, it should be no trouble to pass them peacefully again, if that is what you wish.
failures.translation: 你们再次遇到那支托托纳克狩猎队，你们过去曾避开他们。如今他们知道你们是PManWoman，想必只要你愿意，再次和平通过也不会有什么麻烦。

failures.source: In a lush valley between two looming mountains, you cross the path of a Totonac hunting party. They are eight - mostly trappers, but with a few warriors among them, and the unmistakeable feathered silhouette of a shaman. They come to a stop as soon as they see you, regarding your group from a safe distance, awaiting your move.
failures.translation: 在两座高耸山峰之间的一片葱郁山谷里，你们迎面撞上了一支托托纳克狩猎队。他们一共八人，大多是捕猎者，其中有几名战士，还有一位身影戴着羽饰、一眼便能认出的萨满。他们一看见你们就停下脚步，隔着安全距离打量着你们，等着看你们如何行动。

failures.source: "They're just savages, and they're in our way. I recommend we pass them with our weapons drawn, and if they try anything, we're well within our rights to defend ourselves."
failures.translation: “他们不过是野蛮人，还挡了我们的路。我建议我们拔出武器从他们身边经过；要是他们敢做什么，我们完全有权自卫。”

failures.source: FName folds FHisHer arms across FHisHer chest.
failures.translation: FName双臂交叠在FHisHer胸前。

failures.source: [Check Tactics Medium] "Prepare to defend this area. We'll fight them on our own terms."
failures.translation: [战术检定（中等）]“做好防守准备。我们按自己的方式和他们交手。”

failures.source: Your people attempt to surreptitiously secure the area without alerting the enemy to your plans, but your grasp of tactics doesn't quite suffice to conceal your motivations, and soon the hunters catch on. They quickly move in to engage you before you have time to get the drop on them.
failures.translation: 你的人试图悄悄控制周围区域，不让敌人察觉你们的计划，但你的战术能力不足以掩饰意图，猎人们很快就察觉了。他们迅速逼近，抢在你们出其不意地袭击之前与你们交战。

failures.source: You order your troops to apply simple aid to the wounded to ensure their survival, but nothing beyond that. They do their best, spending some of your medicine in the process, and it looks like all the Totonac hunters will make it.
failures.translation: 你命令部下为伤者做些简单处理，确保他们能活下来，但也仅此而已。他们尽力救治，期间耗用了一些药品；看来所有托托纳克猎人都能活下来。

failures.source: Judging from their intimate knowledge of the area, this must be the regular hunting grounds of these Totonacs. Perhaps you can return here some other time if you desire a rematch.
failures.translation: 从他们对这一带了如指掌来看，这里一定是这些托托纳克人的常用猎场。若想再较量一次，或许你改天还能回来。

failures.source: Travelling along the road, you encounter a group of Totonac merchants accompanied by a small escort of warriors and trappers. They respond calmly and politely to you, and you see that their donkeys are laden with large crates brimming with food and valuable trinkets.
failures.translation: 你沿路遇到一群托托纳克商人，他们身边跟着几名战士和猎捕者护卫。他们平静而礼貌地回应你。你看见他们的驴子驮着大箱子，里面装满了食物和贵重饰品。

failures.source: Attack them.
failures.translation: 袭击他们。

failures.source: The two merchants are escorted by three Warriors and two Trappers who look very experienced and /very/ well equipped. Their leader is a grizzled woman carrying a macuahuitl with jade spikes who looks like she's ready for any kind of trouble you can throw at her.
failures.translation: 两名商人由三名战士和两名猎捕者护送。他们看起来经验丰富，/装备精良/。他们的首领是个饱经风霜的女人，手持一把嵌有玉刺的马夸维特木棒，看起来已经做好准备，应付你可能惹出的任何麻烦。

failures.source: [Check Tactics Hard] Kill the leader with a surprise attack.
failures.translation: [高难度战术检定] 偷袭首领，将她杀死。

failures.source: You signal for your people to cause a small distraction. A couple of them walk up to the donkeys loaded with the merchants' goods and behave highly suspiciously. The leader of the merchants' escort keep a very close eye on them. Meanwhile you sneak up behind her and run your sword directly through her back. A shocked groan is the only sound that escapes her before she collapses on the ground.
failures.translation: 你示意手下制造一点小小的骚动。几个人走到装着商人货物的驴子旁，举止十分可疑。商人护卫的首领紧紧盯着他们。与此同时，你悄悄绕到她身后，一剑直刺她的后背。她只来得及发出一声惊愕的呻吟，便倒在地上。

failures.source: You try to sneak up on the leader of the merchants' escort, and you manage to get rather close to her, but then she swings around with her weapon raised and pure rage painted in her face. She takes a powerful swing at you, knocking you to the ground, and before you know it the battle rages around you.
failures.translation: 你试图悄悄接近商人护卫的首领，确实靠得相当近，可她突然转过身来，举起武器，脸上满是怒火。她猛力挥击，将你打倒在地。你还没反应过来，周围的战斗已经打响。

failures.source: The natives are scattered and beaten, but still alive. Your people round them up and search them, then they seize the goods from the crates their donkeys were carrying. A few of the beasts ran off during the fighting, but the remaining spoils aren't bad at all.
failures.translation: 当地人四散溃逃，身负重伤，却还活着。你的人把他们聚拢起来搜身，随后夺走驴子驮着的箱中货物。几头牲畜在战斗中跑掉了，不过剩下的战利品仍相当不错。

failures.source: You exhume the buried corpse. There is nothing unusual about the skull.
failures.translation: 你掘出了埋葬的尸体。头骨并无异样。

failures.source: You exhume the buried corpse. The skull is encrusted with gold and studded with crystals.
failures.translation: 你掘出了埋葬的尸体。头骨上镶满金饰，还嵌有水晶。

failures.source: You exhume the buried corpse. The skull of this person is rotted and filled with maggots. It is quite disgusting.
failures.translation: 你掘出了埋葬的尸体。此人的头骨已经腐烂，里面爬满蛆虫，令人作呕。

failures.source: You exhume the buried corpse. The skull is unusually large, with a very large cavity for the brain.
failures.translation: 你掘出了埋葬的尸体。头骨异常巨大，脑腔也大得惊人。

failures.source: You exhume the buried corpse. The skull bears clear signs of trepanning.
failures.translation: 你掘出了埋葬的尸体。头骨上有明显的环锯术痕迹。

failures.source: You exhume the buried corpse. The skull is encrusted with blood and has a faint otherworldly glow about it. The number 13 is etched into the bone.
failures.translation: 你掘出了埋葬的尸体。头骨上沾满鲜血，隐约散发着异界的微光。骨头上刻着数字13。
