failures.source: Burned village hut near the north-west corner of the swamp.
failures.translation: 沼泽西北角附近一间被烧毁的村落小屋。

failures.source: Shaman hut right next to the Toltec Village.
failures.translation: 紧邻托尔特克村的一间萨满小屋。

failures.source: As the morning dawns, you realise with horror that you are stuck. With every single member of your expedition injured, you cannot move on, and you have no medicine left with which to treat your people.
failures.translation: 清晨来临时，你惊恐地意识到自己被困住了。远征队的每一个人都受了伤，你们无法继续前进，而你手头已经没有药品可以治疗大家。

failures.source: "You cannot leave, Capitán. Look around - you are needed here. Without your leadership at this trying time, everything will fall apart. We’ll be done for. No, I must go; it will be a privilege."
failures.translation: “你不能离开，队长。看看四周——这里需要你。眼下这么艰难，没有你的领导，一切都会乱套。我们就完了。不，我必须去；这是我的荣幸。”

failures.source: "PSenorSenorita PNameLast, we have come to your aid! Your selfless FRank1, FNameLast1 came to us in a dreadful condition and begged for our help. I can see that the situation is as dire as FHeShe1 described."
failures.translation: “PSenorSenoritaPNameLast，我们来帮助你们了！你无私的FRank1FNameLast1情况危急地来到我们这里，恳求我们伸出援手。我看这情形确实和FHeShe1描述的一样糟。”

failures.source: "I am sorry, PSenorSenorita, FHeShe1 had completed a gruelling journey, FHeShe1 died of FHisHer1 injuries."
failures.translation: “抱歉，PSenorSenorita，FHeShe1历经艰辛才走完这段路，FHeShe1最终伤重不治。”

failures.source: Noriega's men spread across the camp, unloading a shipment of medicine and medicinal equipment. There are several doctors among them, and they set about aiding your people. They spend the whole night there, and even Noriega is so busy directing the efforts that he has no time to join you in your tent for dinner. The next day, despite looking tired after a long night's work, he and his people set off again towards Santo Domingo, leaving the rest of the medicine with your expedition.
failures.translation: 诺列加的手下散布到营地各处，卸下一批药品和医疗器材。他们中有几名医生，随即开始救治你的队员。他们忙了一整夜，连诺列加也忙着指挥救援，无暇到你的帐篷里与你共进晚餐。第二天，尽管一夜劳作后显得疲惫，他还是带着手下再次启程前往圣多明各，把剩下的药品留给了你的远征队。

failures.source: Six days pass with no news of FName1. It takes everything you've got to keep your people in stable condition, and you understand that if you had left, most of them would probably be dead by now. On the seventh day, a small group of Aztec carefully approach your camp.
failures.translation: 六天过去了，仍没有FName1的消息。你竭尽全力让队员们的病情保持稳定，也明白要是当时离开了，他们大多数现在恐怕都已经死了。第七天，一小群阿兹特克人小心翼翼地接近了营地。

failures.source: "Your emissary perished shortly after FHisHer1 arrival."
failures.translation: “你们的使者抵达后不久便去世了。”

failures.source: Six days pass with no news of FName1. It takes everything you've got to keep your people in stable condition, and you understand that if you had left, most of them would probably be dead by now.
failures.translation: 六天过去了，仍没有FName1的消息。你竭尽全力让队员们的病情保持稳定，也明白要是当时离开了，他们大多数现在恐怕都已经死了。

failures.source: On the seventh day, during your morning patrol, you hear a meak cry for help from the nearby jungle.
failures.translation: 第七天清晨，你巡逻时听见附近丛林里传来一声微弱的呼救。

failures.source: Find and help FHimHer1.
failures.translation: 找到FHimHer1并帮助FHimHer1。

failures.source: You find FNameFirst1 at the bank of a small river, curled up and shivering, covered in mud.
failures.translation: 你在一条小河岸边找到了FNameFirst1。FNameFirst1蜷缩着瑟瑟发抖，浑身是泥。

failures.source: "Somebody has to go back to Santo Domingo for medicine."
failures.translation: “得有人回圣多明各去取药。”

failures.source: "Somebody has to go back to Tenochtitlan for medicine."
failures.translation: “得有人回特诺奇蒂特兰去取药。”

failures.source: Another evening of dissentful murmurings and secretive meetings culminate in a loud argument. FName1 seems to have taken charge of this latest mutiny.
failures.translation: 又一个夜晚，反对的低语和秘密集会最终演变成激烈争吵。FName1似乎主导了这场新近发生的兵变。

failures.source: That evening, the mood around the camp fire is beyond dire. You can hear the dissent and the plotting from your tent, and when you emerge for dinner, the voices die down, but the anger persists in the faces of your people.
failures.translation: 那天晚上，营火旁的气氛糟糕透顶。你在帐篷里就能听见反对声和密谋声；你出来吃晚饭时，声音虽渐渐平息，队员们脸上的怒意却丝毫未消。

failures.source: "So it's mutiny then?"
failures.translation: "所以这是要哗变了？"

failures.source: "We'll give you another chance, but you better turn this ship around soon, or we'll make good on our threats. Next time, there'll be no talking us out of it."
failures.translation: "我们再给你一次机会，但你最好尽快让船改变航向，否则我们就会兑现威胁。下次，谁也别想劝住我们。"

failures.source: "It's been a pleasure serving with you, Capitán - /before/ you brought us to the New World, that is. Come on friends, we'll be better off this way."
failures.translation: "和你共事一直很愉快，队长——当然，是在你把我们带到新大陆之前。朋友们，走吧，这样对大家都好。"

failures.source: "You'll respect me again. Defend yourselves!"
failures.translation: "你们会再次敬重我的。保护好自己！"

failures.source: "I will return to my sisters and lead them as we join the attack on Tenochtitlan."
failures.translation: "我要回到姐妹们身边，带领她们加入进攻特诺奇蒂特兰的队伍。"

failures.source: "I do not seek your permission, I am here as a courtesy, and you will not stop me in this. I hope that we shall not meet on the field of battle, but if we do... glory unto you, PNameFirst."
failures.translation: "我不是来征求你的许可，只是出于礼数告知你。你拦不住我。希望我们不会在战场上相见；若真有那么一天……愿你荣光加身，PNameFirst。"

failures.source: "Yet you have made yourself my enemy through your choice of allies! I hope that we shall not meet on the field of battle, but if we do... glory unto you, PNameFirst."
failures.translation: "可你选择了这样的盟友，已经让自己成了我的敌人！希望我们不会在战场上相见；若真有那么一天……愿你荣光加身，PNameFirst。"

failures.source: "You understand that family comes before anything else. I hope that we shall not meet on the field of battle, but if we do... glory unto you, PNameFirst."
failures.translation: "你明白，家人永远排在第一位。希望我们不会在战场上相见；若真有那么一天……愿你荣光加身，PNameFirst。"

failures.source: "I don't understand you, PNameFirst! Do you /intend/ to hurt me? Gods, we should have had this conversation /weeks/ ago, but I kept fooling myself into thinking we might still be heading in the same direction."
failures.translation: "我真不明白你，PNameFirst！你/是想/伤害我吗？天啊，我们早/几周/前就该谈谈了，可我一直自欺欺人，以为我们也许还在朝着同一个方向前进。"

failures.source: "Please, stay. I couldn't bear to face you in battle!"
failures.translation: "求你留下吧。我无法忍受在战场上与你兵戎相见！"

failures.source: Tears are welling up in Citlalli's eyes, making them glisten like precious gems. She fights to hold them back, but it's a losing battle. Wiping her eyes, she sinks to the ground and sits, clearly unhappy with herself.
failures.translation: 西特拉利眼中泛起泪光，晶莹得如同珍贵的宝石。她竭力忍住泪水，却终究徒劳。她擦擦眼睛，沉沉坐到地上，显然对自己很失望。

failures.source: "I've taught them to handle themselves against Aztec patrols, not against you, or your Spanish metal, or your Spanish tactics, and certainly not against /myself/! I need to be there for them, I /need/ to keep them alive."
failures.translation: "我教她们对付阿兹特克巡逻队，可没教她们对付你、你的西班牙兵器、你的西班牙战术，更没教她们对付/我自己/！我得在她们身边，我/必须/保护她们活下去。"

failures.source: "You earned my gratitude in Texcoco, but I have had many misgivings with your leadership since I joined. I have disagreed with most of your decisions. However, my respect - once earned - is not easily lost, and that is why I have come to tell you that I am leaving to aid in the defence of Tenochtitlan."
failures.translation: "你在特斯科科赢得了我的感激，但自从我加入以来，我对你的领导一直有不少疑虑。我大多数决定都与你意见相左。不过，尊重一旦赢得，便不容易失去。所以我来告诉你，我要离开，去协助防御特诺奇蒂特兰。"

failures.source: "You are warriors, you do not require my protection. The people of Tenochtitlan - the farmers, the artisans - they have far too few champions willing to fight for them. Next time we meet, it will be on opposite sides of a battle. I wish you good luck nevertheless."
failures.translation: "你们都是战士，不需要我的保护。特诺奇蒂特兰的百姓——农民、工匠——他们身边愿意为他们而战的守护者实在太少了。下次相见，我们便会在战场上各为其主。尽管如此，还是祝你们好运。"

failures.source: "I do not seek your permission. I did not have to come here before I left, but I chose to show my respect this way. Next time we meet, it will be on opposite sides of a battle. I wish you good luck nevertheless."
failures.translation: "我不是来征求你的许可的。离开之前，我本不必来这里，但我选择用这种方式表达敬意。下次相见，我们便会在战场上各为其主。尽管如此，还是祝你好运。"

failures.source: "I had transgressed against the nobles, and I paid the price, but the people of Tenochtitlan - the farmers, the artisans - they need my protection. Next time we meet, it will be on opposite sides of a battle. I wish you good luck nevertheless."
failures.translation: "我得罪了贵族，也为此付出了代价。但特诺奇蒂特兰的百姓——农民、手艺人——需要我的保护。下次我们再见面时，便会站在战场的对立两侧。尽管如此，我还是祝你好运。"

failures.source: "From the beginning, I have known you to be a PManWoman of honour. Next time we meet, it will be on opposite sides of a battle. I wish you good luck nevertheless."
failures.translation: "从一开始，我就知道你是个PManWoman有荣誉感的人。下次我们再见面时，便会站在战场的对立两侧。尽管如此，我还是祝你好运。"

failures.source: "A chasm has been growing between us for some time. We have danced around it, like the shamans dance around a bonfire, not daring to touch it. But now our time has run out. You have placed yourself, and those who follow you, at odds with my duty."
failures.translation: "我们之间的鸿沟已经日渐加深了一段时间。我们一直绕着它兜圈子，就像萨满绕着篝火起舞，不敢触碰它。可现在，我们的时间已经耗尽。你选择了自己的立场，也让追随你的人站到了我的职责的对立面。"

failures.source: "From /me/?"
failures.translation: "是我吗？"

failures.source: "I stood with you in the tomb in Tlaxcala. We were only killing Totonac warriors, it was easy for me to justify. I stood with you when you razed the farms that feed Tenochtitlan, and still somehow I managed to convince myself that it might work out between us."
failures.translation: "我曾在特拉斯卡拉的墓穴里与你并肩作战。那时我们只是在杀托托纳克战士，我很容易就能说服自己那样做有道理。你焚毁供养特诺奇蒂特兰的农田时，我也站在你身边；不知怎的，我仍设法说服自己，我们之间或许还能有个好结果。"

failures.source: "Please, stay. My heart will break if I have to face you in battle!"
failures.translation: 求你留下吧。要是我不得不在战场上与你为敌，我的心会碎的！

failures.source: "I have to make a choice, what side to take in this conflict, and I don't know if I can trust my feelings for you. Honour, duty... these are firm, stable concepts. I've lived with them my whole life."
failures.translation: “我必须做出选择，决定在这场冲突中站在哪一边。我不知道自己能不能相信对你的感情。荣誉、职责……这些都是坚定而稳固的信念。我一生都奉行着它们。”

failures.source: "You're a tough FManWoman1. It takes a lot to bounce back from something like that."
failures.translation: “你真坚强。能从那种事情中恢复过来，需要很大的毅力。”

failures.source: "You're a tough FManWoman1. It takes a lot to bounce back from something like that."
failures.translation: “你真坚强。能从那种事情中恢复过来，需要很大的毅力。”

failures.source: You call a couple of servants over to move FNameFirst2 back to the camp, then you and your people set off into the jungle, struggling to track the bootprints of Esteban and his people in the mushy earth.
failures.translation: 你叫来几个仆人，把FNameFirst2抬回营地，随后你带着手下冲进丛林，在泥泞的土地上艰难追踪埃斯特班一伙人的靴印。

failures.source: You put speed above precision and take a few chances along the way, and soon you catch up to Esteban's people - there's half a dozen of them, waiting for you in front of their tents in small clearing where they must have made camp before they attacked you. It's as good a place as any for a showdown.
failures.translation: 你一路求快，不惜冒些险，很快便追上了埃斯特班一伙人。他们有六七个，正等在一片小空地上自己的帐篷前；袭击你之前，他们想必就在这里扎过营。这里正适合做个了断。

failures.source: Esteban says something to his second in command, then his troops begin to move forward across the clearing. Esteban himself vanishes back through the camp into the jungle behind them.
failures.translation: 埃斯特班对他的副手交代了几句，随后他的士兵开始穿过空地向前推进。埃斯特班本人则穿过营地，消失在他们身后的丛林里。

failures.source: "There is only one group on Hispaniola that Esteban Gallego might turn to for help - do you remember the ritual site that we found empty in the mountains along the northern coast? The Caribs that use that site are the only tribe that Esteban could use against us. The Taíno have all been quite hospitable and friendly to us since Columbus first arrived - and easy to conquer. The Caribs have rejected our presence on the island, and have so far eluded our grasp."
failures.translation: “伊斯帕尼奥拉岛上只有一伙人可能会帮助埃斯特班·加列戈——你还记得我们在北海岸山脉里发现的那处空荡荡的祭祀遗址吗？使用那处遗址的加勒比人是埃斯特班唯一能用来对付我们的部族。自从哥伦布初次抵达以来，泰诺人一直对我们十分友善、热情，也很容易征服。加勒比人则拒绝我们留在岛上，至今仍躲过了我们的掌控。”

failures.source: "The Caribs have cruel traditions for cannibalism and human sacrifice. To bring them one of their oppressors as a sacrifice to their pagan gods, well... it will be seen as a powerful gift. They will follow him anywhere after that."
failures.translation: “加勒比人有残酷的食人和活人献祭习俗。要是把他们的一个压迫者献给他们的异教神明……那会被视为一份贵重的礼物。之后他们就会唯他马首是瞻。”
diagnostics: terminology mismatch: human sacrifice, pagan, gods

failures.source: "I love those who follow me and fight beside me like my own brothers and sisters, but don't make the mistake of thinking I won't make whatever sacrifice I must to ensure the freedom of Hispaniola!"
failures.translation: “我爱护追随我、像亲兄弟姐妹一样并肩作战的人，但你别以为我不会为确保伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的自由而作出任何牺牲！”

failures.source: After the ceremony, everyone goes back to their work. FNameFirst1 kneels at the grave and places a wild flower on the mound.
failures.translation: 仪式结束后，大家都回去继续工作。FNameFirst1跪在坟墓旁，把一朵野花放在土堆上。

failures.source: "You passed through my life leaving nothing but ripples in the water."
failures.translation: “你走过我的生命，只留下水面上的涟漪。”
diagnostics: R0012046_d0bbe097e3: terminology mismatch ['ripples in the water']
terminology mismatch: ripples in the water

failures.source: In the evening, FName1 comes to you with a concerned expression on FHisHer1 face.
failures.translation: 傍晚时分，FName1面带忧色地来找你。

failures.source: "It'll keep the region stable and open up many new avenues of trade with Spain."
failures.translation: “这样能维持地区稳定，还能开辟许多与西班牙贸易的新渠道。”

failures.source: A wide smile slowly spreads across FNameFirst1's face as FHeShe1 understands your plan.
failures.translation: FNameFirst1明白你的计划后，脸上渐渐绽开灿烂的笑容。

failures.source: "We will be richly awarded for our help. We will return to Spain with our ship full of gold and jewels."
failures.translation: “我们会因援助而得到丰厚奖赏。回西班牙时，我们的船上将装满黄金和珠宝。”

failures.source: "They're Aztec warriors, eight of them, led by an Eagle Warrior! They must have snuck past our defences in the night. Capitán..."
failures.translation: “是阿兹特克武士，一共八人，由一名鹰武士率领！他们肯定是趁夜偷偷越过了我们的防线。队长……”

failures.source: You stand your ground against the Aztec attack, and thanks to the training of your people and your own tactical finesse, you prevail. Searching the Aztec warriors yields a few valuable trinkets and some salvageable pieces of equipment.
failures.translation: 你坚守阵地，抵挡阿兹特克人的袭击。多亏队员们训练有素，加上你战术得当，最终取得了胜利。搜查阿兹特克武士后，你们找到几件值钱的小饰品，还有一些可以回收利用的装备。

failures.source: Once you are back on your feet, you waste no time in tending to their wounds and having them carried off to the medical tents. Despite your failure to defend against the attack, this was a learning experience. Such an egregious lapse of camp security must not be repeated.
failures.translation: 你们恢复行动后，立刻着手处理伤口，并把伤员送往医疗帐篷。尽管没能挡住袭击，这次也算是吸取了教训。营地安保出现如此严重的疏漏，绝不能再有下次。

failures.source: You awake from dreams of battle in the dark of night, your sweat-soaked blanket clinging to your body. But the sounds of alarm, rushing feet, and clanking metal do not cease as you shake the drowsiness from your head - your camp is under attack.
failures.translation: 深夜，你从战斗的梦境中惊醒，浸透汗水的毯子紧贴着身体。然而你甩开睡意后，警报声、急促的脚步声和金属碰撞声仍未停歇——营地正遭受袭击。

failures.source: You jump into the fray and quickly reassert your authority, gathering your people in an offensive formation. Thanks to your swift arrival and stern tactical commands, you will be able to meet the initial attack head on.
failures.translation: 你冲进战团，迅速重申指挥权，集合队员组成进攻阵形。多亏你及时赶到并下达了严厉的战术命令，你们得以正面迎击首轮攻势。

failures.source: Take charge of the fighting.
failures.translation: 亲自指挥战斗。

failures.source: Despite having left their equipment in the tents, your people fight like lions under your command and the attack is quickly repelled. Your servants reappear cautiously from the outskirts of the camp, having largely been left in peace by the tribals, and they help you scavenge what they can from your fallen enemies.
failures.translation: 尽管队员们把装备留在了帐篷里，在你的指挥下仍如猛狮般奋战，很快击退了袭击者。你的仆人小心翼翼地从营地外围现身；部落民基本没有为难他们。他们还帮你从倒下的敌人身上搜刮能用的东西。

failures.source: Caught without their equipment, your people are outmatched by the attackers. Though you put up a good fight, you are eventually routed from your camp and forced to watch your attackers sack your tents and make off with a sizeable amount of loot from your carts. Once the tribals disappear back into the wilderness, you return to take measure of your losses and restore your medical tent to treat the wounded.
failures.translation: 队员们没带装备，根本不是袭击者的对手。尽管奋力抵抗，你们最终还是被赶出营地，只能眼看袭击者洗劫帐篷，从货车上抢走大量战利品。部落民消失在荒野后，你们返回营地清点损失，并修复医疗帐篷以救治伤员。

failures.source: Leaving your tent, you find that your troops are hastily preparing for battle. You stop FName1 on FHisHer1 way to the palisades.
failures.translation: 你走出帐篷，发现部队正在匆忙准备战斗。你在前往栅栏的路上拦住了FName1。

failures.source: "A small group of natives have been seen near the ridge to the east of the camp, Capitán! We've already sent a squad out to cut off their attack!"
failures.translation: “队长！有人在营地东边的山脊附近发现了一小队原住民！我们已经派出一支小队去截住他们的进攻！”

failures.source: Deciding that you can probably despatch the distraction group fast enough to make it back to the camp before the thieves get away, you set upon your enemies with the fury of the Heavens. Your troops are well trained and well equipped, and you manage to take out the opposition with ample time to chase off the thieves. When the natives see your men charging back into the camp with blood-stained blades in their hands, they quickly drop everything they've taken and scatter into the wilderness.
failures.translation: 你判断自己大概能及时迅速击溃那支佯攻队伍，在窃贼逃走前赶回营地，于是如天神降怒般猛攻敌人。你的部队训练有素、装备精良，及时消灭了敌方，尚有充足时间赶走窃贼。原住民看到你的人手持血迹斑斑的刀刃冲回营地，立刻丢下偷来的东西，四散逃入荒野。

failures.source: You quickly manoeuvre your troops back through the wilderness towards the camp. The thieves are still there when you return, but as your troops charge into the camp and gather in formation between the tents, they panic, drop their loot, and scatter into the wilderness.
failures.translation: 你迅速率部穿过荒野，赶回营地。你回来时窃贼还在，但你的部队冲进营地，在帐篷之间列队后，他们便惊慌失措，丢下赃物，四散逃入荒野。

failures.source: You clean up the mess they left behind and make sure that nothing is missing. You stay up until sunrise to make sure that the warriors won't attempt a real attack to follow up on their failed ruse.
failures.translation: 你收拾他们留下的残局，确认没有东西遗失。你一直守到日出，以防那些战士在诡计失败后又发动真正的进攻。

failures.source: You try to make it back to the camp in time to chase off the thieves, but only a few of them are still there when your people charge back into the camp and form up between the tents. The remaining thieves drop what they've taken and disappear into the jungle, but you've lost an unfortunate amount of resources to this ruse.
failures.translation: 你试图及时赶回营地赶走窃贼，但等你的人冲回营地、在帐篷之间列队时，只剩下几个窃贼还在那里。剩下的窃贼丢下偷来的东西，消失在丛林中；不过这场诡计还是让你损失了不少物资。

failures.source: You've made camp for the evening and sent your troops out to handle their various chores. As you're overseeing the construction of the campfire, an arrow shoots out from the wilderness, zooms past your head inches from your face, and buries itself in a tree.
failures.translation: 你们已扎营过夜，并派部队去处理各自的杂务。你正在监督营火的搭建，一支箭突然从荒野中射来，擦着你的脸颊从头边飞过几英寸，钉进了一棵树里。

failures.source: Despite your lack of preparation and your numerical disadvantage, you stand your ground against the natives and emerge victorious from the attack. Not long after the last tribal warrior hits the dirt with a pained groan, the rest of your troops begin to return to the camp, startled to see it littered with the writhing bodies of your fallen enemies.
failures.translation: 尽管准备不足、人数也处于劣势，你仍顶住原住民的攻势，最终赢得了这场战斗。最后一名部族战士痛苦地倒地呻吟后不久，其余部队开始陆续返回营地，看到遍地都是倒下敌人的挣扎尸体，不禁大吃一惊。

failures.source: Your troops search the fallen natives and carry them off into the medical tent where they will be stabilised and guarded until tomorrow morning. They don't yield spectacular loot, but it's better than nothing. With the camp once again secure, your people settle down for dinner.
failures.translation: 你的部队搜查倒下的原住民，把他们抬到医疗帐篷里，在那里为他们处理伤势并看守到明早。他们身上没什么像样的战利品，但总比没有强。营地再次安全后，你的人便坐下来吃晚饭。

failures.source: Your FRank1 runs off. More shouting rings out as the thieves are chased from your camp, and then all is quite once more, save for the confused murmurings and relieved laughter of your troops returning to their posts.
failures.translation: 你的FRank1跑开了。赶走窃贼时又响起一阵喧闹，随后一切再次归于平静，只剩下困惑的低声议论，以及部队返回岗位时如释重负的笑声。

failures.source: The thieves are elusive, but your troops hunt them down and kill them. They are mostly young men and women with no apparent battle training or experience, and they offer little resistance. You gather your stolen supplies again and bring them back to the carts to be repacked, then you go over the defences to see where the thieves might have gained entry. You should probably endeavour to guard your camp better in the future.
failures.translation: 窃贼很狡猾，但你的部队还是追上并杀死了他们。他们大多是年轻男女，看不出受过战斗训练或有过实战经验，几乎没有抵抗。你找回被偷的补给，重新装回车上，然后检查防线，寻找窃贼可能入侵的地方。今后你最好加强营地守卫。

failures.source: Despite your best efforts, some of the thieves manage to escape with the loot from your carts. You and your people go over the defences of the camp, trying to find out where they got in, and you identify several flaws in your security. You should probably endeavour to guard your camp better in the future.
failures.translation: 尽管你竭尽全力，仍有一些窃贼带着车上的赃物逃走。你和部下检查营地的防线，试图找出他们从哪里进来，并发现了几处防卫漏洞。今后你最好加强营地守卫。

failures.source: Totonac Attack
failures.translation: 托托纳克人来袭

failures.source: You quickly take your sword and your arquebus and run out into the camp to see what's going on. FName1 is on the ground, clutching an arrow sticking out of FHisHer1 leg, writing in agony while a few of your servants are attempting to calm FHimHer1. All around you, arrows are zooming through the air, hitting tents, carts, and people. It would appear that you're under siege.
failures.translation: 你迅速拿起剑和火绳枪，跑出帐篷查看情况。FName1倒在地上，紧紧抓着一支刺入FHisHer1腿里的箭，痛苦地呻吟着，几名仆从正试图安抚FHimHer1。四周箭矢呼啸而过，射中帐篷、马车和人。看来你们遭到围攻了。

failures.source: "Defensive formation! This is a hit-and-run attack, all we have to do is hold our ground until they run out of projectiles!"
failures.translation: “摆好防御阵型！这是打一枪换一个地方的袭击，我们只要坚守阵地，等他们耗尽投射物就行！”

failures.source: The arrow storm seems to never let up, but with steely determination, you hunt down the Totonac archers and kill them one by one. At the end of it, your troops return to the camp - most of your people are still standing. You tend to the wounded and count your blessings. This was a learning experience, and such an egregious lapse of camp security should not be repeated.
failures.translation: 箭雨似乎永不停歇，但你们凭着钢铁般的决心追捕托托纳克弓箭手，将他们逐一击毙。战斗结束后，你的部队回到营地，大多数人都还站着。你照料伤员，庆幸众人平安。这次算是吸取了教训，如此严重的营地防卫疏失绝不能再犯。

failures.source: Tribal Attack
failures.translation: 部族民来袭

failures.source: You move through the camp, dragging the wounded out of harm's way and patching them up to at least stop the bleeding. You manage to stabilise a lot of people, but after a while it becomes clear that there are too many wounded for you to handle on your own. It's time to address the situation more directly.
failures.translation: 你在营地中穿行，把伤员拖到安全处，并为他们包扎，至少先止住流血。你设法稳定了不少人的伤势，但过了一会儿，显然伤员太多，单凭你一人无力应付。是时候更直接地处理眼下的局面了。

failures.source: Unable to find a doctor to help you, you move alone through the camp, dragging the wounded out of harm's way and trying to patch them up to at least stop the bleeding. It's a daunting task, however, and your skills aren't quite up to the task. After wasting quite a bit of time, it's clear that there are too many wounded for you to handle. It's time to address the situation more directly.
failures.translation: 你找不到医生帮忙，只得独自在营地中穿行，把伤员拖到安全处，尽力为他们包扎止血。然而这活儿着实棘手，你的本事也不太够用。白白忙活了好一阵后，你终于意识到伤员太多，自己应付不来。是时候更直接地处理眼下的局面了。

failures.source: With horror, you watch as FName1 - clutching a bleeding wound - attempts to crawl to the relative safety of the wilderness. One of the Godless savages grabs FHimHer1 by the feet, turns FHimHer1 on FHisHer1 back, and meticulously carves up the wounded FType1 with a dull knife. FNameFirst1's anguished screams are quickly silenced.
failures.translation: 你惊恐地看着FName1捂着流血的伤口，试图爬向相对安全的荒野。一名无信仰的野蛮人抓住FHimHer1的双脚，将FHimHer1翻过身来，拿钝刀仔细地割开受伤的FType1。FNameFirst1痛苦的尖叫很快便戛然而止。

failures.source: You order your servants out, and soon after, they return with enough meat to feed ten grown men for a day.
failures.translation: 你命仆役们出发，他们很快就带回了足够十名成年男子吃一天的肉。

failures.source: They decided to give the unfortunate individual a makeshift burial and bring the loot back to your camp along with the spoils of their hunting.
failures.translation: 他们决定为这位不幸之人草草安葬，并把战利品连同猎获一起带回营地。

failures.source: As things are quite busy around the camp tonight, you put FName1 in charge of the hunting party. When the party returns at last, it is with quite a ruckus. Two servants are carrying a bloody FNameLast1 on a makeshift stretcher, shouting in panicked voices about an attack by hideous swamp creatures.
failures.translation: 今晚营地里事务繁忙，你便让FName1负责狩猎队。队伍终于归来时，却闹出了不小的动静。两名仆役用简易担架抬着一名浑身是血的FNameLast1，惊慌失措地喊着他们遭到了可怕沼泽怪物的袭击。

failures.source: You manage to calm everyone down and give you a little peace to examine the wounded FType1 - FHisHer1 lower body is torn by powerful tooth marks. Questioning the servants that accompanied FHimHer1 on the hunt, their terrified descriptions paint a picture of some sort of giant reptile. You remember hearing tales of such a creature back in Santo Domingo, that the earlier explorers had named simply "el lagarto" - the lizard. Despite the terrifying stories, FNameLast1 doesn't seem to be beyond repair, but will take a few days to heal from FHisHer1 injuries.
failures.translation: 你总算安抚住众人，腾出一点时间查看伤员FType1。FHisHer1的下半身布满了有力牙齿留下的撕咬伤。你询问了陪FHimHer1狩猎的仆役，他们惊恐的描述让你想起一种巨型爬行动物。你记得早先的探险者在圣多明各时提过这种生物，称它为“el lagarto”——蜥蜴。尽管传闻骇人，FNameLast1看起来伤势尚可恢复，只是FHisHer1需要几天才能痊愈。

failures.source: "Preserve it. It should provide enough rations to last quite a while."
failures.translation: “把它腌起来吧，应该能做成足够吃上好一阵子的口粮。”

failures.source: Your hunters smile excitedly and head off to prepare the meat.
failures.translation: 猎人们兴奋地笑着，动身去准备肉。

failures.source: FNameFirst2's eyes widen as you approach with the prepared peccary. FHeShe2 quickly takes it into FHisHer2 tent, away from the eyes of others, thanking you as FHeShe2 does so. The jealousy in the eyes of your other followers is clear.
failures.translation: 你拿着处理好的西貒走近时，FNameFirst2睁大了眼睛。FHeShe2赶紧把它带进FHisHer2的帐篷，避开众人的视线，并向你道谢。其他追随者眼中的嫉妒显而易见。

failures.source: Climbing the vines is easy enough, and it doesn't take long before you reach the net. With a determined swipe you easily cut down the trap, and it drops to the ground with a thump and a rattle. You climb back down and unpack the net, revealing its contents. Inside, you find the armour of a Spanish soldier, which seems surprisingly well kept. As you take the equipment to add to your stores, a few bone fragments rattle and fall from the armour.
failures.translation: 爬上藤蔓并不难，你很快就够到了那张网。你用力一挥，轻松割下陷阱；它砰地一声落地，发出一阵响动。你爬下来打开网，露出里面的东西。里面是一套西班牙士兵的护甲，保存得出奇完好。你把装备收起来时，几块骨头碎片从护甲中掉落，叮当作响。

failures.source: Leaving the abandoned camp, your people continue on their patrol and make it back to your own camp without further incident.
failures.translation: 离开废弃营地后，你的人继续巡逻，平安返回自己的营地，再无意外。

failures.source: Sneak past.
failures.translation: 悄悄绕过去。

failures.source: You decide to go out and patrol the camp perimeter with your people tonight. During the patrol, you hear a commotion nearby in the wilderness.
failures.translation: 今晚，你决定带着手下去巡查营地外围。巡逻途中，你听见附近荒野中传来一阵骚动。

failures.source: "The meat should be clean enough to eat, Capitán, and I have heard that jaguar bone marrow boiled to a paste can effectively help in the covering and healing of open wounds."
failures.translation: “队长，这肉应该够干净，可以吃。我听说，把美洲虎的骨髓煮成糊状，能有效帮助覆盖并治愈开放性伤口。”

failures.source: FNameLast goes off again and returns with a dead pig slung over FHisHer shoulder. Then you finish your patrol and return to camp.
failures.translation: FNameLast再次出发，回来时肩上扛着一头死猪。随后你结束巡逻，返回营地。

failures.source: Carry on with your patrol.
failures.translation: 继续巡逻。

failures.source: The commotion comes to a climax with the deep growl of a great feline and the last painful squeals of its dinner. You finish the patrol and return to the camp.
failures.translation: 随着一声大型猫科动物的低沉咆哮，以及它的猎物最后几声痛苦的哀嚎，骚动达到了高潮。你结束巡逻，返回营地。

failures.source: Over night, FName is attacked in FHisHer tent by what must be the same beast, and is unfit for duty in the morning.
failures.translation: 夜里，FName在FHisHer帐篷里遭到袭击，袭击者想必是同一头野兽。到了早上，FName已无法履行职责。

failures.source: Your patrol is travelling along a wide stream when FName1 notices something glimmering in the water out of the corner of FHisHer1 eye. A closer inspection quickly reveals that the bed of the stream is littered with sizeable lumps of gold that must have washed down from the mountains.
failures.translation: 你的巡逻队沿着一条宽阔的溪流前进，FName1忽然发现水中有什么东西在闪光，正好映入FHisHer1眼角。仔细查看后，很快便发现溪床上散落着大块的黄金，想必是从山上冲下来的。

failures.source: Your people collect all the gold they can find as they move up the stream, until the gold gradually thins and disappears entirely.
failures.translation: 你的人沿溪向上游走去，尽可能收集沿途的金币，直到金币逐渐稀少，最终彻底消失。

failures.source: The ship's captain perished attempting to free the ship from the jagged rocks and reef it had run aground on, but its first mate offers to buy any resources you might spare with the treasure he managed to salvage from the wreck.
failures.translation: 船长试图让船脱离搁浅的礁石和暗礁，却不幸丧命。他的大副提出用从沉船中抢救出的宝藏，购买你愿意割让的任何物资。

failures.source: Fully aware of the dangers of a shipwreck rescue, compounded by the darkness of the night, you pull back those members of your patrol who have already begun to prepare for the rescue.
failures.translation: 你很清楚夜色会让沉船救援更加危险，于是叫回了巡逻队中已经开始准备救援的队员。

failures.source: When you return in the morning, only the dead bodies of the ship's crew have made it ashore. Along the coast, you discover a scattered handful of golden coins.
failures.translation: 你们早上返回时，只有船员的尸体被冲上了岸。你在海岸边发现了零散的几枚金币。

failures.source: You cut your patrol a bit short and return directly to your camp, but it looks like the tribals didn't pursue you. You got away with it this time.
failures.translation: 你提前结束巡逻，直接返回营地，不过那些部落民似乎没有追来。这次算你们走运。

failures.source: That night, FName1 returns from FHisHer1 patrol with a beaming smile on FHisHer1 face and a dead hare in FHisHer1 hand. Apparently there is a watering hole near the camp which is visited by many creatures.
failures.translation: 当晚，FName1结束巡逻归来，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容，FHisHer1手里还提着一只死野兔。显然，营地附近有个水塘，许多动物都会去那里饮水。

failures.source: A deafening blast resounds from the workbenches in the back of the camp. You and the majority of the camp rush over to see what's happened. You find FName1 on the ground, writhing under a blanket thrown over FHimHer1 by two of the servants. Smoke rises from under the blanket. The workbench FHeShe1 was working on has been blown apart.
failures.translation: 营地后方的工作台突然传来一声震耳欲聋的爆炸。你和营地里的大多数人赶过去查看发生了什么。你发现FName1倒在地上，两个仆人用毯子盖住FHimHer1，FName1在毯子下痛苦地扭动着。毯子下冒出阵阵烟雾。FHeShe1正在使用的工作台已经炸得粉碎。

failures.source: "If we apply poison to our caltrops, we might be able to enhance their effects in battle. Rather than just slowing the enemy down momentarily and causing a little pain when stepped on, they could work over a longer period of time to damage the enemy."
failures.translation: “要是给我们的蒺藜涂上毒药，或许能增强它们在战斗中的效果。它们不只能短暂拖慢敌人，踩上去时让人疼一下，还能持续更久地伤害敌人。”

failures.source: "I don't like to work with poison, it's too dangerous."
failures.translation: “我不喜欢碰毒药，太危险了。”

failures.source: "Capitán, we have a problem. It seems FName1 was toying with poisons at the work benches last night, and FHeShe1 managed to poison FHimHer1self."
failures.translation: “队长，出问题了。看来FName1昨晚在工作台那儿摆弄毒药，结果FHeShe1把FHimHer1自己给毒倒了。”

failures.source: "That's very unfortunate. Is FHisHer1 condition stable?"
failures.translation: “真不幸。FHisHer1的情况稳定吗？”

failures.source: "Let FHimHer1 rest. I'll reprimand FHimHer1 when FHeShe1's back on FHisHer1 feet."
failures.translation: “让FHimHer1好好休息。等FHeShe1恢复行动，我再训斥FHimHer1。”

failures.source: "I don't like to work with poison, it's too dangerous."
failures.translation: “我不喜欢碰毒药，太危险了。”

failures.source: Travel Event
failures.translation: 旅途事件

failures.source: Fortunately you have more than one doctor, and FName2 believes FHeShe2 has just the right remedy to treat spider venom poisoning. The healthy Doctor administers the medicine while your servants make room in one of the carts for the unfortunate FNameLast1 to rest and recuperate.
failures.translation: 幸好你不止一位医生，FName2相信FHeShe2正好有办法治疗蜘蛛毒。身体健康的那位医生给伤者用药时，你的仆人腾出一辆马车，让可怜的FNameLast1休息和恢复。

failures.translation: 要不是你的医生正痛苦地蜷在眼前的地上，FHisHer1的医疗经验本来能派上大用场。幸好你相信自己正好有办法治疗蜘蛛毒，于是亲自给伤者用药，并命令仆人腾出一辆马车，让可怜的FNameLast1休息和恢复。

failures.translation: 要是你的医生不是此刻正痛苦地蜷缩在你面前的地上，FHisHer1医疗知识或许能派上大用场。可惜，你不知道该如何治疗蜘蛛毒液中毒，只好命仆人给伤者用些通用药剂，并在一辆马车上腾出位置，安置这位倒霉的FNameLast1。

failures.translation: 可惜你不确定该如何治疗蜘蛛毒，于是命令仆人给伤者用些常备药，并腾出一辆马车安置可怜的FNameLast1。

failures.source: The Bad Spring
failures.translation: 有毒的泉水

failures.source: Stopping for a moment to send out scouts and reorient yourself, you notice that FName1 has gathered a little group of your expedition members and is complaining in loud and angry tones about your leadership and some of the specific decisions you've made.
failures.translation: 你停下来派出斥候并重新确定方向时，发现FName1召集了一小群远征队成员，正大声愤怒地抱怨你的领导方式和你做过的几项具体决定。

failures.source: To your distress, FName1 instead draws FHisHer1 weapon and waves it angrily at you.
failures.translation: 令你惊愕的是，FName1竟拔出FHisHer1的武器，愤怒地朝你挥舞。

failures.source: A quick look at the faces around you indicate that nobody is in fact with FNameLast1, but it's clear that FHeShe1's prepared to leave on FHisHer1 own if necessary. You might be able to talk FHimHer1 down if you've got a way with words, but keeping FHimHer1 around would almost certainly be bad for morale. Alternatively, it would undoubtedly strengthen the morale among your troops if you make an example of the agitator.
failures.translation: 你迅速扫视四周，发现其实没人站在FNameLast1那边，但显然FHeShe1已经做好了必要时独自离开的准备。如果你口才够好，或许能说服FHimHer1冷静下来；但把FHimHer1留在队里，几乎肯定会打击士气。另一方面，杀鸡儆猴无疑能提升部队士气。

failures.source: You admit that you can see the reason in FName1's demands, and you agree to acquiesce to them. Having made your decision, you inform FNameFirst2 that it's time for FHimHer2 to leave the expedition and return to FHisHer2 old life.
failures.translation: 你承认FName1的要求确有道理，并同意照办。决定既定，你便告知FNameFirst2，该离开远征队，回到FHisHer2从前的生活了。

failures.source: You give FName1 a simple ultimatum: fall back in line, or leave your sight and never return. The traitor makes a final desperate attempt to drum up support among the rest of your people, but when it becomes clear that FHeShe1 had overestimated the general dissatisfaction with your leadership, FHeShe1 assumes the deepest frown you've ever seen, casts FHisHer1 weapons at your feet, and rides off into the jungle. Hopefully this will be the last you ever see of the FType1.
failures.translation: 你给FName1下了最后通牒：要么回到队伍中来，要么离开你的视线，永远别再回来。叛徒最后一次孤注一掷，试图煽动其他人支持FHeShe1，但发现FHeShe1高估了大家对你领导力的不满后，FHeShe1皱起你从未见过的深深眉头，把FHisHer1的武器扔在你脚边，骑马消失在丛林中。希望你再也不会见到FType1。

failures.source: Your lead supply cart, weakened under the stress of lengthy travel, has split its rear axle, halting the caravan in its tracks. Your people give the cart a cursory examination.
failures.translation: 长途跋涉令你们领头的补给车不堪重负，后轴断裂，商队只得停下。你的人草草检查了一番马车。

failures.source: Unwilling to sacrifice valuable Equipment, your servants spend the rest of the afternoon nearby seeking out a reasonable replacement from the ample jungle wood. A suitable axle is cut and measured and the cart is right as rain in the morning.
failures.translation: 仆役们不愿牺牲宝贵的装备，便在附近花了整个下午寻找合适的替代品，丛林里有大量木材可供利用。他们锯下一根合适的车轴并量好尺寸，到了早晨，马车便完好如初。

failures.source: You bring a handful of troops and move towards the sounds of combat. Reaching an outcropping overlooking a ravine, you see two groups of rebels locked in battle below you - Esteban's troops appear to be fighting Leandra's people. The ground is already strewn with bodies, but a dozen troops are still alive on each side.
failures.translation: 你带上几名士兵，朝战斗声传来的方向走去。抵达一处俯瞰峡谷的高地后，你看见下方两股叛军正在交战——埃斯特班的部队似乎正与莱安德拉的人马厮杀。地上已经横陈着许多尸体，但双方各自仍有十几名士兵活着。

failures.source: Order your troops to sneak closer and open fire from cover.
failures.translation: 命令士兵悄悄靠近，从掩体后开火。

failures.source: After the battle, you search the bodies of your defeated enemies, and those of the people who fell in the skirmish, and bring a decent haul of equipment, rations, and valuables as well as a couple of caltrop bags back to your carts.
failures.translation: 战斗结束后，你搜查了被击败的敌人和在冲突中倒下之人的尸体，带回不少装备、口粮和贵重物品，还有几袋蒺藜。

failures.source: Though FName1 strongly advocates executing the prisoners here and now, you stand by your decision. Your troops tie the prisoners' hands behind their backs and march them off back to the caravan. Afterwards, you search the bodies of those who fell in the skirmish, and bring a decent haul of equipment, rations, and valuables as well as a couple of caltrop bags back to your carts.
failures.translation: 尽管FName1极力主张立即处决俘虏，你还是坚持自己的决定。你的士兵将俘虏的双手反绑，押回商队。之后，你们搜查了在冲突中倒下之人的尸体，带回不少装备、口粮和贵重物品，还有几袋蒺藜。

failures.source: Despite the strong objections of some of your more ethical expedition members, you order your men to execute the prisoners - a task which they carry out with grim efficiency. Afterwards, you search their bodies, and those of the people who fell in the skirmish, and bring a decent haul of equipment, rations, and valuables as well as a couple of caltrop bags back to your carts.
failures.translation: 尽管远征队中一些更有道德感的成员强烈反对，你还是命令手下处决俘虏。他们冷酷利落地执行了命令。之后，你们搜查了他们和在冲突中倒下之人的尸体，带回不少装备、口粮和贵重物品，还有几袋蒺藜。

failures.translation: 你命令手下处决俘虏——无人反对，他们冷酷利落地执行了命令。之后，你们搜查了俘虏和在冲突中倒下之人的尸体，带回不少装备、口粮和贵重物品，还有几袋蒺藜。

failures.source: Attack.
failures.translation: 进攻。

failures.source: Taking on both sides of the battle at once was maybe not the best idea, and soon a hasty retreat is called for. The rebels follow you half-heartedly until you hit the treeline, then they give up the chase.
failures.translation: 同时对付交战双方或许不是个好主意，很快你们便不得不仓促撤退。叛军有气无力地追了一阵，等你们抵达林线便放弃了追赶。

failures.source: Charge into the fray.
failures.translation: 冲入战局。

failures.source: The Healing Herbs
failures.translation: 疗伤草药

failures.source: The servants carry the still unconscious FNameLast2 off, and after administering some carefully selected remedies for the fever, FNameLast1 returns to FHisHer1 place in the caravan. Soon, you're off again.
failures.translation: 仆人们抬走了仍未醒来的FNameLast2，给FNameLast1服用了精心挑选的退烧药物后，FNameLast1回到了商队中FHisHer1的位置。很快，你们又启程了。

failures.source: You put your knowledge of healing to use and check FNameFirst1 for all the possible symptoms you can think of, but all you can find is a fever. It's probably just a cold, but it might be some exotic new jungle disease that you've never encountered before. At your command, the servants carry the still unconscious FNameLast1 off, and once you're done administering some carefully selected remedies for the fever, everyone returns to their place in the caravan.
failures.translation: 你运用自己的治疗知识，检查FNameFirst1可能出现的各种症状，结果只发现了发烧。大概只是感冒，但也可能是你从未见过的某种丛林新型疾病。你下令后，仆人把仍然昏迷的FNameLast1抬走。你给病人用过几种精心挑选的退烧药剂后，众人便各自回到商队原来的位置。

failures.source: "Quick! Get a length of rope from the carts!"
failures.translation: “快！从马车上拿一段绳子来！”

failures.source: After what seems like far too long, one of the servants brings you a rope. Both of the unfortunate expedition members now barely have their heads above the filthy sludge.
failures.translation: 过了仿佛漫长得令人难以忍受的一段时间，一个仆人才把绳子拿来。那两名倒霉的远征队成员此时只剩脑袋勉强露在肮脏的泥浆上。

failures.source: You throw the rope out to FName1. The FType1 struggles to grab hold of FHisHer1 new lifeline, and then clings on for dear life as you and some of the servants pull FHimHer1 out of the quicksand. Meanwhile, FName2 is getting louder and more desperate.
failures.translation: 你把绳子扔给FName1。FType1费力地抓住FHisHer1这条救命绳，随后死死攥住。你和几名仆人合力把FHimHer1从流沙中拉了出来。与此同时，FName2的呼喊声越来越响，也越来越绝望。

failures.source: Throw the rope to FNameLast2 next.
failures.translation: 接着把绳子扔给FNameLast2。

failures.source: Once FNameLast1 is safe back on the stable ground, you throw the rope out to FNameLast2, but FHisHer2 head is no longer above the surface, and FHeShe2 can't see the rope. You grab the rope and jump in, putting your arms around FNameLast2 and hauling FHimHer2 out of the pit. It looks like FHeShe2's swallowed a lot of sand and dirt - FHeShe2 will probably be sick for a few days.
failures.translation: 等FNameLast1安全回到坚实的地面上后，你把绳子扔给FNameLast2，可FHisHer2的头已经没在地面之下，FHeShe2看不见绳子。你抓起绳子跳了进去，搂住FNameLast2，把FHimHer2从坑里拖了出来。看来FHeShe2吞下了不少沙土，FHeShe2接下来几天恐怕会生病。

failures.source: You manage to grab hold of a firm ledge with your right hand, but a terrified scream behind you alerts you to the fact that FName1 was not so lucky.
failures.translation: 你设法用右手抓住一处牢固的岩台，身后传来一声惊恐的尖叫，让你意识到FName1就没这么走运了。

failures.source: Spiked Pit
failures.translation: 尖刺陷阱

failures.source: Your expedition is making good time today and the terrain seems safe and peaceful. You're just enjoying the feeling of hot sunlight on your face when a snap and a crack behind you are followed by a startled grunt.
failures.translation: 今天远征队进展顺利，地势看起来安全而平静。你正享受着温暖阳光照在脸上的感觉，身后忽然传来啪的一声脆响，接着是一声惊愕的闷哼。

failures.source: You hurry to the edge of the hole and see your FRank1 at the bottom of a pit, FHisHer1 arm penetrated by a nasty-looking wooden spike. It appears that FNameLast1 has fallen into some old hunting trap left here by the natives.
failures.translation: 你赶到坑边，看见FRank1在坑底，FHisHer1手臂被一根看起来十分骇人的木刺刺穿。看来FNameLast1掉进了当地人留下的某个古老捕猎陷阱。

failures.source: You and a few of your other troops procure a length of rope and help the incapacitated FNameFirst1 to escape the trap. It's a nasty wound, and regrettably it will take some time to heal.
failures.translation: 你和几名队员找来一段绳子，帮无法行动的FNameFirst1脱离陷阱。这伤势很严重，恐怕得花些时间才能痊愈。

failures.source: Thick Overgrowth
failures.translation: 丛林密生

failures.source: You have encountered particularly thick jungle overgrowth today, and travel will be painstakingly slow as your crew clears a large enough path for the caravan to pass through. The remainder of your movement is halved until tomorrow.
failures.translation: 今天你们遇到了格外茂密的丛林，队伍清出足够商队通行的道路，行进速度因此慢得令人难以忍受。直到明天，你剩余的行军距离都会减半。

failures.source: FName2 comes quickly from the rear of your column. The FType2 thoroughly inspects FNameLast1, then FHeShe2 has the FType1 brought back to a rear cart to lie down. FNameLast2 wipes FHisHer2 hands on FHisHer2 apron and approaches you with a severe frown.
failures.translation: FName2很快从队伍后方赶来。FType2仔细检查了FNameLast1，随后FHeShe2让人把FType1抬到后方的马车上躺下。FNameLast2用围裙擦了擦FHisHer2的手，皱着眉头走到你面前。

failures.source: "Probably not. If it is, there's a high chance FNameFirst1 will be able to live with the disease for many years before it truly kicks in."
failures.translation: “大概不是。就算是，FNameFirst1也很可能还能带病生活多年，之后病情才会真正发作。”

failures.source: Your servants carefully pick FNameFirst1 up and move FHimHer1 to a cart at the rear of the caravan to lie down. It's a slowly progressing disease, and your expedition is likely to be completed before the symptoms truly manifest themselves, but FNameFirst1's general endurance will probably be decreased from now on, which will of course be most obvious during combat.
failures.translation: 仆人们小心翼翼地扶起FNameFirst1，把FHimHer1抬到商队后方的马车上躺下。这是一种缓慢发展的疾病，你们的远征很可能会在症状真正显现前结束。不过从现在起，FNameFirst1的整体耐力恐怕会有所下降，这在战斗中当然最为明显。

failures.source: From FHisHer1 tent, the sick FName1 is struggling to find rest, the damp air inducing one coughing fit after the other. As the night progresses, some of your followers grow annoyed, until finally FName2 gets up and marches over to the FType1's tent and starts yelling.
failures.translation: 从FHisHer1的帐篷里传来声音，生病的FName1辗转难眠，潮湿的空气让FName1一阵接一阵地咳嗽。夜色渐深，一些追随者越来越不耐烦，最后FName2终于起身，大步走到FType1的帐篷前，开始大声叫嚷。

failures.source: FName2 stumbles backwards out of the tent - FHeShe2 is clearly upset and disgusted, wiping spit off FHisHer2 face. The FType2 storms back toward FHisHer2 tent, mumbling something under FHisHer2 breath.
failures.translation: FName2踉跄着向后退，出了帐篷——FHeShe2显然又气又恼，擦掉FHisHer2脸上的口水。FType2怒气冲冲地朝FHisHer2的帐篷走回去，嘴里还在嘟囔着什么。

failures.source: After a while, things calm down and people finally fall asleep, mostly from exhaustion. The next morning, the humid air still hangs like a damp cloth clinging to your face, and as your men rally to begin the day's march, you find FName2 looking utterly miserable. It is clear that whatever disease FNameLast1 was carrying has now infected FNameLast2.
failures.translation: 过了一阵，骚动平息下来，人们终于纷纷入睡，大多是累得撑不住了。第二天早上，潮湿的空气仍像一块湿布般贴在脸上。士兵们整队准备开始当天的行军时，你发现FName2看起来痛苦不堪。显然，FNameLast1所携带的疾病已经传染给了FNameLast2。

failures.source: With a severe expression on FHisHer1 face, FName1 pulls you into the medical tent.
failures.translation: FHisHer1面色凝重，把你拉进医疗帐篷。

failures.source: Not long after you and your people have finished eating, a small group of tribal natives approach your camp carrying small bags. They are dressed in simple clothing and do not carry weapons.
failures.translation: 你和队伍吃完饭没多久，一小群部族原住民便带着几个小袋子来到营地。他们穿着朴素，也没有携带武器。

failures.source: The tribal visitors pick up on the tone of your voice, and they look scared before your translator even gets around to telling them what you said.
failures.translation: 部族访客听出了你语气中的敌意，脸上露出惧色，翻译甚至还没来得及告诉他们你说了什么。

failures.source: The visitors all but flee your camp, taking their gifts with them.
failures.translation: 访客们几乎是夺路而逃，带走了他们的礼物。

failures.source: You've barely finished setting up camp for the night when your perimeter guards sound the alarm. FName1 comes charging into the camp shouting at the top of FHisHer1 lungs.
failures.translation: 你们刚搭好夜间营地，外围卫兵就拉响了警报。FName1冲进营地，扯开嗓子大喊。

failures.source: "Fall back to the inner perimeter and prepare to defend the camp!"
failures.translation: “退到内层防线，准备守住营地！”

failures.source: You hold out against the rebel assault, cutting down rebel after rebel until the rest of them give up and retreat back into the jungle. You send a few people to follow them discretely and make sure they're not just regrouping for another attack, then you see to your wounded. Your servants, many of whom were acting as squires during the battle, loot the bodies of the dead rebels and bring a good amount of valuables and some equipment back to the carts.
failures.translation: 你们顶住了叛军的袭击，一个接一个地砍倒敌人，直到其余叛军放弃进攻，退回丛林。你派了几个人悄悄跟踪他们，确认他们不是在重整队伍准备再度攻击，然后照料伤员。你的仆人中有不少人在战斗时充当侍从，他们搜刮了死去叛军的尸体，带回不少贵重物品和一些装备，装进补给车里。

failures.source: "I know, that's one of the reasons why I admire you. You run a tight ship, but I've always felt that you respect and value us."
failures.translation: "我知道，这也是我敬佩您的原因之一。您治军严明，但我一直觉得，您尊重并珍视我们。"

failures.source: "Well, in the tavern back in San Tiago, I talked to a scout who recently returned from a posting in a region called Boaruco, on the western side of the island. She said she came into possession of an old stone slab with symbols that describe an ancient temple full of sacrificial gifts to pagan gods."
failures.translation: "嗯，我在圣地亚哥的酒馆里，遇到一名斥候。她刚从岛屿西侧一个叫博阿鲁科的地区驻守归来。她说自己得到了一块古老的石板，上面的符号描述了一座古代神庙，里面满是献给异教神祇的祭品。"

failures.source: "She said she found a Taíno elder who was able to translate the symbols, and now she's putting together a group to go back to Boaruco and find the temple. She wants to claim the treasure, and she asked if I would be willing to join her expedition. We will be a dozen troops, and I will get an even cut of whatever treasure we find."
failures.translation: "她说自己找到了一位能解读这些符号的泰诺族长老，现在正召集人手，准备回博阿鲁科寻找那座神殿。她想把宝藏据为己有，还问我愿不愿意加入她的远征队。我们会有十二名士兵，找到的宝藏我也能分得一份。"

failures.source: "Of course, I am just excited about this talk of ancient temples and pagan gods. This sort of thing is /precisely/ why I came to the New World, not - I beg your pardon, Capitán - not to run errands for the Governor. I just want to go for the adventure, I will add my share of the treasure to the expedition's stores. With your permission, I will leave tomorrow morning and join her expedition in San Tiago. It should be no more than a fortnight until we return."
failures.translation: "当然，我只是对古代神庙和异教神祇的话题很感兴趣。这/正是/我来新大陆的原因——请原谅我，队长——我可不是为了替总督跑腿来的。我只是想去冒险；找到的宝藏，我会把自己那份交给远征队。要是您准许，我明早就动身去圣地亚哥加入她的队伍。最多两周我们就能回来。"

failures.source: FNameFirst1 slumps visibly at your reply, and FHeShe1 fights to keep FHisHer1 facial expression neutral, with limited success. The FType1 opens FHisHer1 mouth to say something, but then closes it again and simply nods. Then FHeShe1 turns around and walks quietly back to the camp to disappear into FHisHer1 tent for the night.
failures.translation: FNameFirst1听到你的答复，肩膀明显垮了下来；FHeShe1努力保持FHisHer1面无表情，却没能完全做到。FType1张口想说些什么，随后又闭上嘴，只是点了点头。接着FHeShe1转过身，默默走回营地，钻进FHisHer1的帐篷过夜。

failures.source: The FType1 is momentarily startled out of FHisHer1 train of thought, then nods and continues.
failures.translation: FType1从沉思中猛然回过神来，随后点点头，继续说道。

failures.source: The steady rhythmic thumps of arrowheads embedding themselves in the trunk of a tree draw your attention while you're inspecting the guard posts. FName1 is practicing FHisHer1 already impeccable archery skills as usual.
failures.translation: 你正在检查哨位，树干上不断传来箭头钉入其中的沉稳节奏声，吸引了你的注意。FName1一如往常，正在练习FHisHer1精湛的箭术。

failures.source: "My entire life, PSenorSenora PNameLast. Remember, my father was a fletcher. The bow you hold in your hands, I built it myself. I know the wood, how well it bends and why it bends the way it does. I dare say nobody in Spain can match me at the range."
failures.translation: "我这一辈子都在练，PSenorSenoraPNameLast。别忘了，我父亲是制弓匠。你手里这把弓就是我亲手做的。我了解木材，知道它有多柔韧，也知道它为何如此柔韧。我敢说，西班牙没人能在射程上胜过我。"

failures.source: "Certainly, Capitán. In my defence..."
failures.translation: "当然，队长。为自己辩解一下……"

failures.source: "Citlalli is twice the warrior you'll ever be!"
failures.translation: "西特拉利比你强两倍都不止！"

failures.source: The FType1 opens FHisHer1 mouth, but no words come out.
failures.translation: FType1张开嘴，却一个字也说不出来。

failures.source: FHeShe1 holds your gaze for a long moment, a crooked smile on his lips. Then FHeShe1 waves FHisHer1 arm at you lazily.
failures.translation: FHeShe1久久凝视着你，嘴角挂着一抹歪斜的笑。随后FHeShe1懒洋洋地朝你挥了挥FHisHer1手臂。

failures.source: When FHeShe1 realises that you're being absolutely serious, FHeShe1 nods slowly. Then the FType1 returns to FHisHer1 tent, packs his belongings while you observe from afar, and disappear into the jungle with one last look back towards your camp.
failures.translation: 当FHeShe1意识到你是认真的，FHeShe1缓缓点头。随后，FType1回到FHisHer1的帐篷，收拾好自己的东西。你远远看着FType1，只见FType1最后回头望了一眼营地，便消失在丛林中。

failures.source: The FType1 turns to face you, a surprised look on FHisHer1 face.
failures.translation: FType1转过身面对你，脸上满是惊讶。

failures.source: You stare at each other for several moments. Then FNameFirst shakes FHisHer1 head and turns around again, stumbling back to FHisHer1 tent.
failures.translation: 你们彼此凝视了片刻。随后FNameFirst摇摇头，又转过身，踉踉跄跄地回到FHisHer1的帐篷。

failures.source: The FType1 opens FHisHer1 mouth, but no words come out.
failures.translation: FType1张了张嘴，却什么也没说出来。

failures.source: "He was, back then. His estate was modest, but it was all forest. We did a lot of hunting together."
failures.translation: "那时候是。他的领地不大，但全是森林。我们常常一起打猎。"

failures.source: "I will make it clear to FNameLast2 that I do not tolerate rumourmongering. However, you will /never/ attack a fellow soldier again. Is that understood?"
failures.translation: “我会向FNameLast2说明，我绝不容忍散播谣言。不过，你绝/不能/再攻击同袍。明白了吗？”

failures.source: You turn and head back to the campfire to reprimand FNameLast2 for sticking FHisHer2 nose in other people's business.
failures.translation: 你转身回到篝火旁，准备斥责FNameLast2多管闲事。

failures.source: You follow the path that FNameFirst1 took and have no trouble tracking FHisHer1 foot prints in the soft mud. You find the FType1 just out of earshot of the camp, kneeling on a large patch of moss, animal entrails spread out before FHimHer1.
failures.translation: 你沿着FNameFirst1走过的小路跟去，在松软的泥地上追踪FHisHer1的脚印毫不费力。你在营地听不见的地方找到了FType1，正跪在一大片苔藓上，面前摊着动物的内脏。

failures.source: "I'm... first, let me assure you there is nothing occult or demonic about this practice."
failures.translation: "我……首先，我向你保证，这种做法既不神秘，也不是什么恶魔仪式。"

failures.source: "I can deduce that you learned haruspicy from the same master who taught you medicine?"
failures.translation: "我可以推断，你学脏卜术和医术时拜的是同一位师父？"

failures.source: "...but you have long since proven your worth to me as a doctor. You will stop these filthy pagan rituals. That is an order, and it will not be repeated."
failures.translation: "……但你早已证明自己是个称职的医生。你必须停止这些肮脏的异教仪式。这是命令，我不会再重复第二遍。"

failures.source: "...is what I would say if I were a more God-fearing PManWoman. Thank your fortune that we are far from the church, FNameLast1. Now, wrap up what you’re doing and come back to the camp."
failures.translation: "……如果我更敬畏上帝一些，我就会这么说。你该庆幸我们离教堂很远，FNameLast1。现在收拾好手头的东西，回营地去。"

failures.source: "Then may your pagan gods protect you."
failures.translation: "那就愿你的异教神祇保佑你。"

failures.source: FNameFirst1 stares at you aghast for a few moments, then FHeShe1 turns and runs back towards the camp, leaving the remains of FHisHer1 despicable ritual on the forest floor. You cover the entrails in fallen leaves and head back to bed.
failures.translation: FNameFirst1惊愕地瞪着你片刻，随后转身朝营地跑去，把FHisHer1那场可憎仪式的残迹留在林地上。你用落叶盖住内脏，回去睡觉。

failures.source: "Now. Haruspicy."
failures.translation: "现在，占卜。"

failures.source: As your servants begin to erect a camp for the night, your guards call you out to the perimeter. A small group of Aztec servants are approaching with their arms full of large items wrapped in skins. They appear harmless, and you allow them into the camp to find out what they want.
failures.translation: 仆人们开始搭建夜间营地时，卫兵叫你到营地边缘去。一小队阿兹特克仆人正走过来，手里抱满了用兽皮包裹的大件物品。他们看起来没有恶意，你便让他们进入营地，问问他们有何来意。

failures.source: After accepting your gift, you have a few of your people take the Aztec servants to the carts and put them in chains. After a few days of regular beatings, you should be able to release them from the chains and trust that they don't run off back to Tenochtitlan.
failures.translation: 接受礼物后，你派几名手下把阿兹特克仆人带到马车旁，给他们戴上镣铐。等连续鞭打几天后，你就可以给他们解开镣铐，并相信他们不会逃回特诺奇蒂特兰。

failures.source: Picking out the Galician words that resemble Spanish and putting them together in your head, you think you gather that the song is about a nun of high birth who was seduced by the nephew of the abbess and tried to leave her convent to be with him.
failures.translation: 你挑出其中听起来像西班牙语的加利西亚语词句，在脑海中拼凑一番，觉得这首歌讲的是一位出身高贵的修女：她被女修道院院长的侄子诱惑，想离开修道院与他在一起。

failures.source:
"Essa noit' aquela monja todas sas cousas guisou 
por se con seu amigo yr; mais en ha capela 
da Virgen Santa Mari' ant' o altar ss' agollou, 
chorand' ant ha sa omagen que era mui bela, e sse ll' espedia. 
Mas quando foi na porta, per ela non podia sayr, ca via 
deant' a magestade que ll' a porta choya."
failures.translation:
“那一夜，修女备齐了所有东西，
打算与情人一同离去；可她来到
圣母玛利亚的礼拜堂，在祭坛前跪下，
向那美丽的圣像哭诉告别。
可到了门口，她却无法离开，
因为眼前显现出威严的圣母，
竟将那扇门牢牢封住。”

failures.source:
"Poi-la levou a ssa terra e con ela juras pres, 
mui ben ll' ouve conprid' aquelo que lle convera; 
aynda mui mais lle deu, que ante que passas' un mes 
a fez sennor de ssa herdade, mais ca ll' el dissera. E ela vivia 
a mais viçosa dona que viver poderia, e quanto queria 
tod' aquel seu amigo lle dava e compria."
failures.translation:
“后来他带她回到自己的领地，与她结为夫妻，
将该给她的一切都给了她，
甚至远远超过了先前的承诺。不到一个月，
他便让她成了领地的女主人。她过着
世上最欢快的日子，她的情人想要什么，
便给她什么，尽心满足她的一切心愿。”

failures.source: Somewhat surprisingly, the nun's second escape attempt succeeded, despite the repeated efforts of the statue of the Virgin Mary, and she did in fact marry her seducer, lived happily ever, and had many sons and daughters. You await the final twist with baited breath.
failures.translation: 有些出人意料的是，修女第二次逃跑竟然成功了，尽管圣母像一再阻拦。她确实嫁给了诱惑她的男人，从此幸福地生活下去，还生了许多儿女。你屏息等待着最后的反转。

failures.source:
"A dona daqueste sonno foi espantada assi 
que tremendo muit' e chorando diss' a seu marido 
toda a vison que vira. E per quant' eu aprendi, 
quiso Deus que da sa graça foss' ele ben conprido, e o que ll' oya 
todo llo outorgava; e dela sse partia e d'outr' abadia 
religion fillava, en que a Deus servia."
failures.translation:
“那女子在梦中大惊失色，
浑身颤抖，哭着把所见的一切
都告诉了丈夫。据我所知，
上帝赐予他充足的恩典；她所说的话，
他无不应允。于是他离开了她，
在另一座修道院受戒，侍奉上帝。”

failures.source: Indeed, the Virgin Mary visited the former nun in her sleep and scolded her for leaving her convent. Disturbed by this vision, she told her husband of it, and he agreed to leave her and took orders in another abbey. It's uncertain what the morale of this story is, except perhaps to keep your visions to yourself if you're happy with your life.
failures.translation: 原来，圣母玛利亚在梦中探访了那位已还俗的修女，责备她离开修道院。她被这个梦境惊扰，便告诉了丈夫；丈夫同意离开她，随后在另一座修道院受戒。这个故事究竟想劝人什么，很难说；或许只是提醒你，若生活满意，就别把梦境告诉别人。

failures.source: After the meal, FName1 sits next to you at the camp fire.
failures.translation: 饭后，FName1坐到你身旁的篝火边。

failures.source: Returning from your nightly chores, you round a corner in the camp just in time to see Cacama charge Coyotl at full speed. Both men are unarmed.
failures.translation: 你做完夜间杂务回营地时，正好转过营地的一个拐角，看见卡卡马全速冲向科约特尔。两人都没有带武器。

failures.source: You sense a certain cool air about Coyotl as he simply nods and returns to what he was doing before Cacama's little episode.
failures.translation: 科约特尔只是点点头，便回去继续先前的事。你察觉到他身上透着一丝冷淡。

failures.source: The Nature Of Culture
failures.translation: 文化的本质
